izzyondroid:com.parishod.watomatic.name: Watomatic
izzyondroid:com.parishod.watomatic.summary: Auto reply bot for WhatsApp, FB Messenger and more soon
izzyondroid:com.parishod.watomatic.description:
Watomatic automatically replies to all your WhatsApp and Facebook messages. This is especially useful if you are planning to migrate away from WhatsApp but can also be used as a simple vacation responder.
 Features: 
 Auto reply to every WhatsApp and Facebook messages
 Set your own auto reply message
 Auto reply to group chats
 Respects your privacy
 Does not connect to the internet
 No Ads
 Open Source
 WhatsApp's recent privacy policy changes have triggered a huge migration to more privacy friendly apps like Signal and others. But most of us find it difficult to delete WhatsApp because everyone else uses it. Watomatic tries to make your migration easier by letting your friends automatically know that you are moved to another app. Just set an auto reply message something like “I am not using WhatsApp anymore. Please use Signal…” and let it do the work for you.
 Troubleshoot: 
 Watomatic relies on WhatsApp notifications for auto reply to work. Most users usually have notifications enabled so should work straight out of the box but otherwise please make sure WhatsApp notifications are enabled and WhatsApp fingerprint lock is disabled for this app to work. This app is not associated with any company including WhatsApp, Facebook, Signal, Telegram.
 This uses non standard Android APIs to achieve this so it is not guaranteed to work on all devices.

izzyondroid:com.shpak.quicktimer.name: Quick Timer
izzyondroid:com.shpak.quicktimer.summary: Set and manage timer directly from your Quick Settings - no regular app screen!
izzyondroid:com.shpak.quicktimer.description:
Quick Timer Tile makes managing your time effortless and distraction-free.
 Add it to your Quick Settings, and you’re ready to go – no app icon or traditional interface. Everything happens through a timer dialog and notification.
 How to get started:
 Add the Timer to Quick Settings: Swipe down from the top of your screen to open Quick Settings.
 Tap the pencil icon or "Edit" to customize your tiles.
 Drag the "Timer" tile into the active area.
 Set up your timer: Tap the "Timer" tile to open the timer setup dialog.
 Grant notifications permission (if needed).
 Use the pickers to set the desired time and press "Start".
 Follow the Timer in Notifications: Once the timer starts, a notification shows the remaining time.
 Pause, resume, or cancel the timer directly from the notification with one tap.
 Why use Quick Timer?
 Quick access: start a timer in seconds straight from Quick Settings.
 No clutter: no app screen or icon – just a clean, efficient experience.
 Convenient notification: always know how much time is left at a glance.
 Perfect for cooking, workouts, or any activity where timing matters!

fdroid:com.donotnotify.donotnotify.name: DoNotNotify
fdroid:com.donotnotify.donotnotify.summary: Block unwanted notifications. Fast, private, and fully offline.
fdroid:com.donotnotify.donotnotify.description:
Take control of your Android notifications with DoNotNotify — the simple, privacy-first way to block unwanted alerts and focus on what matters.
Tired of constant pings, spam, and clutter? DoNotNotify lets you create powerful yet easy rules to block notifications from specific apps or by matching text — even using regular expressions. No ads. No accounts. No tracking. Everything runs locally on your device.
Key features:
🛑 Block by app or by text: Silence a whole app, or only the notifications that contain certain words or match a regular expression. Or allow only the ones you care about and block the rest.
📚 Stack: Gather a chatty app's notifications into one tidy group you can expand, instead of a constant stream.
⏳ Throttle: Let the first notification through, then block repeats for as long as you choose. Perfect for apps that ping you every few seconds.
🕒 Right time, right place: Limit any rule to certain hours, or to when you're (or aren't) using your phone.
✨ Easy rule wizard: Tap a notification in your history to create a rule for it. As you type, DoNotNotify shows which of that app's notifications your rule will match.
📦 Pre-built rules: Ready-made rules for popular apps are added automatically, and more are shared by the community.
📜 View notification history: See all notifications your device has received, even the ones that were dismissed or blocked — so you never miss anything important.
🔒 100% private: All processing happens on your phone — no internet required.
⚡ Lightweight & battery-friendly: Runs silently in the background without draining power.
Privacy by design:
DoNotNotify never collects or shares your data. There are no analytics, ads, or cloud servers — your notification data never leaves your device. Notification history is kept only on your phone and is never included in backups; Android may back up your rules and settings if system backup is turned on.
DoNotNotify is open source (MIT License): https://github.com/anujja/DoNotNotify
Whether you want fewer distractions, better focus, or simply a cleaner notification shade, DoNotNotify gives you peace and control — effortlessly.

fdroid:me.timeto.app.name: Productivity System - timeto.me
fdroid:me.timeto.app.summary: Goals, checklists, tasks, repetitive tasks, calendar and 24/7 time tracking.
fdroid:me.timeto.app.description:
I built this app to manage my productivity.
Here, I will SHARE my productivity system and how I use the app.
My system IS ALL ABOUT achieving my REAL-LIFE goals.
For example:
- I DO NOT care how much time I waste,
- but I CARE if I read a book every day,
- I CARE if I exercise every day,
- I CARE if I don't forget anything,
- I CARE if I constantly follow my long-term goals.
Now I will show MY PERSONAL app setup with REAL-LIFE scenarios.
---
Activities
The first you have to do is SET UP ACTIVITIES. MY ACTIVITIES in the morning, right after I wake up look empty. During the day, I have to turn them as completed. Now I'll show how I use each activity.
---
Morning
Right after waking up, I tap the Morning activity. Once I finish the checklist, Morning will be marked as complete.
---
Workout
I DO NOT care about tracking every single step, but I CARE I do workout every day.
---
Small Tasks
We all have plenty of non-urgent tasks that we constantly postpone. Every day, I FORCE MYSELF to spend 30 minutes for that.
---
Work
Working as a developer, I have to track my working hours, there are a set of features for that.
Total Stopwatch makes the timer display TOTAL TIME spent on work FOR TODAY. This way, I can always see how much time I've spent on work today.
Another feature is adding notes to the current task. You can see how much time you spent on each task.
I use a POMODORO-LIKE technique.
---
Reading
Some people set a goal to read for a hour a day. I like to read a fixed number of chapters per day. It works like a counter.
---
Free Time
I use Free Time for activities I don't need to track, like eating, walking, meeting, etc.
---
Sleep
I prefer to use a stopwatch to check in the morning how long I slept.
---
Conclusion
By default, the app comes with almost the same activities and settings. You can use this setup.
I want to give you THREE TIPS dealing with activities that are extremely important to me: PROCRASTINATION, PRIORITIES, and FLEXIBILITY.
---
Procrastination
I solve it simply: I open the app, see uncompleted activity, and tap on it without thinking.
Tapping the activity feels like you've made the first step. If you start thinking, you will continue procrastinating.
---
Priorities
We usually start the day with the most urgent tasks and SACRIFICE long-term goals, because long-term goals are not usually urgent.
NO MATTER what happens, I try to start my day focusing only on what really MATTERS TO ME.
---
Flexibility
Unexpected things happen every day. We have to accept this fact. It's ABSOLUTELY OKAY if we can't do some activity today.
KEEP IN MIND: the most important is REAL-LIFE and PRACTICAL VALUE.
---
DO NOT RUSH
I believe we do more when we don't rush. Stay calm and start slowly.
Let's move to other features.
---
Timer
Timer is running ALL THE TIME. There is NO STOP OPTION! To stop the current activity, you have to start the next one.
This way I always remember what I have to do. Also, it provides 24/7 data on how long everything takes.
---
TASKS is a big part of the app.
NEVER KEEP ANYTHING IN MIND! As soon as a task or idea comes to mind, leave it to the list. We get really tired when we try to keep everything in mind. TRY TO EXPERIENCE the feeling when you don't need to remember anything. EVERYTHING in the task list.
---
Task Folders

 Here’s a quick list of capabilities that Bibledit provides for Bible translation teams today:
 Bibledit has much of the same functionality of Paratext, but it works on any smart device — including all types of computers and tablets and phones.
 A translation team can work with Bibledit via the Internet without installing anything. We call this the Cloud version. But for most translation team members, it will be better to install Bibledit locally. This is called the Client version. The Client version saves editing changes made by each team member to his/her device, and when they have an connection, their work will automatically be saved to the Cloud.
 Many excellent and scholarly translation resources available in Bibledit. And one can view translation resources while editing a translation on the same screen.
 Bibledit can port changes in a Bible text over to a local instance of Paratext. I think many translation team leaders will want to do this. But the opposite is also possible: Bibledit can receive Bible texts from Paratext.
 Bibledit has many powerful export options. These include creating web-ready HTML files, beautifully formatted OpenOffice files (which then can easily be turned into PDF files), and Sword modules for Bible-reading applications on all smart devices.

fdroid:sh.hnet.comfychair.description:
ComfyChair brings the power of ComfyUI to your Android device with a native Material 3 Expressive interface. Connect to your ComfyUI server and generate AI images and videos right from your phone.
What you can do:
- Generate images from text prompts with live progress updates
- Transform existing images or use inpainting with a built-in mask editor
- Pick a source from your device or one already on your server, without uploading it again
- Create AI videos from text, animate still images, or restyle and upscale videos
- Continue a video from its last frame, or send a result straight to another screen
- Follow your jobs in the queue, cancel them, move them to the front, or clear the queue, and see what else the server is working on
- Browse all your creations in the gallery, with Undo for every deletion
- Work offline with cached data when your server is unavailable (with media stored on the device)
Flexible workflow support:
- Works with both traditional Checkpoint and modern UNET workflows (Flux, Z-Image, Wan, LTX-2, MiniMax H3 and more)
- Stack up to 5 LoRAs with individual strength controls
- Create new workflows from scratch, import files, or pick a workflow saved on your ComfyUI server
- Link values between nodes and disconnect them, as in ComfyUI
- Add your own fields: any node value can appear in the generation options
- Open, create and unpack ComfyUI subgraphs, and export workflows in ComfyUI's format
- Full node graph visualization and editing with a searchable node browser, values and lists that take links as in ComfyUI, and an overview of large graphs when zoomed out
- Organize nodes into groups and add notes with Markdown, tables and code blocks included
Built for mobile:
- Image, Video, Gallery and Settings tabs with predictive back
- A full-screen prompt editor and one-tap parameter chips
- Manage multiple servers with per-server settings
- HTTP Basic Auth, API key and browser SSO sign-in for secured servers
- Private by default: generated media stays in memory, no analytics, no cloud backup
- Pinch-to-zoom media viewer with swipe navigation
- Video playback with sound, seeking and frame-by-frame stepping
- Clear error messages, with the full details from the server one tap away
- Batch operations for saving, sharing, or deleting multiple items
- Backup and restore your configuration across devices, right from the welcome screen
- Available in English, German, French, Polish, Spanish, and Chinese
Requirements:
- A running ComfyUI server (local or remote)
- Android 13 or higher
ComfyChair is free, open source (GPL-3.0), and not affiliated with the official ComfyUI project.

apple-macos:463362050.name: PhotoSweeper
apple-macos:463362050.description:
PhotoSweeper is a lightning-fast, highly accurate, and remarkably efficient tool for cleaning up similar or duplicate photos, even in massive photo libraries. It works with Apple Photos, Lightroom Classic, Capture One, and images stored anywhere on your Mac or external drives.
“Swift, easy to use, thorough, analyzes specific libraries, can search according to various criteria, offers choices in photo handling” - TheNextWeb
"PhotoSweeper packs a powerful punch in de-cluttering any size collection. 9/10" - Mac.AppStorm
"PhotoSweeper is a simple and efficient utility for organizing photos. 4.5/5" - Macworld
“I like PhotoSweeper because you can tweak it to compare with different criteria… not a one-trick-pony.” - MacRumors forum user
"This tool does a great job of finding duplicates, not just exact duplicates, but photos that have been rotated, resized, or are even just very similar. It also has a great set of default rules for figuring out which image to keep automatically, which can save hours." - Mac App Store Review
PhotoSweeper is perfect for you if:
• You often take a series of shots to get the perfect image and want to remove the extras.
• You edit photos in apps like Photoshop or Capture One and create multiple versions or backups.
• You have photos spread across folders, external drives, and libraries like Apple Photos, Lightroom Classic, or Capture One.
• Your photo library feels messy, disorganized, or too full, and you want to reclaim space by removing unnecessary files.
Key Features
• Deep Integration with Popular Photo Libraries
Works seamlessly with Apple Photos, Lightroom Classic, and Capture One. You can also scan any folder or external drive, with no need to move or reorganize your files beforehand.
• Fast and Accurate Comparison Engine
Under the hood is a lightning-fast engine that detects both exact duplicates and visually similar images. It goes beyond filenames by analyzing content, composition, and capture time. You can fine-tune the matching level to catch everything from identical copies to burst shots and edits.
• Flexible, User-Friendly Workflow
Clean up your library with ease. Similar photos are grouped side by side for quick visual comparison. Use Auto Mark to automatically select the best image in each group, or choose manually. Lock important photos, view EXIF data, preview with Quick Look, and apply customizable marking rules.
• AI-Powered Photo Scoring
Evaluates the visual quality of photos using AI and displays a visual badge on each image. Use the “Quality Score” auto mark rule to automatically keep the best shots.
• Smart Cleanup with Safety in Mind
You're always in control. Review all marked photos before deleting. Nothing is permanently erased. Photos go to the system Trash, are marked “Rejected” in Lightroom, or moved to a special album in Photos so you can recover them later if needed.
• Optimized for Performance / Handles Large Libraries
Whether you have thousands or hundreds of thousands of photos, PhotoSweeper runs fast and smooth. It's optimized for macOS and runs natively on Apple Silicon for top performance on your Mac.
Why Choose PhotoSweeper?
• Works with Photos, Lightroom Classic, Capture One, folders, and more
• Detects both exact duplicates and similar-looking photos
• Lets you compare side-by-side with clear previews and detailed info
• Features Auto Mark, customizable rules, and flexible cleanup options
• Supports RAW, JPEG, HEIC, PNG, TIFF, and other popular formats
• Designed for both casual users and professionals
• Keeps your photo collection tidy, organized, and free of clutter
Declutter your photo library, free up disk space, and enjoy your best memories without the noise. With PhotoSweeper, cleaning up your Mac has never been so smart and satisfying.
Need help or want to learn more? Check out the full user manual at http://overmacs.com, or drop us a line at support@overmacs.com — we’re happy to help!

flathub:app.tintero.Tintero.name: Tintero
flathub:app.tintero.Tintero.description:
Tintero is a writing studio for long or structured projects. It was built for creative writers,
 so characters, worldbuilding, scenes, plot grids, cork boards and screenplay formatting come built
 in, but at its core it is a place to write, link and organize text. A novel, a screenplay, a thesis,
 a research paper, a role-playing campaign, a set of documentation or a personal knowledge base
 all fit, and dozens of project templates (classic story structures, academic papers, memoirs, business
 documents) give each one a starting point. Your files stay on your device unless you choose to
 sync them.
 The editor adapts to what you write: distraction-free and typewriter modes, a manuscript page
 view and dedicated screenplay formatting. Open several documents side by side, insert elements
 from a quick slash menu, link documents to each other, search and replace across the whole project,
 and see your characters and worldbuilding elements highlighted directly in the text.
 Organize everything in a hierarchical tree with colors, icons and status, and see how it all
 connects in the project map, a graph of documents, links, characters and worldbuilding. Plan on
 a cork board, track plot lines and character arcs in a plot grid, place events on timelines and
 draw flow maps for branching stories. Sticky notes, collections and an outline view keep the big
 picture within reach.
 Build detailed character profiles with galleries, relationships, variants and psychological
 traits, and describe your world with more than a dozen entity types: locations, factions, items,
 events, species, languages, magic systems, deities and more. A global relationship map shows how
 they relate to one another.
 Listen to your manuscript with natural voices, or produce a directed multi-voice narration by
 annotating who speaks and how. Dictate straight into the document. An optional AI assistant can
 brainstorm, summarize and answer questions about your own project, running on a local model (Ollama
 or LM Studio) or on your own cloud provider: it is there to consult, not to write for you.
 Import DOCX, RTF, Markdown, HTML, Fountain and plain text, or whole projects from Scrivener,
 bibisco and novelWriter. Export the whole book to PDF, EPUB, DOCX or HTML from the Book Studio,
 or single documents to Markdown, RTF and plain text. Loose Markdown or DOCX files can be opened
 and edited without a project. Share private drafts with beta readers and collect their inline comments,
 and extend Tintero with plugins and about thirty themes. Snapshots, version comparison and backups
 protect your work, and optional live sync (a premium feature) keeps desktop, mobile and web in
 step, with end-to-end encryption if you want it.
 Highlights:
 Distraction-free, typewriter, page view and screenplay modes in a multi-tab editor
 Links between documents and a project map that draws the whole project as a graph
 Cork board, plot grid, timelines and flow maps for planning
 Characters and worldbuilding with relationships, variants and inline highlighting
 Narrated audio with directed multi-voice packs, and voice dictation
 AI assistant on a local model or your own provider, focused on your project
 Import from DOCX, RTF, Markdown, Fountain, Scrivener and more; export to PDF, EPUB and DOCX
 Statistics, writing sessions and custom writing goals with a progress calendar
 Snapshots, version comparison, backups and optional live sync with end-to-end encryption
 Plugins, about thirty themes, beta reader sharing and zero telemetry by default

flathub:de.renew.Renew.name: Renew
flathub:de.renew.Renew.description:
Renew (The Reference Net Workshop) is a Java-based multi-formalism editor and simulator that provides a flexible modeling approach based on, but not limited to, reference nets.
 Petri nets are a well established means to describe concurrent systems. Over the years, numerous extensions to the basic formalism have been proposed to account for abstract data types, object-orientation, hierarchies or new arc types.
 Among them is the reference nets formalism, where tokens can be references to arbitrary objects, especially other nets, thus allowing nested net models. It allows Java inscriptions, has built-in List and Tuple types, offers test, inhibitor and flexible arcs and has a powerful synchronization mechanism.

fedora-packages:btrfs-assistant/btrfs-as.description: Btrfs Assistant is a GUI management tool to make managing a Btrfs filesystem easier. The primary features it offers are: * An easy to read overview of Btrfs metadata * A simple view of subvolumes with or without Snapper/Timeshift snapshots * Run and monitor scrub and balance operations * A pushbutton method for removing subvolumes * A management front-end for Snapper with enhanced restore functionality * View, create and delete snapshots * Restore snapshots in a variety of situations * When the filesystem is mounted in a different distro * When booted off a snapshot * From a live ISO * View, create, edit, remove Snapper configurations * Browse snapshots and restore individual files * Browse diffs of a single file across snapshot versions * Manage Snapper systemd units * A front-end for Btrfs Maintenance * Manage systemd units * Easily manage configuration for defrag, balance and scrub settings

fedora-packages:btrfsmaintenance/btrfsma.name: btrfsmaintenance
fedora-packages:btrfsmaintenance/btrfsma.description: Scripts for btrfs maintenance tasks like periodic scrub, balance, trim or defrag on selected mountpoints or directories. This is a set of scripts supplementing the btrfs filesystem and aims to automate a few maintenance tasks. This means the scrub, balance, trim or defragmentation. Each of the tasks can be turned on/off and configured independently. The default config values were selected to fit the default installation profile with btrfs on the root filesystem. Overall tuning of the default values should give a good balance between effects of the tasks and low impact of other work on the system. If this does not fit your needs, please adjust the settings.

Block Color: Blast Jam Puzzle – Slide, Match, and Clear Your Way to Puzzle Perfection!
Dive into a vibrant world of block-stacking strategy and colorful challenges! Tetra Jam combines the joy of classic block puzzle games with a fresh twist — dynamic color slide blocks that keep your brain buzzing and your fingers sliding. Perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages!
HOW TO PLAY
- Use your finger to slide blocks toward the edge of the board that matches the block's color.
- When the block reaches the matching color edge, it will be removed from the board.
- Keep sliding and matching until all blocks are cleared — that’s how you win the game!
- Think ahead and strategize your moves — some levels will really test your logic!
WHY TETRA JAM?
- Color-Slide Puzzle Fun – A unique twist on the classic block puzzle! Slide blocks to matching edges and clear the board with satisfying moves.

- Smooth & Intuitive Controls – Just one finger is all you need to slide, match, and win!
- Vibrant Visuals & Relaxing Vibes – Enjoy colorful themes and calming sound effects as you puzzle your way through.
- Play Anytime, Anywhere – Just pure puzzle fun whenever you want.
Are You Ready to Master the Color Block Craze?
Tetra Jam isn't just a puzzle game — it's a brain-teasing, color-sliding adventure! Whether you're in for a quick challenge or an hours-long puzzle session, every move brings a splash of fun and satisfaction.
Download Tetra Jam: Color Block Puzzle now and turn every slide into a win! Unleash your logic. Embrace the colors. Let the jam begin!

Get $25 to $500* in cash advances with no credit check, no late fees, and same-day delivery* for a fee.

Grant Cash Advance lets you get cash fast by requesting your cash advance amount, claiming it, then repaying it once your paycheck arrives.

In Grant Cash Advance’s Bills & Spending tab, Grant Cash Advance Plus users can easily track how money is flowing in and out of your account.
Lastly, Grant Cash Advance’s Marketplace feature lets you browse tools to help you succeed in your financial journey.
KEY FEATURES:
- Cash advances from $25 to $500* for eligible and qualifying customers
- Optional same day delivery for a fee*
- Simple automated repayment with your next paycheck
- No late fees
- No credit check
TRANSPARENT PRICING:
- Optional subscription to Grant Cash Advance Plus for $9.99 per month, which includes access to Bills & Spending features.
- Get same-day delivery using our optional Express Delivery* service for a fee ranging from $2 to $21.

1. Connect your bank account
2. Request a cash advance
3. Choose standard or Express Delivery
4. Let Grant Cash Advance work its magic in processing your request!

bluejetty:00131418:ios.description:
Welcome to Tumblr, your ultimate creative space and art social network community for art, memes, and fandoms. Whether you're deep into a niche or just discovering your artistic side, Tumblr welcomes every voice and vision. It’s where creativity, community, and self-expression come together in one powerful social networking platform. Share your work, connect with fans, and explore endless opportunities to post your art in a supportive art community.
Use Tumblr to share art, write an art blog, discover new fandoms, and explore your interests without limits. We function as a powerful blog making app for all your long- and short-form creations. Post images, text, videos, GIFs, and even audio to your own personalized dashboard. Follow topics you love, reblog content that inspires you, and build your own art community of fans and friends. Post your art alongside like-minded creators, whether you’re into illustrations, photography, or fanart.
Tumblr is your creative playground. Whether you’re into digital art, fanfiction, cosplay, or simply love funny memes, you’ll find others who get it. Express yourself with GIFs, memes, fanart, and tutorials, and join authentic conversations with others who share your passions across countless fandoms. Think of this as your space to be real, hang out, and create openly, among the top social media apps for creativity.
Our social media platform supports original content creation, art blogs, and fan communities. Use tags to reach new audiences and curate your personal feed. Whether you're writing original stories, sharing digital art, or posting your latest fan creations, your dashboard is where it all comes together. Post your art with ease and connect with people who share your interests in an engaged art community that supports your creativity.
Explore trending tags, join creative challenges, or browse through curated art collections and fan edits. Discover the latest in K-pop, anime, Marvel, DC, gaming, and TV show fandoms. Tumblr thrives on vibrant spaces, giving you access to a world of niche interests and major trends. We are one of the essential social media apps for finding creative communities. You can even follow your favorite fic writers from AO3 (Archive of Our Own), see their OC art, and share your passions in conversations about your favorite fanfiction universes.
Start your own webcomic, showcase your fan creations, or simply enjoy scrolling through an endless stream of content. With tools for reblogging, liking, and sharing, you’re never far from discovering something amazing. Join the community where you can hang out, reblog iconic moments, engage in fan theories, or just scroll for inspiration. Be real and express your unique style while being yourself in creative communities across a global art network.
Customize your experience with our intuitive tools and privacy settings. Create multiple blogs, go private, or make a name for yourself in the digital art and fanart world. Whether you’re here to share your voice, find your people, or simply enjoy the internet the way it used to be, Tumblr is your space to do it all. Post your art or write your next art blog, and discover a community where everyone can be real.
Download Tumblr now and become part of a global creative social media community. From art sharing apps and fandom hubs to social creativity tools and online self-expression, this is your space to belong. Explore creative discussions, connect with an art community, and make it your own.
Twitter: https://twitter.com/tumblr/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tumblr/
Terms of Service: https://www.tumblr.com/policy/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00014806:ios.name: TinyPOS:Tools for Business
bluejetty:00014806:ios.summary:
TinyPOS is a powerful, easy-to-use bookkeeping app that helps your business grow faster.
We offer a wide range of customizable features. You can edit your items and orders, print receipts, view inventory and statistics, and share and back
bluejetty:00014806:ios.description:
TinyPOS is a powerful, easy-to-use bookkeeping app that helps your business grow faster.
We offer a wide range of customizable features. You can edit your items and orders, print receipts, view inventory and statistics, and share and back up data. Use the app to record sales, check receipts, and print them with ease. It saves you significant labor and time costs while helping you avoid extra hardware expenses.
Customizable content includes, but is not limited to:
Items and categories, inventory, customer info, payment methods, staff, common notes, etc.;
Your business name, logo, welcome message, receipt numbering, sequence settings, etc.;
Connect a Bluetooth printer, set receipt print styles, and customize receipt content;
Customize receipt calculation and payment rules, discounts, taxes, other fees, tips, etc.;
Personalized operation settings, sound and vibration reminders, language and currency symbol options;
Main features and highlights:
○ Item management, including name, price, discount, tax rate, image, sorting, category, keywords, and number. Also supports add, edit, and delete.
○ Category (group) info. Quickly expand categories by swiping down above the item list on the main screen to select items more precisely.
○ Record sales with a tap, as simple as using a calculator. Add item notes, temporarily change price, quantity, or discount, and record cash received and change.
○ Print receipts/invoices with a Bluetooth printer. Add watermarks, headers, footers, and other extra information to invoices, and manage this information.
○ Personalize your currency symbol, language, time and date format, quantity and price precision, printed content, and more.
○ Connect your Bluetooth printer and configure it professionally. Adjust encoding language, code page, line spacing, receipt width, and more.
○ Add and manage customer info, and quickly switch customers during use. Search by name and notes.
○ Export receipts (bills, slips) as images or PDF files, and share them as files or images.
○ Professional statistics that automatically summarize and query sales info and provide reports.
○ View and analyze sales reports, and export them to EXCEL in a specified format.
○ Back up and restore your data, making it easy to share data across devices or accounts.
○ More importantly, contact the developer directly in the app for timely help and support.
TinyPOS will become your preferred order management app. It has a friendly interface, is easy to use, and is portable. It works without the internet and requires no account registration, so you don’t need to worry about privacy leaks. Just a few taps make running your business easier.
[Upgrade to Subscription]
The subscription version provides cloud sync and backup, so you can keep all your information in a secure cloud service and share the same data across multiple iOS devices such as iPhone and iPad.
We offer the following auto-renewing plans:
Monthly VIP (1 month), quarterly VIP (3 months), yearly VIP (1 year);
1. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period;
2. Within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period, the renewal fee for the next month will be charged to your account;
3. You can view and manage your subscription in your device’s account settings;
[Privacy Policy and Terms of Use]
Privacy Policy: https://oppinfo.github.io/privacy.html
Terms of Service: http://oppinfo.github.io/service.html
We look forward to your feedback, and any questions will receive a quick reply:
iMessage: cenzigo@icloud.com
Email: oppinfo@163.com

MAMBA IN NUMBERS
- 60 million man and women are registered in Mamba;
- Over 3 million users meet each other every day;
- Mamba is popular in more than 50 countries of the world;
- Now over 100 000 users are online, 1/3 of them are new;
- Over 1 million new profiles every day.
ADVANTAGES
MAMBA IS A FREE AND SAFE place for dating and communication.
Technologies based on digital intelligence detect and block fake activity and suspicious profiles. Our support team is at your service 24/7. 
FAST REGISTRATION via social networks
Create a new profile or authorize via Facebook. It takes just 10 seconds to start meeting people! 
SEARCH FOR PEOPLE NEARBY or in other locations!
- meet and chat with people nearby now; 
- the app shows people with whom you are close during the day, for example in the area of your office or work. 
- socialize with girls and guys from all over the world: chat with charming Ukrainian women, cute Russian and European women. 
FILTERS
All people look for different: some look for friends, some for romance and others seek a date, love and relationship. How to please everyone?
Use advanced settings filters by dating purpose. Chat with people with the same goals. 
Would you like to make new friends considering all your preferences? 
Use filters for appearance type, income, family status, children and others.
Are you dreaming to meet a sweetheart? It is easy! 
Go to “Encounters” and Mamba will find people who match your criteria.. If you like a user swipe right and swipe left if not. If you have a match you get notification and can start chatting immediately. 
--
If free options are not enough for you, you can use paid benefits: 
- Make your profile more popular and thousands will see it; 
- Hide your profile so that only your favorite users could view it; 
- Send presents to users you like, congratulate friends on birthdays and other holidays; 
--

bluejetty:00037309:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00037309:ios.description:
Tapestry weaves your favorite blogs, social media, and more into a unified and chronological timeline.
⁕ The Web Your Way
Tapestry combines posts from your favorite social media services like Bluesky, Mastodon, Tumblr along with others like RSS feeds, podcasts, YouTube channels, and more. All of your content is presented in chronological order, with no algorithm deciding what you should or shouldn't see.
⁕ Join The Conversation
Compose new posts, reply to your friends, and read discussions on Bluesky or Mastodon right from inside of Tapestry. No need to switch to another app when you want to interact.
⁕ A Bird's Eye View
Tapestry makes it easier than ever to browse content from dozens or even hundreds of sources. Create custom timelines, seamlessly sync your reading position across devices, and keep track of feeds in an easy-to-read, color-coded stream of content.
⁕ Avoid Spoilers Everywhere
Quickly create powerful rules that control what you do and don't see across all your feeds. Avoid potential spoilers and stay clear of unwanted topics by creating rules that muffle and mute items in everything you follow.
⁕ Powerful Searching
Search for topics and terms across all feeds simultaneously. Tapestry makes it easy to find that blog post, YouTube video, or podcast you're looking for - and easy to mark it for later.
⁕ Private By Design
Your privacy is a priority. Tapestry works with content stored on your device, so searching and viewing content is completely private. We never sell or share your data with third parties. 
⁕ Custom Connectors
Expand Tapestry’s potential with third-party connectors. Import custom connectors from trusted developers, or even write your own to add your favorite bit of data to the timeline. If there's an open data feed available, a connector can weave it into Tapestry.
Additional Features:
• Universal app for iOS, iPadOS and macOS
• Quickly open posts in your favorite third party apps to take action
• Syncs your reading position via iCloud across devices
• Fully accessible using VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, and more
• Customize Tapestry's app icon, layout, and fonts
• Create custom timelines of your favorite feeds
• Mark your favorite items to read later
• Light and dark mode support
--------
Tapestry uses auto-renewing subscriptions. The subscription provides access to premium features like ad removal, custom timelines, feed customization, and more. The subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of your subscription period and will be charged through your iTunes account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time from your iTunes account settings. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed.
Terms of Use: https://tapestry.iconfactory.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://tapestry.iconfactory.com/privacy

bluejetty:00029834:ios.description:
Where does your money go every month? Budget OK gives you the answer. It is a personal finance and money management app that combines an expense tracker, a monthly budget planner and a bill organizer, so your household budget, spending, savings and debts fit on one screen.
Personal budgeting only works when tracking takes seconds. In Budget OK you log a purchase in two taps: amount, category, done. Because entry is fast, you keep your money tracking going day after day, and your budget finally reflects reality instead of guesses.
TRACK YOUR EXPENSES AND INCOME
Record daily spending and income as they happen. Categories and subcategories such as groceries, cafes, transport and subscriptions show exactly how you spend your money.
SEE YOUR FINANCIAL PICTURE
Clear charts and reports break down your expenses by category and compare months. Spot the spending leaks, cut them, and free up cash for the things that matter.
PLAN A MONTHLY BUDGET YOU CAN KEEP
Set a spending limit for each category and watch the remaining balance through the month. Planning your income and expenses ahead turns budgeting from a chore into a habit.
STAY ON TOP OF BILLS AND PAYMENTS
Keep rent, utilities and recurring payments organized so every bill is paid on time and nothing surprises you at the end of the month.
GROW YOUR SAVINGS, MANAGE YOUR DEBTS

The villains who invaded the Earth under the command of Zenos!

Miniforce animation is now available as a game!
Create your own avatar and make new friends.

Once you've made new friends, let's start an adventure to find a new world!
Sea, fishing ground, playground, and even school!
In Miniforce World, you can discover new things even in places you've been to!
Start an adventure with your friends and find hidden secrets!
■ Various Minigames ■
Pick your most favorite character and play!
Fight against Zenos, a belt-actions scroll, Miniforce Shooting!
Pass the obstacles and challenge to the highest score, Miniforce Run!
Flip the cards and win the duel, Miniforce Memory!

bluejetty:00154040:ios.description:
Meet your easy all-in-one tool for scanning and creating QR codes and barcodes. Whether you’re a student, small business owner, or just want to stay organized, this app helps you get things done fast. No confusing menus, no extra steps—just a simple, reliable scanner that works every time. Scan product info, share links, or make your own custom codes in seconds.
Mini Websites & Dynamic QR Codes:
Create QR codes that stay up-to-date without reprinting. With hosted mini websites and dynamic QR codes, you can change content anytime—like updating a menu, event info, or product details—and your QR code will always show the latest version. Ideal for small businesses, restaurants, and event organizers.
Fast Camera Scanning:
Use your camera to scan QR codes and barcodes instantly. Get quick access to websites, product details, or contact info. Great for shopping, events, or daily use.
Batch Scanning:
Scan many QR codes or barcodes one after another. This saves time when doing inventory, checking products, or handling multiple items at once.
QR Code Generator:
Make your own QR codes and barcodes in a few taps. Create codes for websites, contacts, promotions, or personal use. Perfect for business or everyday projects.
Scan History:
Keep track of everything you’ve scanned. Check past codes anytime in your saved history for quick reference.
Export Scan Data:
Export your scan results as CSV or TXT files. It’s an easy way to store or share your barcode and QR code data.
Ready to make scanning and creating simple?
Download now and enjoy a fast, easy QR code reader and barcode scanner that just works.

bluejetty:00144948:ios.description:
Build the city that you’ve always dreamed of! Grow your crops, feed your cattle, and trade the product to further enhance your farming games. Bring happiness and prosperity to your citizens with exotic restaurants, convenient community buildings, and breathtaking wonders. Take on an adventure and explore the mysterious tunnels of the Ancient City buried beneath your very own land.
So what are you waiting for? Get yourself READY to become the most successful mayor and build your dream city in this farming games!
Farming Diary features:
• Adorable farm animals for you to take care of
• Numerous types of vegetables and fruits to grow and process in your farming factories
• Build and customize the city your own way with advanced factories, dazzling landmarks, and glamorous decorations!
• Invite, visit, and help your neighbors from Facebook to make new friends
• Meet kind citizens, deliver orders to their doors, and help them with their problems as a great mayor
• Discover and collect rare minerals in the underground Ancient City
• Try your luck at the Happy Balloon house and receive fascinating gifts
• Get yourself some special exclusive prizes in our unique events
• Invest and earn cash in the City Bank to ensure a stable future for your city
• Tons of great discount farming products and ingredients constantly offered on the Market stall
• Smooth gameplay experience along with beautiful graphics
• Offline playing mode allows you to enjoy the farmer game anywhere and anytime like traveling on the bus or walking down the street
Farming Diary is a FREE TO PLAY farm game with options to purchase some in-game items to enhance your game experience with real currency.
*Some features of the game will require internet connection in order to work properly such as Friends, Competitions, Save/Load data, and other features*
Let us know what you think and learn more about Farming Diary at:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/farmcityofficial
Twitter: https://twitter.com/farmcity_mobile
Email: farmcity@zegostudio.com

Have fun learning about animals - learn animals names and sounds while enjoying funny animations.

At ToyaTap we are dedicated to creating high-quality learning experiences that children and parents can enjoy together.
We hope you and your child will enjoy playing this game as much as we enjoyed creating it!

bluejetty:00140679:ios.description:
HeartIn: Your Comprehensive Heart Health Companion
Welcome to HeartIn, the app designed to empower you to take control of your heart health with ease and precision. Utilizing cutting-edge technology, HeartIn transforms your smartphone into a powerful heart rate monitor, providing personalized insights and resources to help you lead a healthier lifestyle. From measuring your heart rate and variability to monitoring your stress and energy levels, HeartIn offers an all-in-one solution for your cardiovascular wellness.
Key Features
Heart Rate Measurement & Variability (HRV)
With HeartIn, measuring your heart rate is as simple as placing your finger over your smartphone's camera. Our innovative technology uses the camera and flash to detect subtle changes in light absorption, giving you accurate readings in just seconds.
Heart Score
After each measurement, receive a personalized heart score that evaluates your heart health based on age and gender benchmarks. HeartIn calculates this score with HRV (Heart Rate Variability) as its essential metric, integrating age and gender to provide a comprehensive view of your heart health.
HRV Graphs
Track your heart rate variability over time with intuitive line graphs, providing insights into your stress levels, recovery, and overall heart health.
Pulse Rate Monitoring
Seamlessly integrate with your Apple Watch for real-time pulse rate monitoring. This feature ensures you stay informed about your cardiovascular status throughout the day, helping you recognize patterns and make informed lifestyle choices.
Stress & Energy Monitoring
Understand how your daily activities impact your well-being with our stress and energy monitoring features. By analyzing your HRV, HeartIn provides daily insights and recommendations to help you manage stress and boost your energy levels effectively.
Blood Pressure & Blood Oxygen Logging
Easily log your blood pressure and oxygen saturation levels within the app. Track your readings over time with user-friendly history logs that visualize trends, allowing you to make informed decisions about your health.
AI Chatbot & Self-Care Resources
Engage with our health-focused AI chatbot for instant responses to your heart health queries. Explore a curated library of articles on heart health, wellness tips, and daily health insights, all tailored to support your journey towards a healthier lifestyle.
User-Centric Design
HeartIn is crafted with user experience in mind, featuring a clean and intuitive interface that allows for easy navigation between measurements, logs, and self-care resources. Whether you're a health enthusiast or just starting your wellness journey, HeartIn offers a seamless experience for everyone.
Conclusion
Take the first step towards better heart health with HeartIn. Whether you're monitoring your heart rate, managing stress, or exploring self-care resources, HeartIn is your trusted partner in health and wellness. Download HeartIn today and empower yourself with the knowledge and tools to lead a healthier life!

bluejetty:00140655:ios.description:
10 years on the App Store
Over 1 million users worldwide
I tried out A LOT of reminder apps (over 100) and none fully met my needs. So, I decided to learn programming and create the perfect app for myself.
'If you want something done well, do it yourself.' — Ferdinand Porsche
The key thing: with ListBox, you'll really start getting things done.
Why? The app won't let you ignore notifications, and when you notice one, it suggests a quick action (check out the screenshots).
In ListBox, you'll find:
- Customizable task timers, like: 'Remind in 2 hours', 'In 30 minutes', 'At 20:30 tonight' (adjustable), 'In the morning', 'At the start of the week', 'End of the month', etc.
- Recurring tasks. For example, set a reminder to 'Take vitamins' at 10:30 on Mon., Wed., Fri. or 'Change bed linen' every week
- The fastest reminder adding in the industry
- When a task comes up, you can postpone it with just one tap (see screenshots)
- Add tasks by voice, including setting the time. You can say: 'Remind me to call Dima at 8 PM'
- Quickly add the last photo from your gallery, handy for when you take a screenshot and want to set a reminder about it
- Insert text from the clipboard with one button
- Select a contact from your phone book with one tap, so you don't forget to call
- Create different task lists, like: Ideas, Shopping, Movies, etc.
- Customizable appearance, choose a photo or color for the background
- Video tutorials - definitely watch these to make using the app easier
With the 'Ask a Question' feature in settings, you can send me your ideas or report bugs. I respond to all messages.
Thanks for reading this far, have a great day :)
If you decide to use the Premium features (not mandatory), the payment will be charged to your iTunes account.
You can cancel the subscription in your Apple account settings at any time after purchase.
Privacy policy: https://ListboxApp.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00183197:ios.description:
** 2022 APP STORE AWARD Winner **
** 2022 APPLE DESIGN AWARD Finalist **
You know you need to drink more water!
• Smart Reminders during your day
• Complete 10+ fun healthy Challenges
• 50+ Hydration Tips
• Collect & fill up 140 cute Characters
• Track water from anything you drink: 150+ most popular beverages
• Apple Watch app
• Widgets: home screen, lock screen, control center
• Track Calories
• Calculate your daily water goal based on your weight, activity & weather
• Charts & monthly Recaps
• Streaks
• Celebrate your day with fun recap illustration
• Create your own beverages
• 20+ Animated Messages Stickers
• Logs Calendar
• Monthly In-App Events
• Apple Health Sync
• Shortcuts & Siri support
• Oz/Ml measure units
• Localized into 22 languages
• All features are based on scientific studies of building healthy habits
Benefits of drinking water
+ Weight loss & healthy skin
+ Improves productivity & mood
+ Relieves fatigue & boosts energy
+ Healthier heart, immune system & brain
+ Regulates blood pressure & body temperature
Waterllama water tracker free app is simple & fun. Get reminder to drink water regularly. Join healthy challenges like Weight Loss Sloth which will motivate you to drink water only, help with intermittent fasting as your water fasting app.
Don't worry about being too busy, use drink water reminder free & don't just hydrate when you feel thirsty. Avoid dehydration by using my water app drinking reminders & never forget to drink water again. Apple Watch water drinking reminder included.
Waterllama water minder calculates how much do you need to drink water according to your activity level, body weight, climate & gender (male, female, pregnant or breastfeeding mom).
Hydration is essential for human body. Waterllama reminds you to hydrate properly & maintain the balance of your body fluids by drinking water.
Waterllama mywater tracker can help you have a better focus & concentration. Drink water to exercise more effectively. Water tracker can help you avoid fatigue, mood swings & low motivation. Managing your water intake can help with a weight loss since you will feel more full & avoid overeating. Daily hydration helps you restore energy & contribute to feeling happier. Water tracker can even help you boost productivity & reduce stress when used the right way. Building a new healthy habit can be much easier when all of your drinks are logged. You can see all of your water log in the Waterllama water intake calendar.
Waterllama free water drinking app features: track water intake, smart reminders, water reminder apple watch app, streaks, water intake goal calculator, custom daily water goal, llama character, water intake calendar, lock screen widgets, water cup size, Oz/Ml units, Apple Health sync and more.
Waterllama drink water app premium paid features: 100+ characters, 10+ challenges, 150+ beverages, 10+ reminder sounds, create custom beverages, personalized beverages panel, edit water intake history, change glass/cup size. Plus you'll be able to access even more Beverages, Characters, Challenges & features in future monthly updates.
Waterllama premium features are available as a monthly & annual subscription or as a one-time purchase. Your iTunes account will be charged at confirmation of purchase. The subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period. You can go to your iTunes Account Settings to manage your subscription & turn off auto-renew. To restore all your previous purchases use the "Restore Purchases" button located at the bottom of the Premium Features popup.
Stay hydrated & happy using Waterllama drink water reminder n tracker
Terms of use & Privacy policy
https://waterllama.com/privacy-policy-terms-of-use.pdf
Note: HealthKit integration is to sync Water, Caffeine, Dietary Energy data with Apple Health app

bluejetty:00177861:ios.name: Teach Monster: Reading for Fun
bluejetty:00177861:ios.summary: From the charity behind the award-winning Teach Your Monster to Read comes Teach Monster – Reading For Fun, a brand new game that encourages kids to have fun and enjoy reading! Designed with experts from the UK’s Roehampton University to ge
bluejetty:00177861:ios.description:
From the charity behind the award-winning Teach Your Monster to Read comes Teach Monster – Reading For Fun, a brand new game that encourages kids to have fun and enjoy reading! Designed with experts from the UK’s Roehampton University to get kids reading more, Teach Monster – Reading For Fun inspires kids to explore a magical village full of fascinating facts and spellbinding stories.
Customise your own monster, make friends with colourful characters and collect over 70 free ebooks courtesy of Usborne, Okido, Otter-Barry and more. The game encourages children of all ages to read for pleasure and is perfect to play at home or school, alongside Teach Your Monster to Read or on its own.
There are hours of reading fun, from following signposts and reading aloud with Goldspear the librarian, to discovering books which help you bake delicious cakes and find treasure. It’s up to you to choose what to explore and when, but hurry, the villagers need your help. Your monster must use all its wisdom, skill and bravery to stop the book-eating goblin from causing chaos in the village and eating all the books!
WHY READING FOR FUN?
• Boost your child’s reading confidence 
• Develop your child’s empathy, as they put themselves in different characters’ shoes and develop an understanding of the wider world
• Improve your child’s skills in reading for different purposes, from recipes, to signposts and instructions
• Read books with friends. Choose brand new books, or re-read old favorites 
• Create positive screen time for children in a fun environment 
• Collect over 70 brilliant free ebooks from Usborne, Okido, Otter-Barry and more.
Reading for pleasure is a proven method to transform literacy skills and academic performance in children. The pedagogy of reading for pleasure within this game has been developed in close collaboration with educational experts from the UK’s Roehampton University.
BE PART OF A READING COMMUNITY 
• Make friends and help out the villagers with quests that require reading
• Pop into the village library to read along with Goldspear, Coco and more
• Read different kinds of texts, from signposts and instructions to entire fiction and non-fiction books
• Complete jobs to get rewarded with books for your monster’s bookshelf
• Solve challenges and follow the story as it unfolds, read recipes to make treats, or go on quests to overcome the book-eating goblin.
• Discover new authors, poems, stories and a series of children’s books that you’ll love. 
Created by Teach Your Monster, Reading for Fun is part of The Usborne Foundation, a charity founded by children’s publisher, Peter Usborne MBE. Harnessing research, design and technology, Teach Your Monster is a non-profit organisation that creates playful media to address issues from literacy to health.

listings.description:
From the charity behind the award-winning Teach Your Monster to Read comes Teach Monster – Reading For Fun, a brand new game that encourages kids to have fun and enjoy reading! Designed with experts from the UK’s Roehampton University to get kids reading more, Teach Monster – Reading For Fun inspires kids to explore a magical village full of fascinating facts and spellbinding stories.

Customise your own monster, make friends with colourful characters and collect over 70 free ebooks courtesy of Usborne, Okido, Otter-Barry and more. The game encourages children of all ages to read for pleasure and is perfect to play at home or school, alongside Teach Your Monster to Read or on its own.

There are hours of reading fun, from following signposts and reading aloud with Goldspear the librarian, to discovering books which help you bake delicious cakes and find treasure. It’s up to you to choose what to explore and when, but hurry, the villagers need your help. Your monster must use all its wisdom, skill and bravery to stop the book-eating goblin from causing chaos in the village and eating all the books!

WHY READING FOR FUN?
•        Boost your child’s reading confidence 
•        Develop your child’s empathy, as they put themselves in different characters’ shoes and develop an understanding of the wider world
•        Improve your child’s skills in reading for different purposes, from recipes, to signposts and instructions
•        Read books with friends.  Choose brand new books, or re-read old favorites  
•        Create positive screen time for children in a fun environment 
•        Collect over 70 brilliant free ebooks from Usborne, Okido, Otter-Barry and more.

Reading for pleasure is a proven method to transform literacy skills and academic performance in children.  The pedagogy of reading for pleasure within this game has been developed in close collaboration with educational experts from the UK’s Roehampton University.

BE PART OF A READING COMMUNITY 
•        Make friends and help out the villagers with quests that require reading
•        Pop into the village library to read along with Goldspear, Coco and more
•        Read different kinds of texts, from signposts and instructions to entire fiction and non-fiction books
•        Complete jobs to get rewarded with books for your monster’s bookshelf
•        Solve challenges and follow the story as it unfolds, read recipes to make treats, or go on quests to overcome the book-eating goblin.
•        Discover new authors, poems, stories and a series of children’s books that you’ll love. 

Created by Teach Your Monster, Reading for Fun is part of The Usborne Foundation, a charity founded by children’s publisher, Peter Usborne MBE.  Harnessing research, design and technology, Teach Your Monster is a non-profit organisation that creates playful media to address issues from literacy to health.

What are you waiting for? Take your monster on an epic reading adventure today!

K
bluejetty:00029905:ios.description:
The most powerful QR Code Scanner and Generator since 2011. Qrafter has everything you need to scan, create, and design QR Codes and barcodes. Trusted by millions of users, Qrafter's extensive feature set has been refined over the years.
Key Features
• Full English Support: Qrafter is fully localized in English for an intuitive and comfortable user experience.
• Versatile Scanning: Swiftly and accurately scan QR Codes, Micro QR Codes, Data Matrix, Aztec Codes, PDF417, and a variety of barcodes. Scan codes from your Photos app, or scan multiple codes in the same session.
• Custom QR Code Design: Design unique, eye-catching QR Codes with custom colors, logos, backgrounds, and styles for your brand, business, or personal use.
• Comprehensive Code Generation: Create QR Codes, barcodes, and other formats for your business, personal use, or marketing campaigns.
• Unique Features: QR Code compression and QR Code encryption with password protection set Qrafter apart from the rest.
• History: Easily access and manage previously scanned or generated codes with the most customizable history feature. Organize codes into folders, synchronize across devices with iCloud, or store selected information locally on your device. History can also be secured with biometric authentication like Face ID.
• Advanced Parsing: Qrafter smartly parses URLs, contact information, events, location data, email and SMS sending options, Wi-Fi connection details, and more, presenting the results in a user-friendly and meaningful manner.
• URL Safety Check: Reveals the destination URL for short links, helping you detect potentially malicious content.
• Passkey QR Code Support: Log in faster and more safely to websites that support passkeys, using QR Codes.
• Auto Wi-Fi Connection: Scan a QR Code containing Wi-Fi network credentials and connect to the network automatically without manual entry.
• Inventory Scanner Mode: Transform Qrafter into a customized inventory app. With each scan, Qrafter calls a custom API endpoint in the background. You can fully customize the API endpoint URL.
• Optimized for iPhone Duo and iPad: Experience a fully custom user interface for iPhone Duo and iPad, perfect for educational institutions and professional use. On iPhone Duo and iPad, Qrafter's user interface is designed to make the best use of the larger screen, with full multitasking support.
• Apple Watch Companion: Your history is on your wrist. Show a saved ticket, loyalty card or Wi-Fi code from the watch, page through the other formats of a code, and open it full screen.
• VoiceOver Customizations: Qrafter is fully accessible and committed to providing a seamless experience for all users. With its VoiceOver customizations, visually impaired users can easily navigate, scan, and generate codes.
Supported Code Types
• 2D Codes: QR Code, Micro QR Code, Data Matrix, Aztec Code, PDF417
• Barcodes: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 39, Code 93, Code 128, Codabar, GS1 DataBar, GS1 DataBar Expanded, GS1 DataBar Limited
• Postal Barcodes: RM4SCC, IMb, Japan Post, KIX
End user license agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00142756:ios.developer: Chengdu Ningmengyoumeng Science & Technology Co., Ltd
bluejetty:00142756:ios.summary:
[Product Introduction]
Lemonlet Water Tracker, a simple and cute water reminder software, is a good helper for everyone to drink water healthily. It provides you with considerate water drinking reminders and water drinking records, and als
bluejetty:00142756:ios.description:
[Product Introduction]
Lemonlet Water Tracker, a simple and cute water reminder software, is a good helper for everyone to drink water healthily. It provides you with considerate water drinking reminders and water drinking records, and also has functions such as historical data statistics, presentation and retention of water drinking, so as to help you master the daily water drinking rules and ensure your health.
[Product Features]
* Water Drinking Reminder - Remind on time for every drinking water without missing. You can define the time, sound, text, etc. to make drinking water interesting.
* Water Drinking Record - Accurately record the water drinking data without losing it. We carefully save all the data to ensure that your water drinking data is accurate.
* Trend Statistics - Don't worry about observing the daily water drinking trend. We provide some presentation methods: calendar, trend chart and list, to help you make the most effective water drinking plan and display your water drinking records.
* Warm and cute - After using it, you will know that this is a lovely app for drinking water record reminder.
[Reasons for drinking water]
Water is very important to the human body. It can participate in life movement, eliminate harmful toxins, help metabolism, maintain aerobic respiration, etc.
* Help digestion: The food we eat, after being chewed by teeth and moistened by saliva, goes through the digestion process from the esophagus to the stomach and intestines, completes digestion and is absorbed. These links require the participation of water to accelerate the dissolution of nutrients by body fluids.
* Excrete waste: The residual waste left after the nutrients of food are digested and absorbed must be excreted from the body through sweating, breathing and excretion. These different excretion methods all require the help of water to achieve.
* Lubricate joints: Lubricants are needed between human joints to avoid damaging friction between bones, and water is the main source of joint lubricants.
* Balance body temperature: When the ambient temperature is lower than body temperature, in order to maintain body temperature and ensure normal physiological activities, the water in the body will be retained in the body due to the reduction of evaporation due to the shrinking pores; when the ambient temperature is higher than body temperature, the water will be excreted from the body through the expanded capillary breathing holes to lower the body temperature. The body ensures its survival function through the flow of water.
* Maintain cells: Water can promote cell metabolism, maintain the normal shape of cells; keep the skin moist and elastic.
* Balance blood: Water can improve the circulation of blood and tissue fluid, and help balance the viscosity and pH of blood.
[Water requirement]
* Adults consume about 2500ml of water per day, and get about 1000ml from food, so they need to drink about 1500ml of water every day.
* There is also a saying that eight glasses of water a day, these 8 glasses of water cover the time from getting up in the morning to before going to bed at night, to ensure that the human body has enough water intake.
[Types of drinks that the App has provided or will provide]
* Common drinks: plain water / milk / coffee / milk tea / tea.
* Fruit and vegetable drinks: apple juice / orange juice / mango juice / lemon juice / tomato juice.
* Protein drinks: yogurt / soy milk / walnut juice / peanut juice / almond juice.
* Carbonated drinks: cola / soda water, etc.
So, for your health, don't forget to drink water. Go and download this water drinking app, drink water together, insist on drinking water, and eventually become a water lover!
[Notes]
* This App has been connected to HealthKit, and the water drinking data can be synchronized to "Health".

The app provides travelers with travel time and speed information from roadway sensors, weather impacts such as flooded and icy roadways, regional travel alerts, evacuation information, live traffic camera images, incident locations, and construction schedules to aid in trip planning.

Established in 1993, TranStar manages the region’s transportation system and is the primary coordination site for state, county, and local agencies when responding to incidents and emergencies.

Established in 1993, TranStar manages the region’s transportation system and is the primary coordination site for state, county, and local agencies when responding to incidents and emergencies.

bluejetty:00087228:ios.name: GTO Poker Trainer: Postflop
bluejetty:00087228:ios.summary: Fix your postflop leaks in five minutes a day. GTO Poker Trainer puts you in 14,000+ solver-solved hands: cash games at 100 BB and MTTs at 25-100 BB. Make your play, see the exact EV you lose against the GTO strategy, then ask Nash, your AI
bluejetty:00087228:ios.description:
Fix your postflop leaks in five minutes a day. GTO Poker Trainer puts you in 14,000+ solver-solved hands: cash games at 100 BB and MTTs at 25-100 BB. Make your play, see the exact EV you lose against the GTO strategy, then ask Nash, your AI coach, why.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Get a spot: board, positions, stacks and pot.
2. Make your decision: check, call, raise or fold, at the sizes the solver uses.
3. See what it cost: EV loss in big blinds, the solver's mixed frequencies and the full 13x13 range.
4. Fix the leak: your stats rank your biggest EV losses by street, position and stack depth, and the leak drill brings those spots back.
WHAT YOU GET
- 14,000+ pre-solved hands in 290 scenarios: 10 cash (6-max, 100 BB) and 280 MTT (8-max, 25-100 BB, with antes)
- Single-raised pots, graded on the flop, turn and river
- Mixed strategies explained: when two actions are both right, you see why
- Daily 5: five fresh spots a day, streaks and an ELO rating to climb
- Nash, your AI coach: explains any spot in plain language, shows optimal ranges and answers poker questions
- A weekly report of your biggest leaks
- Works offline: all training data is stored on your device
- Phone and tablet, portrait and landscape
BUILT FOR PLAYERS WHO STUDY
Short daily sessions beat marathon study. Track EV loss per decision, accuracy by street and a leak list you can act on, whether you grind cash games, play MTT final tables or are learning poker strategy for the first time.
EDUCATIONAL USE ONLY
GTO Poker Trainer is a study tool. No wagering, no prizes.
SUBSCRIPTION
Download and start training right away. Pro (monthly, yearly or lifetime) unlocks unlimited daily hands, the full leak list, unlimited leak drills, the full weekly report and more Nash messages. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Account Settings in the App Store.
Terms of Use: https://www.pekasoftware.com/gto-poker-trainer/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.pekasoftware.com/gto-poker-trainer/privacy

bluejetty:00185491:ios.description:
*** PLAY TO FRENCH BELOTE ON YOUR IPHONE, IPOD AND IPAD ! *** 
Play to the popular French Belote card game, against opponents simulated by an high-level artificial intelligence or with your friends. 
All official rules and many variants are handled : 
- Play with or without declarations. 
- Play with No Trumps and All Trumps. 
*** SEVERAL GAME MODES INCLUDING MULTIPLAYER *** 
- Play alone against skilled AI players. 
- Play Online through Game Center : Invite your friends, or let the Game Center find players for you. 
- Play on LAN with your friends, via WiFi or Bluetooth. 
- Play with a friend on the same device, each in turn. 
*** HD GRAPHICS *** 
Easy to use, the game is very fast and responsive, with card animation for a more realistic gameplay, and hd graphics.
Two visual themes available. 
*** AN HIGH-LEVEL ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE *** 
Your opponents and teammates are simulated by an high-level artificial intelligence, that knows the common strategies used in french belote card game. Therefore the game is very realistic, close to game with real players, and the challenge is high. 
*** A CUSTOMIZABLE APPLICATION *** 
- Many options to customize the rules. 
- Change the player's name. 
- Change the speed of the game. 
- Play automatically.
- Direction on play.
- Visual theme.
- And many more...
*** AN APPLICATION THAT WILL MAKE YOU BECOME BETTER *** 
A section with statistics is included in the application, allowing you to monitor the evolution of our performances. And you can distinguish yourself thanks to Game Center Achievements and Leaderboards. 
For beginners, rules of French Belote are also included into the application. 
Finally, you can at the end of the round see all the tricks, and replay the round if you want, to train and try new strategies. 
For any question regarding the application : support.belote@eryodsoft.com 
Have fun playing Belote !

bluejetty:00168394:ios.name: Spider Stickman: Grand Hero
bluejetty:00168394:ios.summary: Spider Hero gangster rope crime" is an action-packed mobile game that combines elements of superhero abilities, stickman-style characters, and a thrilling open-world environment. In this game, players take on the role of a courageous stickm
bluejetty:00168394:ios.description:
Spider Hero gangster rope crime" is an action-packed mobile game that combines elements of superhero abilities, stickman-style characters, and a thrilling open-world environment. In this game, players take on the role of a courageous stickman hero with extraordinary powers, similar to Spider-Man, swinging through the city using ropes and defeating criminals to save innocent civilians.
Key features:
Superhero Abilities: As the Miami Spider Stickman Rope hero, players possess incredible superpowers, such as shooting web ropes like Spider-Man, allowing them to swing between buildings, leap across rooftops, and explore the city with ease.
Open-World City: The game world is an expansive and immersive open city environment, teeming with criminal activity and various challenges. Players can freely roam around the city, uncovering missions and discovering hidden secrets.
Crime-Fighting Missions: Throughout the city, players encounter various criminal activities and nefarious villains that they must thwart. These missions involve rescuing hostages, stopping bank robberies, breaking up gang fights, and more.
Upgrades and Customization: Players can earn in-game currency or rewards by completing missions successfully, which can be used to upgrade the hero's abilities, unlock new powers, and customize the appearance of the stickman hero.
Dynamic Combat System: Engaging in combat against criminals is fast-paced and action-packed. Players can utilize their superhero abilities and quick reflexes to take down enemies with epic combos and special moves.
Side Quests and Challenges: Besides the main storyline, there are numerous side quests and challenges scattered throughout the city. These optional missions offer additional rewards and provide an opportunity to test the hero's skills to the limit.
Interactive Environment: The city battle environment is highly interactive, allowing players to interact with objects, and vehicles. This adds depth to the gameplay and enhances the overall spider gaming experience.
Stunning stick fight Graphics and Visual Effects: "Miami Spider Stickman Rope hero" boasts high-quality graphics and impressive visual effects, making the superhero action and swinging mechanics feel fluid and exhilarating.
The stickman game offers an exciting blend of exploration, superhero abilities, and crime-fighting action, creating an addictive experience

• Sign in securely with Touch ID and Face ID (on supported devices).

• Deposit checks without the need to visit a branch or ATM.
• View cleared check images and mobile deposit check images.
• Customize account nicknames, preferences, and alerts.
• Search transactions to quickly and easily find a specific transaction without endless scrolling.
• View eStatements.

• Add entitled users and set and control their access rights and limits.
• Generate ACH payments, such as payroll. (ACH Agreement required prior to using ACH payment services.)

Deceptively simple. Infinitely complex. LYNE is a minimalist puzzle game that will knot your brain as it calms your soul.

"I highly recommend grabbing LYNE in the App Store if you’re a fan of relaxing puzzle games for your iOS device." - AppAdvice, 5/5

- Finalist at IndieCade 2014
- Best Puzzle Game, Tabby Awards 2014
- Finalist for Audio Design at Freeplay 2013
- Honorable Mention for Design at Freeplay 2013
“The whole thing is a gentle puzzle game that’s thoroughly enjoyable, which is rare because the majority of puzzle games frustrate the hell out of me.” - IndieStatik.com

bluejetty:00115145:ios.description:
How often have you searched for “paraphrasing tool iOS”, “AI detector proof text”, “human-like rewriter”, or “AI-safe writing app”? Natural Write delivers.
Welcome to Natural Write—the advanced paraphrase and rewording app that helps you rephrase sentences, rewrite paragraphs, and bypass AI detectors, while keeping your text polished and natural.
Key Features
1. Intelligent Paraphrasing & Rewriting
Rewrite any sentence, paragraph, or essay in fresh, natural language.
Supported queries that users often search: “reword my text”, “paraphrase sentences”, “rewrite essay”, “human-like paraphrase”
Multiple rewrite modes: Light, Balanced, Deep (choose the level of change you need)
2. Built-In AI Detector Check
Instantly detect AI-generated phrasing in your text.
Be one step ahead with “AI detector proofing” and “human-like authenticity check.”
Edit your output until it passes the detector with just a tap.
3. Bypass & Pass AI Detectors
“Bypass AI detection” is a common search—and Natural Write does exactly that.
The app adjusts rewriting style so your text reads as naturally as possible, helping it pass popular AI detectors.
4. Save & Organize Your Work
Save rewritten drafts under custom project or assignment names.
Track versions: “paraphrase history”, “rewrite logs”, “save rewritten text” features help streamline your workflow.
5. Smart Suggestions & Tone Control
Need a more formal rewrite or friendlier tone? Toggle settings like “formal tone”, “casual tone”, or “neutral tone.”
Often searched phrases like “make it sound human”, “less robotic tone”, “natural writing voice” are fully supported.
6. Quick Export & Share
Copy to clipboard or share directly to Mail, Notes, or Messages.
Supports export options like “Copy plain text”, “Share to other apps”, “Export PDF/Doc”.
7. Lightweight, Secure & Ad-Free
No account needed.
Your data stays on your device.
Secure, ad-free writing experience.
Why Users Love Natural Write
“I needed a way to pass AI detectors while paraphrasing my thesis. Natural Write’s rewrite modes made it sound completely human-written.”
“This is the best paraphrasing app for iOS I’ve used. The built-in AI detection tool saved me from accidental AI-style text.”
Privacy Policy: https://apps.archura.co/natural-write/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://apps.archura.co/natural-write/terms-of-service
