bluejetty:00092404:ios.description:
Manage The Cleaning Authority’s house cleaning services using the MyTCA app on your mobile device. 
The MyTCA app allows customers to have complete access and control of their cleaning services including:
- Secure account information
- Access to Consumer Newsletter and Blogs, including helpful deep cleaning and organization tips
- Details on upcoming as well as past cleanings, including rooms to be cleaned, additional cleaning requirements, current rotation, and updated pricing
- Payment options through wallet using credit card or e-check
- Automatic or custom tipping
- Notifications including reminders, updates and cleaning promotions
- Opportunity for free house and apartment cleanings through our Refer a Friend program
The Cleaning Authority has been providing house cleaning services for more than 25 years and is widely recognized for a commitment to serving customers and using environment-friendly cleaning supplies. TCA has a history of excellence and dedication to our clients through providing professional and high-quality residential cleaning services across The US and Canada.
Your satisfaction is 100% guaranteed. We perform ongoing inspections to ensure our high standards are maintained. Our exclusive Detail-Clean Rotation System begins by giving your home a Detail-Clean within the first two cleans. On the first clean, we Detail-Clean your kitchen and bathrooms and then deep clean the rest of your home. On the second clean, we Detail-Clean the sleeping and living areas and thoroughly clean the rest of your home. We then follow with a system that maintains a detailed level of clean throughout your home.
Our company is fully bonded and insured, which means you can have peace of mind when you hire us as your professional cleaning company. Helping our customers feel confident in our services is very important to us, which is why we're committed to taking every step necessary to make sure they feel good about choosing The Cleaning Authority.
Every individual hired at a franchise location of The Cleaning Authority goes through a thorough screening process, and then is trained in every aspect of our home cleaning services. This ensures high-quality service every time.
We participate in the communities in which we are located through The Cleaning Authority CARES by fighting against hunger. Helping to provide food is a fundamental component of taking care of others, but it’s not something we can do alone. Our customers, like you, have been critical to our effort.

bluejetty:00162284:ios.description:
Do you drink enough water? Do you forget drinking water regularly?
This beautiful water reminder app will change that. 
Follow your daily water consumption with a filled virtual aquarium. It has never been that much fun to reach your target. Get reminders to drink water and with every sip a fish dances for you! Over time, new fish will be added to motivate you further.
This water tracker app can be easily adapted to your needs and shows you all the past consumption in the water diary. So there’s no excuse for not keeping your water budget under control. Let's go and drink water! Please consult a doctor to define your personal water drink target.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
- Subscribe for access to PRO features
* No ads
* Apple Watch Integration
* iCloud Backup & Sync between multiple devices
* Allow to give names to drink types
* Configure which fish type can swim in the aquarium
* 15+ fish can swim at the same time
* Option to make all fish look like the main fish
* Configure when to receive a present
* Option to unlock all fish immediately
* Option to unlock all background immediately 
* Additional notification sounds
* Additional drink type images
- Both Monthly Subscription and Yearly Subscription are available
- 7 days Free trial subscription is automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the renewal
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the same price
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

bluejetty:00119876:ios.name: Animal Math Games School Ed
bluejetty:00119876:ios.summary:
TEACHER DESIGNED MATH LESSON PRACTICE FOR Pre-K TO 2nd GRADE
Animal Math School Edition is created by classroom teachers and tested with real students to build strong number sense through play. Perfect for centers, small-group instruction,
bluejetty:00119876:ios.description:
TEACHER DESIGNED MATH LESSON PRACTICE FOR Pre-K TO 2nd GRADE
Animal Math School Edition is created by classroom teachers and tested with real students to build strong number sense through play. Perfect for centers, small-group instruction, intervention, homeschool, and independent practice, it supports the foundational skills taught in Pre-K, Kindergarten, 1st Grade, and 2nd Grade.
WHY TEACHERS & FAMILIES CHOOSE THE SCHOOL EDITION
• Classroom-ready: distraction-free experience designed for elementary learners
• Clear, kid-friendly instructions and visual models
• Short, replayable activities for skill fluency and confidence
• Progressive difficulty across grades for easy differentiation
• Designed for iPad & iPhone; great for school or home use
• Child-safe. No ads. No links. No complicated menus
PRE-K SKILLS (Early Learning & Readiness)
• Pattern recognition (AB/ABB/ABC)
• Shapes & colors
• Compare sizes: bigger/smaller
• Number identification
• Counting (objects & sets)
• Most & least
• Gentle math introduction
KINDERGARTEN SKILLS (Number Sense & Basics)
• Pre-K review for mastery
• Counting to higher numbers
• Number order/Cardinality
• Building numbers
• First & last
• Greatest & least
• Skip counting
• Addition & subtraction within 10
• Basic equations with visuals
• Picture models & ten-frames
• All prior skills at a higher difficulty
1ST GRADE SKILLS (Fluency & Reasoning)
• Kindergarten review for fluency
• Addition & subtraction within 20
• True/False equation checks
• Compare numbers: greater than, less than, equal to
• Even & odd
• Number sentences
• Word problems (read-to-solve)
• Advanced equations and missing numbers
• All prior skills at a higher difficulty
2ND GRADE SKILLS (Place Value & Multi-Step Thinking)
• 1st grade review for confidence
• Compare numbers: greater than, less than, or equal to
• Even & odd (reason with pairs)
• Place value (ones, tens, hundreds)
• Which sign is missing form the equation?
• Build the equation from models
• Complex equations & multi-step practice
• Intro to algebraic thinking
• All prior skills at a higher difficulty
BUILT FOR REAL CLASSROOMS
Animal Math School Edition focuses on essential concepts aligned with current state standards and modern, research-based teaching frameworks—including counting & cardinality, operations & algebraic thinking, and base-ten place value. Activities emphasize visual math, concrete models, and math talk to help learners explain their thinking.
GREAT FOR
• Pre-K, Kindergarten, 1st Grade, 2nd Grade
• Math centers, rotations, and stations
• RTI/MTSS, special education, and enrichment
• Homeschool and after-school practice
Thank you teachers for all you do!

bluejetty:00088871:ios.description:
# Filebar
Filebar is a modern multimedia player that offers video player, music player, cloud services and file management features.
## Main features
### Video player
Filebar offers a powerful video player that allows you to play more video formats, including standard MP4, M4V and MOV, plus MKV, AVI, WMV, FLV, OMG, OGV, 3GP, RMVB and more. You can browse and play videos from your mac, pc, NAS, FTP, and also support playing videos from media servers (such as Emby/Plex/Jellyfin media server), and you can also play videos from cloud services.
### Music Player
Filebar provides a nice local music player for playing local and cloud music, supported audio formats are MP3/M4A/FLAC.
### Cloud Services
Cloud services are another core feature of Filebar. With Filebar you can easily manage cloud services, including creating folders/deleting/playing/batch renaming/viewing information. It also provides support for remote protocols. The supported protocols are SMB, WebDAV, Synology, FTP, SFTP.
### File Management
Filebar also provides a file manager. You can manage your local and remote files: move, delete, edit, copy, upload, batch rename, etc.
## Customer Support
Feel free to contact us if your have any suggestions or ideas.
- Website: https://fileball.app
- Email: filebox.app@outlook.com

FlyteHealth delivers comprehensive, clinically-guided care for conditions along the cardio-kidney-metabolic continuum — including prediabetes, hypertension, high cholesterol, and chronic weight-related conditions — all from the comfort of home.
Unlike generic wellness apps, FlyteHealth pairs you with a dedicated care team of board-certified physicians and registered dietitians who design a treatment plan around your full health picture. Your team monitors your progress, adjusts your care plan as you improve, and is there when you need them - no waiting rooms, no commute, no time off work.
What's included:
- Secure video visits and messaging with your care team
- Personalized nutrition guidance from a registered dietitian
- Weight, food, and activity tracking
- Optional remote monitoring devices (smart scale and blood pressure cuff)
- Lab results, health assessments, and clinical notes in one place
- Medication management and support accessing affordable prescriptions
- Coaching and educational content to build habits that last
This app is available to patients enrolled in a FlyteHealth program through their employer or health plan.

bluejetty:00152417:ios.description:
Tired of replaying conversations in your head, freezing in meetings, or losing your words mid-sentence?
Wellspoken is your AI articulation coach and speech coach. Speak confidently and clearly in interviews, meetings, presentations, and everyday conversations. Built on cognitive science, it trains the real barriers to clear communication in just 5 minutes a day.
Whether you're preparing for a mock interview, speaking up in meetings, delivering a presentation, pitching investors, or trying to stop rambling in everyday conversations, Wellspoken builds the speaking skills you've always wanted.
WHAT YOU'LL IMPROVE
• Interview answers. Practice mock interviews, master the STAR method for behavioral interviews, and answer interview questions confidently on the spot
• Public speaking and toastmasters prep. Speak with charisma, command attention, eliminate stage fright
• Filler words. Eliminate "um," "uh," and "like" with real-time AI feedback
• Articulation and clarity. Sharper delivery that lands every word
• Meeting confidence. Speak up, get to the point, stop overexplaining
• Presentation skills. Pace, pauses, and a "safe base" of professional transition phrases
• Sales pitches and elevator pitches. High-stakes communication that actually closes
• Charisma and executive presence. Sound like the most articulate person in the room
HOW IT WORKS
• Multiple practice modes including mock interviews, meeting roleplay, impromptu speaking, and conversation drills
• AI speech analysis identifies exactly where your delivery breaks down: filler rate, pace, clarity, hedging
• The Wellspoken Index gives you a measurable score so you can track your communication skills over time
• Lexicon Flash gives you instant access to precise words, the vocabulary you know but can't find under pressure
• Daily 60: a 60-second daily practice that builds your "safe base" of professional phrases
• Filler Eliminator drills target your specific patterns of "um," "uh," "like," and other filler words
REAL USE CASES OUR USERS IMPROVE FASTEST AT
• Job interviews, behavioral interview prep, STAR method, mock interview practice
• Workplace meetings, stakeholder communication, manager conversations
• Sales pitches, elevator pitches, board presentations
• Difficult conversations and conflict communication
• Public speaking, toastmasters preparation, debate, panel discussions
• Building charisma and executive presence in professional settings
• Dating, networking, and small talk that doesn't feel awkward
• Daily conversations where you want to sound more articulate and confident
Full access to all features requires an active Wellspoken subscription.
Built on cognitive science research into speech production and skill acquisition. Wellspoken targets the proven systems that help you find words and speak clearly under pressure, the same systems used by communication coaches, executive presence trainers, and speech therapists.
Join thousands improving their communication skills, interview performance, meeting confidence, presentation delivery, articulation, and charisma every day.
Terms of Use: https://wellspoken.me/terms
Privacy Policy: https://wellspoken.me/privacy

Embark on a personalized path with the Women's Bible app, designed to cater to the spiritual needs and daily challenges of women everywhere. Dive into over 50 translations of the Bible, craft personal prayers, find Bible quotes that resonate with your life moments, and receive personalized notifications with verses that uplift and inspire. Download today and start your journey of faith and discovery.
Women around the globe read, share, and find inspiration in the Scriptures through Women's Bible, enriching their faith and finding solace in God's Word.
Customize your experience with Women's Bible to suit your spiritual journey. Enjoy full online access or download your preferred versions and translations for offline devotion.
Grow closer to God and strengthen bonds with your loved ones through Women's Bible. Engage in meaningful conversations about Scripture and nurture deeper connections.

Organize your prayers with prayer cards.
Easily create lists for your prayer intentions.
Keep your prayers private or share them with your community.

Choose from over 50 Bible versions in more than 10 languages.
Access translations like Synodal (SYNO), New Russian Translation (NRT), and others tailored for a more personal understanding.
Enjoy reading the Bible offline with selected translations.
Study the Bible:
Discover plans designed for women, including "Bible in One Year" and special devotionals.
Utilize a keyword-based Bible search to find passages relevant to your life.
Receive personalized revelations:
Generate Bible quotes that speak to your heart and share them with friends.
Customize Women's Bible for your needs:
Adjust background colors for a comfortable reading experience.
Highlight verses, add bookmarks, and share inspirational passages with friends.
Keep personal or public notes and synchronize everything across devices with a free Women's Bible account.
Track your spiritual journey through your reading history.
Connect with Women's Bible:
Directly access customer support from the app.
Join the Women's Bible community on social networks.
Stay informed with the latest updates on our blog.

Pocket Prep will help you feel confident and prepared for test day.
- 1,500 NCLEX-RN Practice Questions: Expert-written, exam-like questions with detailed explanations, including textbook references.
- 2 NCLEX-RN Mock Exams: Simulate the test day experience with a full-length NCLEX-RN mock test to help build your confidence and readiness.
- A Variety of Study Modes: Tailor your NCLEX-RN study sessions with quiz modes like Quick 10, Level Up, and Weakest Subject. 
- Performance Analytics: Track your progress, identify weak areas, and compare your scores with your peers.
Begin Your NCLEX-RN Certification Journey for FREE*
Try for free and access 35* free NCLEX-RN practice questions and 3 study modes – Question of the Day, Quick 10, and Timed Quiz.
Upgrade to Premium for:
- All 1,500 NCLEX-RN practice questions

- Our Pass Guarantee

bluejetty:00126112:ios.description:
O Meu Wi-Fi Intelbras, aplicativo exclusivo para a linha Wi-Force e compatível com os roteadores W4-300F, W4-300S, W5-1200F, GF 1200, W5-1200G, W5-1200GS, W5-2100G, W6-1500, Twibi Force Plug e Twibi Force AX foi desenvolvido para você ter o controle da sua rede na palma da mão, de forma simples e intuitiva
Com ele você consegue configurar seu novo roteador, visualizar todos os dispositivos conectados na sua rede, verificar em tempo real o consumo de velocidade de internet, bloquear acessos, controlar o uso da banda disponível, criar novas redes Wi-Fi, compartilhar de forma fácil o acesso Wi-Fi, por exemplo com suas visitas, além de várias outras possibilidades. 
Como facilidade exclusiva para provedores de internet, através do Remotize é possível definir quais funcionalidades os assinantes podem ter acesso via app. 
As principais funcionalidades do app Meu Wi-Fi são: 
» Assistente de instalação 
» Configurações da conexão com a internet 
» Configurações da rede local (LAN) 
» Configurações da rede Wi-Fi
» Configurações de UPnP e servidor DHCP 
» Atualização de firmware 
» Gerenciamento da rede InMesh
Notas importantes: 
» Verifique se o seu roteador está com a última atualização de firmware. Caso não esteja, faça o download no nosso site e realize a atualização, ou utilize a atualização automática oferecida ao acessar a interface web do roteador (desde que conectado à internet). 
» O aplicativo Meu Wi-Fi Intelbras pode ser usado também remotamente para gerenciar sua rede, porém, o primeiro acesso e associação ao seu roteador devem ser feitos com seu smartphone conectado localmente na sua rede.

bluejetty:00018937:ios.description:
Experience the ultimate bubble popping joy.
Welcome back to Bubble Elf 2, the classic bubble shooter puzzle that will soothe your mind and fill your daily breaks with colorful fun. Precise aiming, clever color-matching, and vibrant bubble explosions are all here to help you escape the daily grind and find your Zen.
Aim Precisely & Shoot Strategically
Take control of your magical launcher. Aim at the target and shoot to pop & clear all the bubbles from the board. Find the satisfying rhythm of precise shots as you clear tricky formations and progress through thousands of stages. Simple for everyone to learn, yet full of strategic depth for puzzle masters.
A Magical Rescue Mission
Be the hero in a world full of wonder! Aim and shoot to save adorable elves trapped within the bubble mazes. Your strategy and clever thinking make a real difference to their magical world. It’s a mission full of mission and purpose that keeps you coming back for more.
Satisfying Feel & Effects
Feel the silky-smooth rhythm of every single blast. With delightful animation effects and calming sounds, every popped bubble brings a satisfying sensation of calm and achievement. It's the casual puzzle game for a quiet moment of relaxation.
Features to Explore in Bubble Elf 2:
2700+ Mesmerizing Levels: Discover a vast world of puzzles, from lighthearted stages to challenging levels that will test your skill. Every chapter brings a new adventure!
Powerful Magic Boosters: Use magical items like Fireballs, Rainbow Bubbles, and Sun Bubbles to clear difficult puzzle stages with powerful combos.
Special Rewards: Keep your winning streak going to earn more special daily rewards! The more you win, the more magical props you collect.
A Daily Companion: A complete experience focused entirely on your entertainment, anytime.
Whether you need a short daily break, a quiet moment of brain training, or just some relaxing puzzle fun, Bubble Elf 2 is your perfect magical companion.
Start your magical bubble shooter journey today and let the fun burst!

bluejetty:00168504:ios.description:
Play Tarot online for free! One of the best strategic multiplayer card games!
Our free Tarot game is usually played by 3, 4, or 5 players using the traditional deck for Tarot with 78 cards. Play online Tarot for free with official rules, always find a skilled player to compete with and sharpen your strategic skills!
Join us at Tarot - Fun & Friends and be at the heart of France's the oldest strategic card game community. Get connected to thousands of French tarot players!
The app is intuitive and easy to use - turning you into a Tarot master in no time!
THE BEST FEATURES AT GLANCE:

bluejetty:00121597:ios.name: Ludo Neo-Classic
bluejetty:00121597:ios.summary: The first ever Nepali variant of Ludo game available for mobile. It has both classic and new modern design + Nepali/Indian local rules along with international rules. Lots of options/rules for customization according to your need is possibl
bluejetty:00121597:ios.description:
The first ever Nepali variant of Ludo game available for mobile. It has both classic and new modern design + Nepali/Indian local rules along with international rules. Lots of options/rules for customization according to your need is possible. Hope you enjoy playing it ;).
Features:
1. Added rules/options which are played and popular in Nepal: 
 i) Option to show safe block(square) which is represented by star icon
 ii) Option to get another turn on both dice number 1 (Pot) and 6 (Chhakka)
 iii) 3 consecutive rolls of 1 kills one own playing coin
 iv) 3 consecutive rolls of 6 brings a coin out if all coins are in the yard
 v) All the rules are optional so you can play both international version or Nepali version or your own customized version according to your desire
2. Classic sketch marks design with wooden or white board
3. New modern design with wooden or white board
4. Option to choose the dice number (1 or 6) which will start the token(coin)
4. Option to choose the number of coins to be played (from 1 to 4)
5. Dice changing color according to color of actual player on turn
6. Variety of rules to meet your own taste of gaming experience
7. Multiplayer in the same device (up to 4 player)
8. Play against CPU
9. User can leave the game if he doesn't want to play during the game play.
10. Game play progress is saved automatically, you can resume the game later even after app is closed
11. Barrier feature (also known as Joint token) is also available

bluejetty:00145450:ios.description:
Email, contacts, and calendars made better
Fastmail gives you full control of your communication, with speed, privacy, and tools that work the way you do.
The New York Times says:
”If you want something easy to use that isn’t tied to one of the big tech giants, Fastmail is a great option.”
Do more with email
• Stay connected anywhere – Read, draft, and search offline.
• Powerful search – Find anything fast, even inside attachments. Plus, use the Search Refinement Toolbar to quickly add, remove, or adjust filters.
• Declutter your inbox – Snooze emails, mute threads, block spam, and unsubscribe easily, and set up rules to automate your flow.
• Stay organised your way – Use folders or labels to keep things tidy, and categorize messages without opening them.
• Work smarter – Schedule or undo send, add private memos, set VIP-only notifications, and resize images in the compose window.
• Custom swipes – Quickly archive, delete, or take other actions with up to four swipe gestures. Your preferences stay consistent across devices.
• Easy navigation – One-tap access to mail, calendar, contacts, and settings. Customize the toolbar in Display Options, or hide it altogether.
• Faster inbox actions – Select messages by tapping avatars, or using a two-finger swipe for faster multi-select.
Smarter calendars
• Plan together – Share calendars with family or teams.
• Sync seamlessly – Works with Google, iCloud, and more.
• Always in sync – Updates instantly across devices, with full time-zone support.
Connected contacts
• Shared or private address books – Keep context from recent conversations and meetings.
Why Fastmail?
• Privacy first – No ads, no tracking, no selling your data. It’s your data, not ours.
• Secure and trusted – Robust encryption of your data both in transit and at rest. Passkeys and 2FA keep your email private and safe.
• No lock-in – Over 20 years delivering better email. People stay because it’s better, not because it’s hard to leave.
• Real support – 24/7 online help from real people, no chatbots.
• Migrate in minutes – Move mail, contacts, and calendars from your old provider in minutes.
Better for everyone – Fastmail supports open standards, keeping email private and usable for all.

bluejetty:00137215:android.description:
PETS ON THE LOOSE!
Run, dash, slide, and jump your way through forest treetops, redrock canyons, and other challenging terrain! Collect dozens of pets, complete daily missions, and unlock tons of fun goodies. Welcome to Dash Tag, the best endless runner game! Choose your favorite pet and get ready to run with your friends and evade capture by Misha!
• Collect dozens of rare and unique pets
• Play as every pet you collect
• Unlock power-ups, outfits, and stats
• Speed through levels in pet cars
• Endless runner with new missions every day
• Free to play
• Easy to learn
Use the coins and emeralds you collect to purchase loads of upgrades like costumes, power-ups, and even pet cars! The farther you run, the more you collect. And the more you collect, the more fun you'll have!
So whether you prefer to scamper, scurry, or scuttle, join the fun of this amazing pet adventure today!

bluejetty:00065680:ios.name: Ricette Bimby
bluejetty:00065680:ios.summary:
Ricette per Bimby by Ricette MIX è un ricettario di oltre 10.000 ricette realizzabili con Bimby, monsieur cuisine, Cookeo e altri robot da cucina . 
Questa app è totalmente gratuita, tutte le ricette al suo interno sono consultabili gratui
bluejetty:00065680:ios.description:
Ricette per Bimby by Ricette MIX è un ricettario di oltre 10.000 ricette realizzabili con Bimby, monsieur cuisine, Cookeo e altri robot da cucina . 
Questa app è totalmente gratuita, tutte le ricette al suo interno sono consultabili gratuitamente e senza nessuna limitazione.
Tutte le ricette presenti in questo ricettario sono state accuratamente organizzate e catalogate per essere consultate velocemente per:
tipologia di piatto: primo, secondo, contorno, ecc...
evento speciale: Natale, Pasqua, capodanno, ecc...
caratteristiche del piatto: vegan, senza glutine, senza cottura, regionali, ecc...
Un potente motore di ricerca interno consente di cercare rapidamente ricette tramite nome o ingredienti. Cercare una ricetta per Bimby non è mai stato così facile!
Ogni ricetta è formata da una pratica scheda composta da: foto, ingredienti, tempo di preparazione, quantità, difficoltà e guida passo passo delle azioni da svolgere con il Bimby.
Per ogni ricetta è possibile interagire con gli utenti della community commentando e condividendo esperienze e foto tramite account Facebook o Google.
Una pratica gestione delle Ricette Preferite permette di consultare rapidamente il proprio segnalibri di ricette.
Hai una ricetta di cui sei particolarmente orgogliosa? Condividila con la community attraverso l’apposita sezione “Invia ricetta”. Una procedura passo passo ti guiderà attraverso l’inserimento di tutti i campi e la ricetta potrà essere disponibile a tutti per la consultazione.
Tutte le ricette presenti in questa app sono consultabili anche tramite il sito www.ricetteperbimby.it
Necessita di una connessione ad internet per funzionare.

bluejetty:00165354:ios.description:
Welcome to Anna's Merge adventure!
Here is an island with a mysterious civilization and merging magic, where you can meet new friends, save lost family members and create your own island with Anna!
To find the secrets hidden behind the mists and learn the stories inside the landscape. Come and experience this puzzle and casual Merging game!
Merging Magic:
You can use the merging magic to merge 3 identical items to get 1 advanced item, or merge 5 identical items to get 2 advanced items.
Adventure:
Anna's family is stranded on a mysterious island because of a tsunami. Here Anna makes new friends and works with them to find her missing family. What magical experiences will she have, and what new challenges will she encounter?
Mysterious characters:
Meet the mysterious characters under the mysterious civilization, and with their help change the whole island!
Tasty Recipes:
Help the characters complete delicious recipes to get mysterious rewards that can be used to explore unknown areas of the island.
What kind of food are they good at? Wait for you to discover!
Rich gameplay experience:
In this mysterious island adventure, you will get a variety of treasure chests, mine deposits with mysterious powers, and harvest new resources.
There are hundreds of game items waiting for you to match, merge, combine and build, and more mysterious buildings to discover!

bluejetty:00036879:ios.description:
Transform your smartphone into a powerful broadcasting tool with our innovative app, designed to seamlessly integrate your mobile device into any professional video production setup. Ideal for journalists, content creators, and live event broadcasters, our app turns your smartphone into an HD IP camera, delivering high-quality video streams directly to OBS, NDI systems, and other NDI-compatible software or hardware.
Key Features:
Real-Time NDI Streaming: Convert your phone’s camera into a high-quality NDI camera, enabling real-time video streaming over local networks with minimal latency.
Versatile Compatibility: Whether you're using OBS Camera for live streaming, incorporating footage into Larix Broadcaster setups, or managing streams with IP Cam Controller, our app ensures compatibility and ease of integration.
Advanced Capture Technologies: Experience professional-grade capture NDI with features tailored for both NDI camera systems and standard IP webcam functionalities.
High Definition Streaming: Supports HD-IPCam standards and Webcams HD to deliver crystal-clear video content, ensuring your streams look professional on all broadcasting platforms.
Efficient Local Network Use: Optimized for IPCam Lite environments and designed to work flawlessly in limited bandwidth scenarios, providing a robust solution for IP camera streaming.
User-Friendly Interface: Simple setup and an intuitive user interface allow you to start streaming instantly, turning your device into an IP webcam or a comprehensive IP cam controller with just a few taps.
This app is perfect for users looking to extend the capabilities of their mobile devices, offering a portable, high-quality video solution that integrates smoothly with existing broadcasting technologies. Whether it's streaming a live concert, reporting from the field, or creating content from your home studio, our app ensures your video captures are seamless and professional.
This app is using the standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA) https://www.apple.com/legal/ internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

This app does NOT provide an official USGA or R&A handicap index. USGA is a registered trademark of the U.S. Golf Association, which is the exclusive owner and licensor of its trademarks and service marks.
The Simple Way to Run Your Golf League
Built for golfers, league managers, and group organizers, this app makes it easy to track handicaps, manage weekly play, and share results — all in one place.
From score posting to tee sheets, everything is designed to be fast, accurate, and effortless.
Why You’ll Love It
• Unlimited Golfers
Manage handicaps and scores for as many players as you need — perfect for leagues and regular groups.
• Modern Handicap Index Calculations
Automatically calculate Handicap Index using current rules, so you’re always up to date.
• Powerful Tee Sheet Builder
Create and share professional tee sheets:
– Assign golfers by tee
– Set pace of play
– Adjust group sizes
– Reorder players easily
– Export clean, shareable PDFs
• Automatic 9-Hole Score Combining
Post 9-hole rounds and let the app combine them seamlessly into full-score differentials.
• 10s of Thousands of Courses
Quickly search and select courses with accurate tee ratings and slope values.
• Course Handicap & Net Double Bogey Guidance
Instantly calculate course handicap and get max score guidance for correct posting.
• Fast Multi-Player Score Entry
Post scores quickly for your entire group in just a few taps.
• Secure Backup & Sync
Keep your data safe with secure server backup and easy restore.
• Flexible Course Editing
Add or edit course and tee information anytime.
• Complete History Tracking
View full score and handicap history over time for every golfer.
• New League Handicap Options
Choose between traditional World Handicap rules or a Short League option built for shorter seasons, helping golfers establish handicaps faster.
Whether you’re running a competitive league or organizing a weekly foursome, this app gives you everything you need to keep play fair, organized, and simple.
Download today and make managing your golf league effortless.
Note: Hole-by-hole scores aren’t required. Please enter your adjusted (maxed-out) score for the round instead of the gross total.
Terms of the in-app purchases:
Golf Handicap Annual Membership with advanced handicap tracking features can be purchased from Apple App Store. Payment for in-app upgrades will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the original subscription amount. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are located at: http://www.infotalkcorporation.com/privacypolicy.html

bluejetty:00139633:ios.summary:
Capture your day with a few words, a photo, and how you felt. My Wonderful Days is a personal diary for iPhone and iPad that makes everyday moments worth coming back to.
A quiet morning. A great trip. Something you're grateful for. You don
bluejetty:00139633:ios.description:
Capture your day with a few words, a photo, and how you felt. My Wonderful Days is a personal diary for iPhone and iPad that makes everyday moments worth coming back to.
A quiet morning. A great trip. Something you're grateful for. You don't need a long story to keep a meaningful journal. Pick a face for your mood, write as much or as little as you like, and make the page your own.
MAKE WRITING A DAILY HABIT
- Set a reminder for a time that suits you.
- See your writing streak after three consecutive days.
- Enjoy the warmth of a paper diary, with page-turning sounds and pages that age as you revisit them.
KEEP MORE THAN WORDS
- Add photos and videos to your entries.
- Express yourself with stickers and text formatting, including bold, italic, underline, and highlight.
- Star the days you want to find again.
FIND YOUR MEMORIES
- Browse your journal by date and revisit memories with On This Day.
- Search for multiple words, then jump to highlighted matches in your entries.
- Filter by favorites or stickers, and sort by happiness or most viewed.
- Look back at your moods with reports and happiness graphs.
SEE YOUR STORY COME TOGETHER
- Reflection brings a month or year of your journal into a full-screen slideshow and a magazine-style story.
- Combine journal highlights with photos from the app or photos and videos from your Photo Library.
- Save or share a reflection as a PDF or long image. Videos appear as still images in exports.
KEEP YOUR JOURNAL CLOSE
- Lock the app with a passcode.
- Sync your entries between iPhone and iPad with iCloud.
- Export entries as PDFs or print them with AirPrint.
START WITH 14 ENTRIES
Try the app with up to 14 entries. You can always read and edit them. To keep adding entries, unlock the app with a one-time in-app purchase. A subscription is optional.
OPTIONAL SUPPORTER SUBSCRIPTION
The yearly supporter subscription helps fund ongoing development and also unlocks the app if you haven't already purchased the unlock.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
- Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: http://hahaint.com/terms
Privacy Policy: http://hahaint.com/privacy
Questions or feedback? Contact us at contact@hahaint.com

bluejetty:00062977:ios.name: Baby Adopter Galaxy
bluejetty:00062977:ios.summary:
Baby Adopter Galaxy is a babysitting, baby care and dress-up game set on a journey through space. Choose from four children and care for your baby as children and their parents travel aboard a spaceship.
Feed your baby when hungry, change
bluejetty:00062977:ios.description:
Baby Adopter Galaxy is a babysitting, baby care and dress-up game set on a journey through space. Choose from four children and care for your baby as children and their parents travel aboard a spaceship.
Feed your baby when hungry, change outfits and keep your child healthy. Maintain your baby's energy at 30 or higher while you earn points, collect items and explore the spaceship and Planet Base.
Earn and Spend Points
Earn points by feeding your baby, hunting for eggs and playing Planet Match. Spend your points on socks, clothes, hats, shoes, toys, space tools and items for game locations.
Karma Points
Karma reflects your overall game progress and player experience. Completing Planet Match levels adds to both your points and Karma.
Game Locations
Purchase all the available items to decorate and complete the Spaceship's Bedroom, Classroom, Lab, Control Center and Planet Base. Collecting all the toys and space tools is another goal of the game.
Egg Hunt and Mini-Creatures
Complete your collection of mini-creatures by finding and hatching eggs. Eggs appear randomly in different game locations. Each egg needs three cracks to hatch, with a waiting period between cracks. Once cracked, an egg stays in the same location so you can return to continue hatching it.
Planet Match
Complete all 100 levels in this match-3 puzzle adventure and earn more points and Karma for the main game.
Each level has an objective to finish within a limited number of moves: collect planet debris, break ice, do both, or bring down coins. Collected debris is converted into points in Baby Adopter Galaxy.
Match four planets in a row or column to create a Special Planet. Include it in a match to clear an entire row or column. Match five to create a Magic Planet, then swap it with a regular planet to clear every planet of that color.
Destroy planets under ice to break it, and destroy planets beside walls to remove the walls. Walls grow when no wall was destroyed on the previous turn.
Space Battle (iPhone)
Pilot a tiny spaceship and shoot asteroids and enemy ships in this space shooting mini-game.
Space Battle is available on iPhone and is not available on Mac.
VoiceOver
Baby Adopter Galaxy supports VoiceOver for blind and visually impaired players.
In Planet Match, swipe right to explore the grid, moving VoiceOver focus between planets. Double-tap the planet you want to move. Then double-tap a neighboring position to its left, right, above or below to try swapping the two planets.
Space Battle does not support VoiceOver.
Game Center
Complete locations to unlock achievements and compete on leaderboards.
In-App Purchases
Tap the yellow coin icon in game locations to buy points for faster progress in the game.
Note: The game works on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.
Baby Adopter is a registered trademark of x2line.

bluejetty:00091675:ios.description:
This app can scale and/or denoise images using various advanced on-device AI algorithms. Note that this app is not affiliated with the original waifu2x project.
Privacy is one of the top priorities of this app. Your files will never leave your device to be processed. Additionally, we don't collect any personal information because there are no ADs even if you only use free models. Therefore, if you encounter any problems, please send us a feedback email or create a GitHub issue so that we can work together to fix them.
Try additional models and custom models on your own images for free before you purchase!
Highlight features:
1. Unlimited number of imported images.
2. Supports both SRCNN and CUnet models from the original waifu2x project.
3. Supports Real-ESRGAN models for both illustrations and photos.
4. Supports Real-CUGAN models for anime illustrations. Also supports customizable intensity.
5. Supports Anime4K models for anime videos.
6. Supports custom Core ML models. Import any model to process images for your specific needs.
7. Custom scale modes. You have options to scale images up to 128x, 1.5x, fixed size and more.
8. Supports multiple ways of importing images: the album, files, folders, drag and drop, other apps, Shortcuts.
9. Supports images with alpha channel.
10. Multiple output formats: PNG, JPEG, HEIF, WebP.
11. Multiple processing backends. You can choose between highest quality or highest speed.
12. Write output images directly to an external path (including network drives like SMB).
13. End-to-end support for 16-bit color and color spaces. Color accuracy will not be compromised after processing.
14. Highly optimized RAM usage. You can easily produce images that don't even fit inside your device RAM.
15. Supports deleting or replacing original images if they come from the album.
16. Supports downscaling images before processing, which is useful while processing some photos.
Source code of core function is available on GitHub:
https://github.com/imxieyi/waifu2x-ios
Usage of images in screenshots is granted by the original author Kurumi:
https://twitter.com/0115_kurumi
The primary app icon is illustrated by Kapuru:
https://twitter.com/KaPuRu_0410

bluejetty:00146760:ios.name: ANACITY IN
bluejetty:00146760:ios.summary: Introducing ANACITY IN – a dynamic evolution of ApnaComplex! Unveiling a fresh brand identity, our app redefines community living with innovative features, seamless management, and enhanced user experience. Elevate your residential experien
bluejetty:00146760:ios.description:
Introducing ANACITY IN – a dynamic evolution of ApnaComplex! Unveiling a fresh brand identity, our app redefines community living with innovative features, seamless management, and enhanced user experience. Elevate your residential experience with ANACITY – where smart living meets modern convenience. ANACITY offers features that add convenience to the lives of both residents and the Management Committee. 
Using the ANACITY IN app, you can effortlessly perform the below actions: 
• Book a facility such as a tennis court, gym, clubhouse, party hall, etc. 
• Track vehicles entering the gated community. 
• Issue Gate Pass to your domestic help. 
• Book or order from local services. 
• Access Apartment Owners Discussion Forums and participate in discussions. This greatly helps reduce e-mail clutter. 
• Access Apartment Interest Groups to share interesting events, celebrations, stories, news, images with your neighbors. 
• Approve/Pre-approve visitors or guests at the apartment gate. 
• Inform expected visitors to the security. 
• Lock and unlock your vehicles from the app for additional security. 
• Raise Maintenance Complaints to the Staff along with pictures of the issue. 
• Scan the QR code assigned to each facility and raise complaints if the said 
facility is malfunctioning. This feature is unique to ANACITY. 
• View and pay dues. 
• Access Apartment Member Directory. 
• Track and Update Action Items of the Society Managing Committee. 
• Access Apartment Maintenance Staff details. 
• Switch between apartments for those who are part of multiple complexes. 
• Add new members to the application. Through the ANACITY application, residents of a community can receive automated alerts and notifications such as, 
• Alerts for School Bus pick up/drop of your child 
• Alerts for Guests/visitors to the flats 
• Alerts for domestic staff attendance 
• Alerts for important notices and meeting reminders 
• Automated reminders to pay maintenance dues. The above are only a handful of alerts and the application is designed to send many more such vital alerts. 
• The app also can be used by the maintenance staff to manage entire helpdesk operations. 
• Staff can log new complaints, and update/close existing complaints. 
• Take pictures of an issue before resolving and after resolving it and attach them to the complaints. 
• Record Readings of Utilities (such as Water Meters, Reticulated Gas, Energy 
Meters) digitally. 
• View Action Items assigned to them. Using ANACITY, society admins can: 
• Track key vitals of the society 
• Broadcast emergency notifications via mobile alerts and SMS to all owners 
/residents 
• Access financial statements of all flats. 
• Track complaints of all apartment residents 
• Post notices about key updates. Want to experience the power of smart living? 
Head over and install the application 
Visit https://www.anacity.com/in

More than just a PDF merger, our app is a full-featured PDF toolkit. With advanced PDF tools, light & dark modes, and secure file handling, it’s the only app you’ll need to manage all your PDF files efficiently. Fast, easy, and reliable!

- Split PDF Files – Extract only the pages you need and save them as a new PDF.
- Rearrange PDF Pages – Organize your documents by moving pages effortlessly.

- Lock & Unlock PDF – Protect your files with a password or unlock secured PDFs.

- Convert PDF to PNG – Extract high-quality images from your PDFs.
- Image to PDF – Turn JPG, PNG, or BMP images into PDF documents in seconds.
- BMP to PDF – Convert BMP files to PDFs with ease.
- History Section – Quickly access previously managed files.
- Light & Dark Mode – Switch modes to reduce eye strain and improve reading comfort.

- Students: Merge lecture notes, compress files, or create PDFs from scanned assignments.
- Professionals: Rearrange reports, delete unnecessary pages, or protect sensitive files.
- Everyday Users: Combine bills, receipts, certificates, and more into a single PDF for easy sharing.

- User-Friendly Interface – Simple navigation for everyone.

- Why Our App Stands Out

Are you tired of exploring the world alone? Do you crave the company of like-minded travelers who share your passion for adventure? Look no further than TripBFF, an app designed to connect you with travel friends, unlock exciting experiences, and create memories that will last a lifetime.
TripBFF is not just another travel app—it's your gateway to a community of solo travelers who are ready to embark on incredible journeys with you. Whether you're a solo traveler seeking friendships or looking to expand your circle, TripBFF has you covered.
With TripBFF, finding travel friends has never been easier. Simply create a profile highlighting your interests, travel preferences, and destination wishlist, and let the app's powerful algorithm do the rest. Discover fellow adventurers who share your wanderlust, connect with them, and embark on amazing trips together. Travel wrapped is awesome with TripBFF. Whether you're backpacking through Southeast Asia or exploring the cultural treasures of Europe, TripBFF helps you build genuine connections with like-minded individuals.
But that's not all—TripBFF is filled with travel tips and insights. With TripBFF you can do Travel Wrapped. Browse through lots of user-generated content, including travel guides, packing hacks, and insider recommendations. From hidden gems off the beaten path to must-try local cuisine, TripBFF's community is here to help you make the most of your adventures. No more need for Trip Advisor no more need for hostelworld .
Planning to study abroad or embark on a work exchange program or live as a digital nomad? With our interests feature, TripBFF is the perfect platform to connect with fellow travelers experiencing the same thing from around the world. Travel Wrapped with TripBFF is the best. Coordinate travel plans, share tips on navigating new cities, and form study groups or networking circles to maximize your international experience.
Stay connected with your travel friends and make group chats to discuss itineraries, share exciting updates, or coordinate meetups. The possibilities are endless when you have a global network of travel buddies at your fingertips. 
Don't let the fear of solo travel hold you back. Download TripBFF today and unlock a world of incredible adventures, unforgettable experiences, and lifelong friendships. Travel is better with friends, and TripBFF is here to make your journey extraordinary.

bluejetty:00174722:ios.description:
Your iPhone takes perfect photos. Hipstamatic® doesn't. That's the point. 
Hipstamatic is not a photo editor. It's a camera... the original analog film camera for iPhone, made since 2009.
——
SHOOT FIRST. EDIT NEVER.
Pick a lens. Pick a film. Shoot. Hipstamatic® applies the analog look before you press the shutter — exactly the way a real film camera works. No editing. No tweaking. No second-guessing. The photo is finished the moment you take it.
——
200+ LENSES. 200+ FILMS. EVERY ONE A REAL CAMERA.
Over 1,000 analog combinations across TinType, Instant, Classic Toy and more. Each one gives you grain, color shifts, light leaks and vignettes you can't fake and can't replicate anywhere else. None of them perfect. All of them honest. Don't want to choose? Shuffle, and let the camera surprise you.
——
NO ADS. NO TRACKING. NO ALGORITHM. EVER.
Hipstamatic® runs on members, not advertisers. No VC funding. No data harvesting. No feed deciding what you should look at. When you join, you're keeping an independent camera alive… One that's been here since before Instagram existed.
——
A SMALL, QUIET ROOM.
If you want it, there's a community of people who shoot the way you do. Chronological. No algorithm. No brand accounts. No promoted posts. No follower math. Just photographs people actually meant to make. And it's opt-in — if you only ever want a private camera, that's the whole app too.
——
FREE TO START. MORE LOOKS WITH MEMBERSHIP.
The camera is free. Join the Hipstamatic® Camera Club to open the whole shelf. Every lens, every film, every camera we've made in 15+ years and go as deep as you want to go. Your first month is on us.
——
P.S. Hipstamatic was Apple's very first App of the Year (2010). We just never stopped pointing the camera at something.

bluejetty:00175319:ios.description:
Keep up with the teams you care about with The Athletic app. Review sports news, scores and stats, and expert insights analysis for each league. Turn on notifications to get real time updates for basketball, football, soccer, hockey, baseball, and more. Get in depth with sports coverage when you can listen to exclusive podcasts and read breaking news stories on your favorite athletes and teams. 
Download today to stay up to date on your daily sports news. 
The Athletic Features:
EXCLUSIVE SPORTS NEWS, INSIGHTS, AND ANALYSIS
- Go deeper with in-depth, global coverage and exclusive sports news.
- Our award-winning newsroom of more than 400 sports journalists. 
- Get exclusive access to expert sports insights and analysis. 
- Explore deeply-reported long reads and exclusive sports interviews.
SPORTS SCORES AND STATS ON ALL MAJOR TEAMS AND LEAGUES
- Discover the top sports stories of the day, breaking news and live score updates, all from the biggest names in sports writing.
- Access exclusive coverage on professional and college teams across football, hockey, basketball, soccer and beyond,
- Find sports updates for the United States and international sports. 
- Follow your favorites so you never miss sports scores or stats.
UNMATCHED SPORTS PODCASTS:
- Follow and listen to a variety of sports podcasts on your favorite leagues
- Discover daily podcasts like “The Athletic Football Show”, “The Audible” and “No Dunks”.
CONNECTIONS: SPORTS EDITION
- Play The Athletic’s daily game for sports fans. 
- Group sports terms that share a common thread.
STAY UP TO DATE ON YOUR SPORTS:
- Keep track of which NFL teams are in contention for the playoffs and follow to see if the Eagles can remain on top.
- Catch all the MLB action with live scores, breaking news and in-depth coverage to see if the Dodgers can repeat their World Series win.
- Stay up to date on all NHL hockey scores, games and news for the Stanley Cup Defending Oilers.
- Don’t miss any NBA highlights and news from this upcoming season and see if the Thunder can defend their NBA Championship win.
- What school will reign supreme from March Madness to the NCAA Football Championships? Don’t miss a score or stat update.
- Stay updated on every swing from the PGA Tour to see who can stay in the lead.
- Who in the Big Six will triumph in the Premier League this year, and can Liverpool defend their title?
- Follow Argentina, Spain and France as they compete for the FIFA World Cup next summer.
- Stay up to speed on Formula 1, NASCAR, Indy Car, MotoGP and World Rally.

bluejetty:00168107:ios.description:
► A BATTLE OF WITS
Now THIS is a tower defense game! Not only will you have to defend your tower from enemy takeover, but you’ll need to do battle with your enemy’s army at the same time – keep your wits about you though, because this is no ordinary in-game opponent! The other tower is manned by a real live person, just like you, so get ready for hours of exciting strategy and tactical takeovers as you each draw your armies on the map and square up to do battle. Explore, conquer, but most importantly, have fun!
► ARMOR UP!
With each battle you’ll have a chance to explore new terrains and strategies – draw your army on the map, choosing which soldiers to send into battle and where, as you keep an eye on your opponent. As you wage war, you’ll get to explore a variety of locations while also building up your tower defenses at the end of each level. Between the real opponents and funky equipment (mammoth anyone?) that you can collect, you’re sure to love all of the unique features we’ve crammed into the game:
◾Real-time enemies – intense PvP fights await as you do battle with other gamers. Since you’re playing against real people, each level and battle will be exciting and new as you each try new tactics.
◾Strategy at play – thanks to the unique drawing mechanism, you can choose where you place your army so as best to conquer the enemy. Place them well at the start of the fight and then keep adding them to steamroll your opponent. Keep your wits about you though because your enemy is doing the same!
◾Diverse units – as you progress in the game you’ll keep unlocking exciting new soldiers and equipment that will serve to help you win the fight. Collect and use everything from infantry and archers to robots and ninjas! You’ll also have the chance to build up your own tower so that its defenses are top notch.
◾Exciting locations – in addition to fights and wars, explore this exciting and fun world, which is filled with all sorts of unique landscapes. Conquer them all in your quest to take over the world!
► A TOWER-IFIC STRATEGY GAME
With real opponents, the need for an ever-changing strategy, and the ability to conquer exciting lands, Draw Arena is sure to become your new favorite PvP tower defense game – download it today to get started winning! Along the way, don’t forget to build up your own bases and towers so that your opponents can’t conquer you easily, collect infantry, and build out your army with all manner of delightful equipment and of course, have some fun while you’re out there taking over the world!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00088264:ios.description:
Expand your planning horizons
Timestripe is a goal planner with flexible time frames. Plan your day, week, month, quarter, year, decade and lifetime side by side, so you always know what to do today and why it matters. We call this system Horizons.
NOW IN 11 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Chinese, Korean and Japanese.
TURN BIG GOALS INTO DAILY STEPS
Break any goal into smaller subgoals and pull it down to a specific day. Rich text notes, tags, colors and recurring goals keep everything in one place.
PLAN YOUR TIME, NOT JUST YOUR TASKS
Schedule goals in the calendar to block time and see how your week really looks. Sync with Google Calendar and Apple Calendar.
ACHIEVE MORE WITH STEP-BY-STEP PROGRAMS
Climbs are guided programs for the goals people struggle with alone: sleep, writing, finance, journaling, mindset. No blank page, just a proven path.
ORGANIZE EVERYTHING ON BOARDS
Projects, reading lists, bucket lists, vision boards, knowledge bases. Start from a community template or build your own, and share any board as a public page.
PLAN TOGETHER
Create separate Spaces for work, personal life or a team. Invite people, assign goals, comment, mention teammates and follow progress together.
AND THE DETAILS
· Home Screen widgets
· Apple Watch app
· Dark mode
· Color labels and hashtags
· Share extension to capture anything
· Public sharing for boards and goals
LOVED BY PLANNERS WORLDWIDE
More than 200,000 people use Timestripe to plan their lives.
Timestripe Pro unlocks every horizon, unlimited boards, Climbs and team features. Monthly and yearly subscriptions are available; prices are shown in the app. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and a subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://timestripe.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00096704:ios.description:
Discover LACOSTE USA, the official app of the iconic crocodile brand. More than a store, it is a gateway to French elegance, sporting heritage, and contemporary style. From René Lacoste’s pioneering spirit to today’s global collections, the app brings the house’s vision to life: timeless, optimistic, and modern.
Explore the Lacoste universe at your fingertips. Browse our iconic Polo shirts, ready-to-wear for men, women and kids, refined leather goods, and versatile Sneakers designed for city movement. Complete your look with Sportwear, elegant Jackets, cozy Sweatshirts, or Bags and Jewellery that finish every outfit. Each creation balances performance and refinement, moving with you from court to street, weekday to weekend.
A seamless shopping journey. The interface is intuitive, navigation fluid, imagery crisp and immersive. Use filters by size, fit, fabric, or color. Discover personalized recommendations shaped by your preferences. Save favorites, keep your cart synced across devices, and check out securely. Managing your wardrobe becomes a pleasure, whether you are looking for a new Polo, lightweight Jackets, or timeless Sneakers.
Be first to what’s new. Enable notifications for early access to limited editions and collaborations with artists, athletes, and cultural innovators. From bold reinterpretations of the Polo to seasonal statements and modern Sweatshirts, the app offers a privileged view of what shapes Lacoste now and next.
Services designed for you. Track orders in real time, manage returns, and consult detailed size and care guides. Sign in to tailor the experience: keep your wish list in one place, and receive curated content. The more you explore, the more the app adapts, suggesting Sneakers, Bags, or Jewellery to match your style.
Elegance as a legacy. Since 1933, Lacoste has connected sport with sophistication, turning freedom of movement into a signature of style. Wearing Lacoste is expressing character with clarity: never loud, always assured. That inventive spirit lives on in breathable fabrics, smart cuts, and silhouettes that last. Whether it’s a crisp Polo, refined Jackets, or casual Sportwear, every piece tells a story of elegance.
A lifestyle beyond fashion. With LACOSTE USA, discover pieces for every moment: layers for the city, polished work essentials, relaxed weekend looks, court-inspired footwear, and travel-ready Bags. Accessories that elevate the everyday, including Jewellery for men and women, are designed to endure. Build a wardrobe with versatile Sweatshirts, statement Sneakers, and timeless Polo shirts that move with you season after season.
Why choose the LACOSTE USA app?
• Shop the official Lacoste catalog in the United States
• Enjoy a smooth, mobile-first shopping experience
• Receive early access to new arrivals and limited editions
• Get personalized recommendations and style inspiration
• Track orders and manage returns with ease
• Save favorites, store preferences, and sync across devices
Download today. LACOSTE USA is more than an app: it blends heritage and innovation, sport and sophistication, turning shopping into a refined experience and style into a daily companion. Open the app, step into the Lacoste world, and discover how the crocodile’s signature elevates your wardrobe, your rhythm, and your perspective.From the court to the city, redefine elegance with Lacoste USA.
Download now and make timeless style part of your life.

bluejetty:00080527:ios.description:
بازی فکری جستجوی کلمات فارسی برای بزرگسالان که به تقویت حافظه و تمرکز فکر کمک میکنه. 
دنبال بازی جستجوی کلمات فارسی میگردید که ذهن تحلیلگر خود را به چالش بکشید؟ "سرهمی" همان بازی فکری هست که به دنبال آن بودید! هدف این بازی کلمه ای جذاب، پیدا کردن واژه رمز است. با استفاده از رنگ بلوک های حروف به عنوان نشانه و سرنخ برای رمزگشایی، سعی کنید که واژه ی رمز را پیدا کنید. در این بازی بعد از تسلط به قوانین، به تدریج با چالش های سخت تر روبرو می شوید. این بازی فکری به شما امکان می دهد تا هوش خود را تقویت کرده و به عنوان یک استاد تمرکز فکری شناخته شوید و حتی بر علیه روباتهای خیلی باهوش بازی کنید!
این بازی هیجانی مرحله ای، مناسب بزرگسالانی هست که اوقات فراغت خود را بازی های سخت پر میکنند.
اگر از بازیهای فکری که بر مبنای بازی با کلمات یا در ژانر جستجوی کلمات هستند لذت میبرید، حتما این بازی را هم دوست خواهید داشت چون این بازی فکری بزرگسالان همژانر بازیهای فکری محبوب دیگر میباشد.
چطور بازی کنم؟ 
برای حدس زدن واژه رمز، حروف مورد نظر خود را وارد کنید. پس از هر حدس، رنگ خانه های حروف تغییر می کند و هر کدام از رنگها معنای خاصی دارد. با چند تلاش، واژه ی رمز را پیدا کنید:
- سبز: این حرف در جای درست قرار دارد 
- زرد: این حرف در رمز موجود است ولی باید جابجا شود 
- خاکستری: کلمه ی رمز شامل این حرف نیست 
دقت کنید که رنگها شبیه رنگهای بازیهای نوستالژیک و قدیمی هستد
ویژگی های فوق العاده بازی: 
- هزاران مرحله ی چالشی
- بازی در مقابل روباتهای باهوش
- بازی روزانه چالش برانگیز
- گرافیک خیره کننده و چشم نواز
- انیمیشن های بامزه و دلنشین
- حجم کم و نصب آسان
- کاملا رایگان و بدون پرداخت درون برنامه ای
 ویژگی های تمرکزی و ذهنی: 
این بازی نه تنها سرگرم کننده ی مفیدی هست، بلکه به صورت پیشرونده مهارت های ذهنی شما را ارتقاء می دهد:
- افزایش قدرت تحلیل
- افزایش هوش (IQ)
- بهبود حافظه
- افزایش دقت و نکته سنجی
- تمرکز فکری
- گسترش دامنه ی لغات فارسی
 آماده ی یک سفر هیجان انگیز در دنیای کلمات هستید؟ 
همین حالا "سرهمی" را دانلود کنید و لحظاتی پر از هوش، تفکر و سرگرمی را تجربه کنید!

bluejetty:00132310:ios.name: Carista OBD2
bluejetty:00132310:ios.summary: Carista lets you diagnose warning lights, read and reset fault codes, monitor live vehicle data, customize your car, and perform DIY service procedures - all from your phone. Save hours and thousands of dollars in unnecessary workshop visit
bluejetty:00132310:ios.description:
Carista lets you diagnose warning lights, read and reset fault codes, monitor live vehicle data, customize your car, and perform DIY service procedures - all from your phone. Save hours and thousands of dollars in unnecessary workshop visits, and take control of your car's maintenance, diagnostics, and personalization.
Trusted by 3+ million users worldwide, Carista supports 30+ car brands, offers SFD & SFD2 compatibility, and brings 10+ years of leadership in the OBD2 industry.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR CAR (PRO)
Unlock hidden features and personalize how your car behaves.
• Gauge needle sweep at startup
• Start screen logo
• Virtual instrument cluster themes
• Daytime running lights
• Coming-home and leaving-home lights
• Throttle response behavior
And many more
ADVANCED DIAGNOSTICS (PRO)
Go beyond the Check Engine Light. Diagnose multiple electronic control modules, including ABS, airbag, SRS, Engine, Transmission, and manufacturer-specific systems. Read and clear diagnostic trouble codes before visiting a workshop.
SEE YOUR CAR'S LIVE DATA (PRO)
Monitor real-time vehicle parameters and see what's happening inside your car. Depending on your vehicle, live data can include:
• Engine and turbo information
• Launch control count
• Mileage information
• Airbag crash count
• Service interval information
• Engine RPM and other performance parameters
With supported vehicles, Apple CarPlay lets you view basic OBD2 live data on your car's screen while driving.
PERFORM DIY SERVICE PROCEDURES (PRO)
Handle simple maintenance yourself and avoid workshop visits. Depending on your vehicle, Carista offers:
• Electronic parking brake (EPB) service
• Service due indicator reset
• Tire pressure sensor (TPMS) registration
• Diesel particulate filter (DPF) regeneration
• Battery registration
And other vehicle-specific service functions
SUPPORTED CAR BRANDS
Carista supports Acura, Audi, BMW, Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, Cupra, Dacia, Ford, Genesis, GMC, Holden, Honda, Hyundai, Infiniti, Jaguar, Kia, Land Rover, Lexus, Lincoln, MAN, Mazda, Mini, Nissan, Opel/Vauxhall, Pontiac, Renault, Saab, Scion, SEAT, Skoda, Toyota, Volkswagen and Volvo.
Feature availability varies by vehicle, model year and hardware: https://carista.com/apps/supported-cars
BASIC OBD2 FEATURES FOR MOST 2005/2008+ CARS (FREE)
Compatible vehicles with an OBD port also get basic OBD2 diagnostics, live data, and emissions readiness tools.
EASY TO USE:
Locate the OBD2 port
• Plug in the scanner
• Turn on ignition
• Open the app
• Pair it with the scanner
HARDWARE
For the best experience, pair the app with the Carista EVO Scanner. Carista also works with selected compatible OBD2 scanners, including OBDLink CX, OBDLink MX Bluetooth, OBDLink LX, Kiwi3, and genuine Bluetooth ELM327 v1.4 scanners.
The Carista OBD Scanner (white) is not compatible with Ford vehicles or SFD/SFD2-protected 2020+ Volkswagen Group vehicles. Check compatibility before purchasing a scanner.
WHY CARISTA?
• 3M+ users worldwide — Trusted by millions of drivers to understand, maintain, and personalize their cars.
• 10+ years of automotive expertise — Over a decade of experience in vehicle diagnostics and customization.
• Official Volkswagen Group partner — Trusted automotive technology with advanced capabilities for supported VW Group vehicles.
• 300+ customizations — Hundreds of ways to personalize your car and unlock hidden features.
• SFD & SFD2 support — Unlock supported SFD- and SFD2-protected features and customizations on compatible Volkswagen Group vehicles.
• 30+ car brands supported — One app for a wide range of popular manufacturers.
• One subscription. All Pro features. — Access every Pro feature for your vehicle without buying individual credits.
• Regularly updated — New vehicles and features added frequently.

listings.name: Carista OBD2
listings.description:
Carista lets you diagnose warning lights, read and reset fault codes, monitor live vehicle data, customize your car, and perform DIY service procedures - all from your phone. Save hours and thousands of dollars in unnecessary workshop visits, and take control of your car's maintenance, diagnostics, and personalization.

Trusted by 3+ million users worldwide, Carista supports 30+ car brands, offers SFD & SFD2 compatibility, and brings 10+ years of leadership in the OBD2 industry.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CAR (PRO)
Unlock hidden features and personalize how your car behaves.
• Gauge needle sweep at startup
• Start screen logo
• Virtual instrument cluster themes
• Daytime running lights
• Coming-home and leaving-home lights
• Throttle response behavior
And many more

ADVANCED DIAGNOSTICS (PRO)
Go beyond the Check Engine Light. Diagnose multiple electronic control modules, including ABS, airbag, SRS, Engine, Transmission, and manufacturer-specific systems. Read and clear diagnostic trouble codes before visiting a workshop.

SEE YOUR CAR'S LIVE DATA (PRO)
Monitor real-time vehicle parameters and see what's happening inside your car. Depending on your vehicle, live data can include:
• Engine and turbo information
• Launch control count
• Mileage information
• Airbag crash count
• Service interval information
• Engine RPM and other performance parameters

With supported vehicles, Apple CarPlay lets you view basic OBD2 live data on your car's screen while driving.

PERFORM DIY SERVICE PROCEDURES (PRO)
Handle simple maintenance yourself and avoid workshop visits. Depending on your vehicle, Carista offers:
• Electronic parking brake (EPB) service
• Service due indicator reset
• Tire pressure sensor (TPMS) registration
• Diesel particulate filter (DPF) regeneration
• Battery registration
And other vehicle-specific service functions

SUPPORTED CAR BRANDS
Carista supports Acura, Audi, BMW, Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, Cupra, Dacia, Ford, Genesis, GMC, Holden, Honda, Hyundai, Infiniti, Jaguar, Kia, Land Rover, Lexus, Lincoln, MAN, Mazda, Mini, Nissan, Opel/Vauxhall, Pontiac, Renault, Saab, Scion, SEAT, Skoda, Toyota, Volkswagen and Volvo.

Feature availability varies by vehicle, model year and hardware: https://carista.com/apps/supported-cars

BASIC OBD2 FEATURES FOR MOST 2005/2008+ CARS (FREE)
Compatible vehicles with an OBD port also get basic OBD2 diagnostics, live data, and emissions readiness tools.

EASY TO USE:
Locate the OBD2 port
• Plug in the scanner
• Turn on ignition
• Open the app
• Pair it with the scanner

HARDWARE
For the best experience, pair the app with the Carista EVO Scanner. Carista also works with selected compatible OBD2 scanners, including OBDLink CX, OBDLink MX Bluetooth, OBDLink LX, Kiwi3, and genuine Bluetooth ELM327 v1.4 scanners.

The Carista OBD Scanner (white) is not compatible with Ford vehicles or SFD/SFD2-protected 2020+ Volkswagen Group vehicles. Check compatibility before purchasing a scanner.

WHY CARISTA?
• 3M+ users worldwide — Trusted by millions of drivers to understand, maintain, and personalize their cars.
• 10+ years of automotive expertise — Over a decade of experience in vehicle diagnostics and customization.
• Official Volkswagen Group partner — Trusted automotive technology with advanced capabilities for supported VW Group vehicles.
• 300+ customizations — Hundreds of ways to personalize your car and unlock hidden features.
• SFD & SFD2 support — Unlock supported SFD- and SFD2-protected features and customizations on compatible Volkswagen Group vehicles.
• 30+ car brands supported — One app for a wide range of popular manufacturers.
• One subscription. All Pro features. — Access every Pro feature for your vehicle without buying individual credits.
• Regularly updated — New vehicles and features added frequently.

Learn more: https://carista.com/
Supported vehicles: https://carista.com/apps/supported-cars

bluejetty:00039852:ios.summary: A mysterious, vibrant, and colorful world sculpted entirely from clay awaits in 'The Sense Point,' a game where the main characters Sen & Po must uncover the secrets of an entire island suspended somewhere in the vast universe. How did the
bluejetty:00039852:ios.description:
A mysterious, vibrant, and colorful world sculpted entirely from clay awaits in 'The Sense Point,' a game where the main characters Sen & Po must uncover the secrets of an entire island suspended somewhere in the vast universe. How did the heroes end up here, and why is there no one else on the island? Or perhaps someone is there after all! The essence of existence has always remained a puzzle for humanity, and who knows? Maybe this enigmatic world holds the answers. This entirely plasticine-built Puzzle & Adventure Game will take you back to childhood when everything was so vivid and fascinating, and everything was still ahead.
IMPORTANT NOTICE!
Please read this before starting the game:
- The Sense Point has been nominated as "Game of the Day" in the App Store across 160 countries worldwide.
- This game was developed by two passionate enthusiasts.
- The intricate process of creating a clay world and meticulously animating each location took more than 6 years.
- The Sense Point is an immersive adventure puzzle game crafted entirely out of clay. It proudly belongs to the indie games category.
- The initial part of the game is free. You will have the opportunity to explore multiple locations and tackle the first set of puzzles. Once you complete the free section, you will be given the option to purchase the full version of the game.
- While the game may pose challenges, utilizing the hint system will significantly enhance your gameplay experience.
- The first chapter offers 1-4 hours of gameplay, depending on your utilization of hints.
- The second chapter is currently in development and will be included in your original purchase on the release day.
- Every time you embark on a new game, you will encounter fresh combinations to solve the puzzles.
We extend our best wishes for your success in completing the first chapter!

bluejetty:00078909:ios.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
Channel your inner pinball wizard! Flip and tilt your way through themed tables featuring characters like Godzilla and Kong in this classic arcade game.
Try to climb the leaderboards or beat your own highest scores in Single Player while enjoying the finest selection of pinball tables. Want to challenge friends? Invite the gang over for a lighting round of pass-and-play hot seat action.
Embark on your silver-ball quest with Zen Studios' tried-and-true physics model — every flip, bounce and shot will feel close to the real thing.
FEATURES:
• Explore original tables featuring familiar characters and settings, including the black-and-white Pinball Noir, the storybook setting of Grimm Tales and the Wrath of the Elder Gods, inspired by Lovecraft.
• Pinball skills a little rusty? Turn on the "Tip of the Day" feature in settings for gameplay hints.
• Swipe to bump the machine for extra control — but be careful not to cause a tilt! (Or you can learn to use the tilt to your advantage.)
• Choose from eight different overhead views to play each game from the perfect angle.
• Hit milestones and unlock unique star ratings for each machine.
• Play solo on or offline, or with friends in a local 2-4 person multiplayer hot seat challenge.
• Flip, bump and score your way to glory on the online leaderboards.
THEMED PINBALL TABLES (WITH MORE TO COME!):
• Kong Pinball
• Godzilla Pinball
• Godzilla vs. Kong Pinball
• The Addams Family
• Pinball Noir
• Curse of the Mummy
• Grimm Tales
• Wrath of the Elder Gods
- Created by Zen Studios.

bluejetty:00160171:ios.name: IELTS Prep App
bluejetty:00160171:ios.summary:
Boost Your Score with IELTS® Exam Preparation App
Are you aiming for a high score in the IELTS exam? Our app is your ultimate solution designed to increase your scores across all test sections. Whether you are focusing on IELTS vocabulary,
bluejetty:00160171:ios.description:
Boost Your Score with IELTS® Exam Preparation App
Are you aiming for a high score in the IELTS exam? Our app is your ultimate solution designed to increase your scores across all test sections. Whether you are focusing on IELTS vocabulary, mastering IELTS writing, or enhancing your English listening and speaking skills, this app is your ideal IELTS assistant, tailored for both Academic and General modules and featuring IELTS practice tests, interactive lessons and exercises, expert tips and tricks, answer strategies, and covering topics that require the most attention to make you fully prepared to achieve your goal.
Step-by-Step Learning Technique
This app offers a unique step-by-step approach, ensuring long-term knowledge retention. The entire course is divided into carefully crafted learning steps that include lessons and exercises, arranged to review studied content just before you would forget it, reinforcing your knowledge and ensuring it stays with you for the long term. This approach optimizes your study time and fundamentally improves your English language skills while preparing you for the real exam.
200+ Tasks to IELTS Practice Anytime and Anywhere
Our app provides comprehensive lessons across all IELTS test components — Reading, Listening, Speaking, and Writing. It helps learners understand each section, tackle various question types, and apply effective test-taking strategies to achieve a higher score. Each lesson is accompanied by targeted exercises that reinforce the skills covered in lesson, offering detailed explanations for every correct answer.
Master Your IELTS Writing Skills
Enhance your ability to write well-structured IELTS essays and letters confidently. The app offers answer strategies and a powerful writing prompts tool to ensure your IELTS essay meet the standards required for a high score. Built-in grammar resources provide clear explanations and examples to make your writing more persuasive.
Improve Your IELTS Reading Skills
Reading comprehension is crucial for achieving success in the exam. Our app offers in-depth lessons that cover answer strategies for all question types of IELTS reading and expert tips and tricks. Exercises simulate real IELTS reading passages, with detailed answer explanations, helping you pass the reading section with the highest score.
Sharpen Your English Listening and Speaking Skills
Mastering IELTS listening and IELTS speaking is also essential. Our app provides tools to improve your English listening and speaking skills. Interactive dialogues replicate real IELTS speaking tasks and a wide collection of audio materials designed to simulate the IELTS listening environment, increasing your confidence and preparing you for any challenges on the exam day.
Expand Your IELTS Vocabulary
A rich English vocabulary is key, especially in IELTS writing and IELTS speaking sections. Our app offers extensive resources to help you improve vocabulary effectively. Dive into English word lists with more than 2.000 words, voiced by native English speakers and tailored to the IELTS exam, covering phrasal verbs, idioms and phrases, and specialized IELTS vocabulary. With regular IELTS practice, you will learn words faster and apply them confidently in your writing and speaking tasks.

bluejetty:00161579:ios.description:
With the Australian Government’s Express Plus Child Support mobile app you can view your Child Support payments, update your details and more.
To use the app you need to have a myGov account linked to your Child Support online account.
To setup a myGov account go to my.gov.au
If you need help to setup a myGov account, or link to Child Support go to servicesaustralia.gov.au/onlineguides
To sign into the app for the first time, use your myGov sign in details and create a PIN.
You’ll then use your myGov PIN to sign into the app in future.
With our app, you can: 
• check when your payments are due
• check how much to pay 
• check how much you’ll receive
• view your payment history
• view and update your personal and bank details
• update change of care arrangements
• upload documents to Child Support
• update your income estimate
• update your income for a previous financial year
• advise of an extraordinary payment
