bluejetty:00177823:ios.name: ChirpOMatic - BirdSong USA
bluejetty:00177823:ios.summary:
ChirpOMatic USA identifies North American birds quickly and easily, from the Blackpoll Warbler’s high pitched song to the loud gobble of the Wild Turkey. It's the most sensitive analyser available, giving a result when other apps fail.
HOW
bluejetty:00177823:ios.description:
ChirpOMatic USA identifies North American birds quickly and easily, from the Blackpoll Warbler’s high pitched song to the loud gobble of the Wild Turkey. It's the most sensitive analyser available, giving a result when other apps fail.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
1. Record the bird song or call using your iPhone or iPad.
2. ChirpOMatic analyzes the audio to identify the bird species based on its unique vocalizations.
3. The app provides the name of the bird or birds.
4. For recordings with background noise, the app offers a ranked shortlist of the most likely birds.
5. Access additional information about each identified species, including song descriptions and key features to listen for.
WHO’S IT FOR?
Birdwatchers, nature lovers, and researchers.
WHY CHOOSE CHIRPOMATIC?
> Easy to use – No birding or technical skills required.
> Ethical and responsible – Features an innovative Bird-safe mode and automatic Night-time mode to ensure no sound or light disturbs nesting birds.
> Accurate and reliable – The app is continually updated and refined. Developed by Spiny Software—a small, dedicated team committed to high-quality software.
> Privacy-focused – No recordings or personal data are collected, ensuring your privacy.
> Outstanding customer service – Get a response within 24 hours.
> Forgot your phone? – Record bird sounds using your Apple Watch and identify them later on your iPhone.
> Support bird research – Share your best recordings to contribute to birdwatching, research, and the global Xeno-canto database, helping to expand knowledge and appreciation of bird diversity.
ADD-ONS
Love ChirpOMatic? Try ChirpOMatic Pro!
With Pro, you can:
> Save, organize, rename, and export your recordings – Recordings are stored on your phone with the date and location, making it easy to relive and remember special moments. Share recordings via AirDrop, Messages, email, or other apps.
> Explore the reference section – Access photos, sounds, and song descriptions of North American birds.
> Test your bird knowledge – Play the Bird Quiz—choose your own birds or challenge yourself with built-in levels.
Subscription Details:
If you choose to subscribe to ChirpOMatic Pro, payment will be charged to your Apple account. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. Auto-renewal can be turned off anytime in your App Store settings. Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited upon subscription purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://www.spinysoftware.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
"Top of the pile of bird song recognition apps" – Bird Watching magazine
The only birdsong app that can safely be used in nature reserves!
Featured by Apple in "Celebrate Springtime" and "App of the Day".
Happy bird listening!

bluejetty:00069801:ios.description:
Property Survey GPS makes it easy to discover accurate property boundaries, parcel data, and land information directly on your iPhone or iPad. Whether you’re a property owner, real estate agent, developer, or land surveyor, our GPS-powered map puts the details you need at your fingertips.
With nationwide coverage and seamless GPS positioning, instantly view who owns land, where lot lines are drawn, and how a property is classified. Perfect for checking parcel data in the field, verifying property lines before purchase, or simply exploring the land around you.
Key Features
* Property Boundaries & Parcel Maps – View accurate lot lines, parcel IDs, and acreage details.
* Owner & Address Information – Instantly see property owners, mailing addresses, and parcel data.
* Land & Building Data – Check land use, zoning codes, square footage, and vacancy indicators.
* Search Made Simple – Look up properties by address, parcel number, owner name, or GPS location.
* Measurement Tools – Calculate distances, square footage, or acreage directly on the map.
* Basemap Layers – Switch between street maps, satellite imagery, and aerial views for better insights.
* Share & Save – Bookmark important properties, add notes, and share parcel links with others.
Why Choose Property Survey GPS?
* Covers over 99% of the U.S. population with reliable parcel data.
* Works as a property finder, land survey tool, hunting app, or real estate assistant.
* Designed for professionals (surveyors, appraisers, developers) and everyday landowners alike.
* Fast, accurate, and mobile-friendly — no need for bulky plat maps or complex GIS software.
Purchasing a subscription is required for advanced features such as unlimited data points, PDF and KML exports, as well as parcel unlimited searches
Terms: https://biographics.com.br/terms
Privacy Policy: https://biographics.com.br/privacy

Stay Close with the People Who Matter Most
Family is a powerful family locator and location tracker designed to help you stay connected with the people you care about.
If you use Find My Friends or Family Link to track family locations, Family gives you the same peace of mind with more everyday family features.
Whether you’re a parent, partner, or caregiver, Family makes it easy to know where everyone is, stay safe, and stay connected.
Why Families Choose Family
Real-time location sharing lets you easily see live locations of family and friends on a private map. It offers a simple and reliable Find My Friends experience designed for families.
Smart location alerts notify you instantly when family members arrive or leave home, school, or work.
Custom safe zones allow you to create safe places for kids and loved ones and receive automatic alerts for each zone, perfect for daily routines.
Location history and routes show detailed timelines so you can quickly understand where your family has been.
Emergency location assistance helps you quickly locate family members in urgent situations when every second matters.
Daily steps and activity tracking encourage healthy habits across the family.
Step challenges for families create fun competitions that motivate kids and adults to stay active together.
Built for Parents, Couples, and Families
Family is ideal for parents tracking kids’ locations safely, couples staying connected throughout the day, and families coordinating daily life with confidence.
If you’re searching for a Family Link alternative or a modern Find My Friends style app, Family is built specifically for real-life family needs.
No complicated setup.
No unnecessary features.
Just a clear and reliable family tracker you can trust.
A Smart Family Locator That Just Works
Family combines accurate GPS location tracking, instant alerts and notifications, location history and safe zones, and simple health and activity insights.
All in one easy-to-use location sharing app designed for families.
Stay informed. Stay connected. Stay close.
Download Family Today
Join thousands of families using Family as their everyday family locator, location tracker, and Find My Friends style app for safety and peace of mind.

Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account once confirmed.

You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in Account Settings.

bluejetty:00124397:ios.description:
Cafe Terrace: Jewel Match 3 is a match-3 puzzle game played by users around the world.
The cafe-themed jewel puzzle and items invite you to a cozy world.
Spend an elegant time with Irene in a lovely cafe with a refreshing breeze.
Cafe Terrace is not difficult and can be cleared easily.
We offer various stages so you won't get bored.
There is no limit to the number of times you can play, so you can enjoy it as much as you like.
Would you like to get rid of stress with exhilarating combos on the Cafe Terrace?
Exhilarating puzzles and charming items await you.
Have a good time on the Cafe Terrace right away.
[How to play the game]
Try matching three jewels of the same color vertically or horizontally.
Match 4 or more jewels to create a special jewel.
Special jewels will erase more jewels.
Matching special jewels with each other will result in a surprise.
If it is difficult to clear the stage, please use special items.
Special items are very useful for clearing stages.
[Characteristics]
We offer more than 2,000 various stages.
There is no limit to the number of plays, so you can enjoy as much as you like.
Feel free to enjoy it regardless of location and time.
Free forever.
You can play without internet access.
Try to compete with other users on the leaderboard.
Try to get all the achievements.
[Caution]
Please save the game before replacing your device.
You can save by selecting Settings > Save.
If you delete the game without saving, you will not be able to load the game data.
This game includes interstitial ads, banner ads and reward ads.

bluejetty:00182791:ios.description:
Let’s enjoy Mahjong Classic: Solitaire for free!
Mahjong Classic: Solitaire is a free puzzle game and also known as: Shanghai Mahjong, Mahjong Solitaire or Taipei Mah-jong. If you are in love with solitaire, poker or merge gameplay, you are in the right place.
The gameplay is super easy: simply tap and match 2 same tiles to finish the board. User can also customize tile sets with many eye-catching styles such as: jewel, blossom, polygon or traditional card deck.
How to play Mahjong Classic: Solitaire:
▶ Match 2 free tiles to remove them. A tile is said to be free if it can be moved either left or right without disturbing other tiles.
▶ It is impossible to match 2 of identical tiles if any of them is located below other tiles
▶ Ranking: player will gain 1 star when complete the board, 2 stars if use no hint and undo, 3 stars if use no hint & undo in a limited time.
Mahjong Classic: Solitaire gameplay features:
▶ Play 1000+ boards: The list will continue seamlessly.
▶ Unlimited free hints: Find out new clues to win the game as fast as possible.
▶ Unlimited free undos.
▶ Unlimited free shuffle: Have a new arrangement for your card deck.
▶ Customize theme with a great deal of tile set, background and music.
▶ Enjoy the game freely without time pressure.
▶ Play Mahjong Classic:Solitaire anywhere, even if you have no wifi around.
▶ New goals, power-ups, and obstacles give Mahjong Solitaire a whole new twist.
▶ Play with others and enjoy your mahjong journey together.
▶ Great fit if you love mahjong solitaire, tripeaks, jigsaw puzzles, mayong, word search and other ‘smart games’.

- Unlock the full potential of AI
Stop wasting time switching between multiple apps. With AI Chat Assistant you get everything in one place: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, image generation, video creation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and even advanced AI Vision. It’s your personal assistant for every occasion.
- Turn ideas into results with zero effort
Need to write a professional email, a marketing post, or an essay for your studies? Just type or say your request, and AI Chat Assistant will instantly generate polished, ready-to-use text. Struggling with writer’s block? Our intelligent writing assistant helps you create articles, stories, scripts, and more — faster than ever before.
- Create stunning visuals & videos
Bring your imagination to life! With AI-powered image and video generators, you can turn text prompts into eye-catching artwork or even transform one photo into another. Perfect for social media creators, marketers, or anyone who wants to stand out online.
- Voice-first interaction
Sometimes typing is not enough. Use our voice mode to talk directly with AI and get instant answers. Record lectures, meetings, or conversations and convert them into clear, structured text using our speech-to-text technology.
- Text-to-Speech for hands-free productivity
Let the app read for you. Convert any text into natural-sounding speech — perfect for multitasking, accessibility, or simply listening on the go.
- AI Vision: Identify and analyze anything
Take a photo or upload an image — the app will instantly recognize, describe, and analyze it. From everyday objects to complex diagrams, AI Vision helps you understand and interact with the world around you in new ways.
- Fine-tune your AI
Customize the assistant to your unique needs. Adjust style, tone, and level of detail to make every answer more relevant and personalized.
- Use AI Chat Assistant for:
Work: write reports, generate presentations, analyze data, draft emails.
Study: solve math problems, summarize lectures, translate texts, prepare for exams.
Creativity: design social media posts, generate ideas, create stories, scripts, or poems.
Daily life: plan trips, find recipes, brainstorm gift ideas, or just chat for fun.
- Privacy & Safety
We respect your privacy. Please avoid entering personal or sensitive information. AI-generated content may sometimes be inaccurate, offensive, or inappropriate — use responsibly.

Terms of Use: assistantaichat.com/termofuse.html

bluejetty:00186151:ios.description:
SuperMemo – Language Learning with AI
Learn English and 27 other languages with SuperMemo! Explore language courses, pick up new vocabulary, reinforce what you learn with spaced repetition and practice conversations with AI. Learn effectively at your own pace – from the basics all the way to advanced fluency.
300+ COURSES IN 28 LANGUAGES
Choose from hundreds of courses tailored to your level, needs and interests. Learn English, German, Spanish, French, Italian and many other languages.
You'll find courses for beginners, intermediate and advanced learners, as well as materials for learning vocabulary, grammar and practical communication.
Learn English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and many other languages. Choose from 28 foreign languages, including Arabic, Czech, Greek, Ukrainian, Turkish and Romanian.
ENGLISH AT EVERY LEVEL
Improve your English at levels A1–C2. Choose the right course for you and practice what you need most – from basic phrases to more advanced vocabulary and communication.
Discover SuperMemo course series:
• No Problem! – practical language learning
• Extreme – intensive vocabulary learning
• PowerWords! – build your vocabulary
• Olive Green – learn the language in an engaging context
• Hello! – language courses for different levels
• Quick Start – the basics to get you started
• Business English – English for work
You can also use grammar courses, exam preparation materials and courses for children and teens.
PRACTICE WITH AI
Take your learning to the next level with the AI features in SuperMemo.
• Live Mode – your AI tutor. Practice conversations with a virtual tutor in your course. Develop your communication skills and put your knowledge to the test.
• MemoChat AI – talk in the language you're learning. Practice dialogues at different levels and save new words and phrases for further study.
• MemoTranslator AI – translate by voice. Use voice translation when you need to quickly understand or say something in another language.
• AI Assistant – get help with your learning. Ask about word meanings, grammar and any language topics you want to understand better.
LEARN EFFECTIVELY WITH SPACED REPETITION
SuperMemo uses a repetition method based on a scientific approach to memory. The app helps you return to the material at the right time, so you consolidate your knowledge and remember new information more effectively.
Learn words, discover useful phrases and check your progress regularly.
CREATE YOUR OWN COURSE
Want to learn vocabulary for work, travel, studies or your own interests? Create your own courses and flashcards on any topic. Tailor learning to your goals and grow your knowledge the way you like.
LEARN WHENEVER AND WHEREVER YOU WANT
Use courses on your devices and come back to learning whenever you have time. Set your own goal, learn regularly and make progress step by step.
CHOOSE YOUR WAY TO LEARN
Start from the basics, improve your language skills or focus on specific abilities. Choose courses that fit your needs and enjoy the extra features of a SuperMemo Premium subscription.
SuperMemo has been developing its language learning method since 1991. Combine a proven repetition system with modern AI tools and learn languages on your own terms.
Download SuperMemo and start learning today!

Hints” and ‘answers’ are provided in case you get stuck, so beginners can enjoy the game until the end.

Tap the arrows at the bottom of the screen to move.
Tap on the area you are interested in to check it out.
Use the items you get to solve the riddles.

bluejetty:00041508:ios.description:
In the vast world of Roblox, Robux Trade for Roblox is like a hidden treasure. It is an essential tool for any player looking to maximize their in-game experience.
With outstanding features designed to enrich your gameplay, Robux Trade becomes your indispensable ally. Discover how to get more items with less effort, maximizing the value of your Robux and enhancing your rovlox game characters.
Features:
- Real-time catalog pricing.
One of the standout features is the ability to provide real-time Roblox catalog pricing. No more guessing how many Robux you need for that desired item; Robux Trade will tell you exactly that.
- Daily Prizes and Giveaways
Who doesn't like to get free stuff? We offer you the opportunity to get items without spending a single rovus. A Robux Trade gift for every day to make the game exciting.
- Finding and connecting friends
Roblox is even better when you play with friends. The Robux Trade allows you to find and connect with friends quickly and easily. It's never been easier to be part of the community.
- Find the latest sellers on the market
If you are looking to trade, Robux Trade will show you who the reliable sellers in the market are. Trade with confidence and build your inventory safely.

bluejetty:00017451:ios.name: Word Connect 2026 Brain Puzzle
bluejetty:00017451:ios.summary:
Sharpen your mind with Word Connect 2026 — a fun and relaxing word puzzle game! Connect letters to find hidden words across thousands of levels, growing your vocabulary and spelling as you play.
Simple to learn, hard to put down. Just you,
bluejetty:00017451:ios.description:
Sharpen your mind with Word Connect 2026 — a fun and relaxing word puzzle game! Connect letters to find hidden words across thousands of levels, growing your vocabulary and spelling as you play.
Simple to learn, hard to put down. Just you, a grid of letters, and that satisfying click when the word clicks into place.
HOW TO PLAY
- Swipe letters to form words — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally
- Words can be spelled in any direction, even backwards
- Find every word to complete the level
- Discover extra hidden words to earn bonus coins
- Stuck? Use a hint and keep the streak going
WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- Thousands of unique word puzzles to solve
- Simple, easy, and relaxing gameplay
- Difficulty grows naturally as you progress
- Daily rewards and bonus coins
- Helpful hints whenever you need them
- Great for brain training and growing your vocabulary
- Play at your own pace — no time limits, no pressure
- 100% offline — no Wi-Fi needed, play anywhere
- Colorful graphics with a fun "letter soup" theme
- Regular updates with fresh puzzles
A REAL BRAIN WORKOUT
Word Connect is more than a game. It's a small daily workout for your mind — proven to help with focus, memory, and vocabulary. Spell your way to a sharper brain, one puzzle at a time. Perfect for a coffee break, a long commute, or winding down before bed.
GROW YOUR VOCABULARY
Every level introduces new words to discover. Whether you're a casual player or a word game pro, you'll pick up fresh vocabulary and sharpen your spelling without even noticing. Learning has never felt this relaxing.
PERFECT FOR FANS OF
- Crossword and word search puzzles
- Anagram and word scramble games
- Word find, word cross, and word connect games
- Vocabulary and spelling games
- Relaxing brain-training puzzles
- Word games you can play offline
If you love any of these, Word Connect 2026 is the perfect addition to your word game collection.
DOWNLOAD TODAY
Free to play, fully offline, and endlessly relaxing. If you want to play without interruptions, an optional No Ads upgrade is available.
We read every review and feature request. Reach out anytime through the in-game settings menu or via the email on our App Store page.
Connect. Spell. Find. Keep your brain fit — one word at a time.

Download now and enjoy your free 30-day trial.

bluejetty:00133187:ios.description:
Experience the art of color mixing with "Color Merge Puzzle". Here, your canvas becomes a vibrant, color-filled puzzle waiting to be solved.
The game begins with a few basic colors at your disposal. By dragging and dropping them onto a larger canvas, you create a mixture of colors. Each combination, whether you're using RGB, black, white, or any other provided hues, influences the final shade.
The goal? To match your color mixtures with pieces of a hue puzzle displayed at the top of the screen. In the initial levels, you'll try to create around 60 different shades from the base colors.
Take advantage of our "undo" and "reset" features when you need to fine-tune your mixture. Stuck or need some inspiration? Use the "reveal" button to view a gradient list of all potential colors and track your progress.
As you advance, you'll encounter puzzles that transform into famous paintings like "Starry Night," bringing an added layer of excitement to the game.
"Color Merge Puzzle" is more than just a game; it's a journey through the art world, an exploration of color, and a test of your creativity. Merge, mix, and create a masterpiece!

Perfect your spellings of all verb tenses, from the most commonly used to those more advanced. Verbs and tenses are organised into logical groups, as well as regular and irregular forms, allowing you to customise the test to best suit your learning.
A must have for students learning French of all levels from high school to university and anybody preparing for a French proficiency exam.

- Contains over 600 most commonly used verbs with full conjugation tables.
- Fully personalisable verbs and tenses.
- Explanation and usage examples on every tense.
- French - English translation.
- Intelligently tests you on the verbs you need to practice the most.
- Word pronunciation to improve memorisation.

Conjuu breaks the task of learning conjugation into little bite sized tests, allowing you to focus on just the areas you need to improve on. bluejetty:00080481:ios.name: Connect 8: Word Chain Game
bluejetty:00080481:ios.summary:
A new word chain every day. Eight words, seven links, one satisfying solve.
SUN → SCREEN → DOOR → BELL. Each word pairs with the next to make a compound word or a familiar phrase: sunscreen, screen door, doorbell. You start with the first
bluejetty:00080481:ios.description:
A new word chain every day. Eight words, seven links, one satisfying solve.
SUN → SCREEN → DOOR → BELL. Each word pairs with the next to make a compound word or a familiar phrase: sunscreen, screen door, doorbell. You start with the first word and work your way down the chain. Every word comes with a clue and its first letter.
A fresh chain every day
Today's chain is free for everyone. It's the same puzzle for every player, and a new one arrives at midnight.
Go for gold
Find a word on the first try and it turns gold. String gold words together to climb the gold-run ladder, and get all seven for a perfect chain. Each tile plays a marimba note as it locks, and sounds stay quiet when your phone is on silent.
Say it instead
Rather talk than type? Hold the mic key and say the word, or double-tap it for hands-free and say a whole run. Words are recognized on your iPhone, and Connect 8 doesn't record or keep your voice.
12 packs, 144 chains
Around the house, Kitchen, Game night, Nature, Sports and more. Each pack is twelve chains that get harder as you go, with a stamp and its own theme at the end. The first pack is free.
20 themes to make it yours
Linen, butcher block, felt, vinyl, storm and more change the whole board, and each one moves in its own way. Every pack earns a theme, and finishing all twelve earns Prism. Keep your streak going for more, along with app icons and badges.
Challenge your friends
Think you've got today's chain down? Share a tile card with no letters and a link to the same chain, with your time to beat. Once enough people have played, you'll also see how your time compares with everyone who played today.
Keep your streak
Solve each day's chain to build your streak. A widget keeps your streak and today's chain on your Home Screen or Lock Screen, and a daily reminder is there if you'd like a gentle nudge.
Never stuck for long
Every word has a clue. Reveal a letter, or the whole word if you need it. In casual mode a wrong guess also reveals the next letter.
Made to fit
The board sizes itself to your screen, so the keyboard never covers a word. Connect 8 plays on iPhone and iPad, in light or dark. There are no ads.
Eight words. One chain. How far can you go?
Connect 8 Unlimited
For players who want more:
- All 12 packs, at your own pace
- Endless shuffle, chain after chain
- Every past daily in the archive
- The Marble, Candy and Neon themes
- Hard mode: no first letters after the opening word, and one reveal per chain
- A streak shield that forgives one missed day each week
Today's chain stays free whether or not you upgrade.
Unlimited subscriptions are charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of use: https://e4-studios.com/apps/connect-8/terms-of-service
Privacy policy: https://e4-studios.com/apps/connect-8/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00065368:ios.description:
Think Bank – Think Online is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Think Bank – Think Online:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Think Bank – Think Online app, you must be enrolled as a Think Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00124370:ios.description:
Includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
Welcome, Mayor, to the city builder and simulator! Be the hero of your very own city metropolis. This is the city-building game to design and create a beautiful, bustling town or metropolis. Every decision is yours as your city simulation grows larger and more intricate. You need to make smart building choices as a city builder to keep your citizens happy and your skyline growing. Then build, trade, chat, compete, and join clubs with fellow city-building Mayors. The city game that lets you build your city, your way!
BRING YOUR CITY METROPOLIS TO LIFE
Build your metropolis with skyscrapers, parks, bridges, and much more! Place buildings strategically to keep your taxes flowing and your city growing. Solve real-life city-building challenges like traffic and pollution. Provide your town and city services like power plants and police departments. Strategize, build and keep traffic moving with grand avenues and streetcars in this fun city builder and simulator.
PUT YOUR IMAGINATION AND CITY ON THE MAP
The possibilities are endless in this town and city-building simulator! A worldwide city game, build Tokyo-, London-, or Paris-style neighborhoods, and unlock exclusive city landmarks like the Eiffel Tower or Statue of Liberty. Make building rewarding and discover new technologies with the Future Cities while getting athletic with sports stadiums to become a pro city builder. Build and decorate your town or city with rivers, lakes, forests, and expand along the beach or mountain slopes. Unlock your city-builder strategies with new geographic regions for your metropolis, such as the Sunny Isles or Frosty Fjords, each with a unique architectural style. The city-building game where there’s always something new and different to make your city simulation unique.
BUILD AND BATTLE YOUR WAY TO VICTORY
The city-building game that lets you defend your city metropolis against monsters or compete against other mayors in Club Wars. Plot winning city-builder strategies with your Club mates and declare war on other cities. Once the battle simulation is on, unleash crazy disasters like the Disco Twister and Plant Monster on your opponents. Earn valuable rewards to use in battle, in building or to improve your city. In addition, take on other players in the Contest of Mayors, where you can complete weekly challenges and climb the League ranks toward the top of this city game. 
BUILD A BETTER CITY WITH TRAINS
The city-building game to improve as a city builder with unlockable and upgradeable trains. Discover new trains and train stations for your dream metropolis! Build, expand and customize your rail network to fit your unique city simulation.
BUILD, CONNECT AND TEAM UP
Join a Mayor’s Club to trade city supplies with other members who love and chat about city-building strategies and available resources. Collaborate with other town and city builders to help someone complete their personal vision as well as get support to complete yours. Build big, work together, lead other Mayors, and watch your city simulation come to life in this city-building game and simulator!
___

bluejetty:00120674:ios.description:
TriviaMaker is the #1 custom trivia game creator used by 200,000+ educators, corporate trainers, event hosts, and families in 100+ countries. Create professional quiz games in minutes, no tech skills needed.
7 INTERACTIVE GAME STYLES
Each style transforms the same questions into a completely different experience:
• GRID: Classic Jeopardy-style category board. Teams pick categories, wager points, and compete round by round.
• LIST: Survey Says format with top answer reveals. Players guess the most popular answers.
• TRIVIA: Fast-paced multiple choice rounds with instant scoring. Everyone gets it instantly.
• WHEEL: Spin to reveal questions in random order. The spinning moment creates instant energy. Ideal for parties, fundraisers, and events.
• TICTAC: Classic tic-tac-toe with trivia twists. Adds strategy that keeps students thinking even on others' turns.
• HANGMAN: Word guessing with your custom vocabulary. Great for ESL classes, spelling practice, and vocabulary review.
• FUSION: Combine Grid, Trivia, List, and more into one seamless game.
BUILT FOR EVERY AUDIENCE
FOR TEACHERS & EDUCATORS
Transform review sessions into game shows students actually love. Make test prep engaging. Reinforce learning through play. Track scores automatically.
Perfect for: classroom review, test prep, vocabulary practice, subject reinforcement, formative assessment, bell ringers, exit tickets.
FOR CORPORATE TRAINERS
Boost training retention with interactive quizzes. Onboard new hires with branded trivia. Run icebreakers that actually break ice. Make compliance training people remember.
Perfect for: employee onboarding, product knowledge, team building, conferences, sales kickoffs, company culture events.
FOR EVENT PLANNERS & HOSTS
Host professional trivia nights without hiring a host. Run fundraisers with custom branded games. 
FOR FAMILIES & FRIENDS
Create custom game nights with your own questions. Birthday parties, holiday gatherings, road trips, your quiz show, your rules.
POWERFUL FEATURES 
• AI QUESTION GENERATOR: Type any topic or upload a PDF.
• CROWD MODE: Live multiplayer for 5 to 2,000 players.
• CUSTOM BRANDING: Add your logo, colors, backgrounds, and music to every game.
• SCORE TRACKING: Automatic leaderboards and team scoring across all game styles.
• IMPORT QUESTIONS: Upload from spreadsheet or type manually. One set of questions works across all 7 game styles.
TRUSTED BY THE BEST
Used by teams at Google, Amazon, Stanford, Microsoft, and 200,000+ users worldwide.
4.8 stars from 2,847+ reviews on triviamaker.com.
CREATE YOUR FIRST GAME IN 60 SECONDS
1. Pick a game style
2. Add questions (or let AI generate them)
3. Share the join code and play
IN APP PURCHASE INFORMATION
A "TriviaMaker Premium Account" includes the following features:
Unlimited Games, up to 4 teams per game, up to 16 questions on Feud, 6 categories in GRID, and 4 answers per question on Trivia. 
We currently offer 2 Premium Account purchase options.
1. "Premium Membership - 6 Month Subscription" - This In App Purchase will give you 6 months of Premium features on your account. 
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication
2. "Unlock All Features" - This In App Purchase will unlock a Premium Account for life and is not a renewing subscription.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.

bluejetty:00131287:ios.description:
Whether you're deeply spiritual, casually curious, or simply craving guidance during a transitional season, Nebula is a great place to start your journey to self-discovery. - Brit+Co
Nebula: Spiritual Guidance Space is both your trusted psychic reading app and astrology app for spiritual self-discovery, offering personalized tools and expert guidance to help you feel seen, connected, and confident. Nebula app is designed to meet you where you are, fitting naturally into your life so you can move forward in deeper alignment with your true self.
Nebula is an astrology app with a useful features:
- Birth chart reader tool to calculate natal chart and zodiac chart.
- Zodiac compatibility calculator to test love match potential and romantic relationships.
- Daily horoscope to check daily zodiac sign trends and horoscope insights.
- Tarot card readings
- Palm readings to explore palmistry and hand lines on your hand
- Live psychic chat to connect with psychic advisors anytime.
Zodiac Compatibility and Relationship Guidance
Ever wondered who is a good match for you? With Nebula’s advanced compatibility tools, you can explore the potential connection between you and your crush, partner, or even that intriguing new friend. Discover how you align and understand the natural tensions that arise when your energies interact. These insights help you avoid toxic dynamics, build healthy relationships, and move forward in love with clarity.
Accurate Psychic Readings via Live Chat
Receive spiritual guidance from one of 900 trusted advisors available 24/7 for private psychic readings. Whether you need clarity in love, confirmation of your thoughts and plans, or simply to know that you’re moving in the right direction, you can feel confident that their insights are both gifted and grounded in respect — wisdom you can truly rely on.
Birth Chart and Astrological Profile
Deepen your self-discovery by exploring your personality beyond your Sun sign. Enjoy detailed descriptions of each placement in your birth chart and learn how they shape your unique perspective. Discover the core strengths that make you who you are, while gaining insights into the challenges and opportunities that lie ahead.
Daily Horoscope and Tarot Insight
Start your day with personalized daily guidance and a special Tarot "Card of the Day" for immediate inspiration and focus. Nebula is a psychic app that also tracks your biorhythms to provide a clear overview of your physical, emotional, and intellectual energy. By staying aware of your daily focus and mood percentages, you can better plan your day and align your actions with your natural internal cycles.
As seen in media:
What sets Nebula apart, as many reviews highlight, is a commitment to guiding you every step of the way with a personalised, no-cookie-cutter approach that’s rooted in the core pillars of spiritual wellness - Hello Magazine

- Incredibly user-friendly interface designed for everyone.
- Perfect for social media influencers, gamers, designers, and art lovers.
Download Fugu AI today, choose your favorite art style, and step into the future of digital creation and photo editing!

Experience hearing like never before with the Miracle-Ear App — a certified medical device designed to support your hearing health and give you smarter control of your hearing aids.
Whether you're just starting your hearing care journey or already using compatible hearing aids, the Miracle-Ear app offers everything you need for a seamless, empowering experience. Take a free hearing screening test, explore a wide range of expert content on hearing health, and stay connected to your personal clinician — all in one place.
Smart Hearing Aid Management: Pair your compatible Bluetooth® hearing aids and take full control — adjust programs, volume, and background noise levels with ease.
Personalized Insights: Monitor your hearing aid usage and track your progress to get the most out of your devices.
Step-by-Step Guidance: Learn how to use and care for your hearing aids with tailored tutorials and daily maintenance tips.
Direct Support Access: Get in touch with customer service whenever you need expert help.
The Miracle-Ear App is a certified medical device. CE certified under MDR Regulation 2017/745 (NB 2797). Cleared by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) - DI 08059606110356. For medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, always consult a qualified healthcare professional.

bluejetty:00033383:ios.name: Clarity Wallpaper
bluejetty:00033383:ios.summary:
Discover, preview, create, and share beautiful wallpapers with ease. Whether you're using an iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad, or Mac, Clarity Wallpaper brings a thoughtful touch of beauty to every Apple device.
Previously featured on the App Stor
bluejetty:00033383:ios.description:
Discover, preview, create, and share beautiful wallpapers with ease. Whether you're using an iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad, or Mac, Clarity Wallpaper brings a thoughtful touch of beauty to every Apple device.
Previously featured on the App Store's Today tab in "Your Wallpaper Library," "A Fresh Look Every Day," and "Create Your Own Wallpaper."
Wallpapers may seem like a small detail, but we've always believed they're worth caring about.
Clarity Wallpaper brings together years of carefully curated photography, design, and original artwork. We believe a great wallpaper does more than make your screen look beautiful. It reflects your taste, your mood, and the way you see the world.
We've redesigned and rebuilt Clarity Wallpaper from the ground up. From browsing and previewing to widgets, Shortcuts, and sharing your creations, everything has been crafted for a smoother experience on the latest Apple devices.
/ Curated Wallpapers, Endless Inspiration
From natural landscapes and architecture to abstract art, minimalist design, and photography, we continually update themed collections, helping you discover something you love without spending hours searching.
Explore exceptional work from photographers and designers, original creations from our team, and a growing collection of artwork shared by our community.
/ Made for Every Screen
Portrait wallpapers are designed for your iPhone's Lock Screen and Home Screen, while landscape wallpapers are prepared for larger displays, including iPhone Duo, iPad, and Mac.
We refine how wallpapers look across different screen sizes, aspect ratios, and use cases, making it easy to find the right fit for every device.
/ Preview Before You Choose
Found a wallpaper you love but aren't sure how it will look on your device?
With device mockup previews, you can see how a wallpaper might look on your screen before choosing it.
/ Share Your Creations
Everyone has the potential to be a creator.
Share your original photography, artwork, or AI-generated wallpapers with the Clarity community. For AI creations, you can also include your prompts, sharing the ideas and process behind your work.
Track your work in "My Submissions." Approved submissions may be featured publicly or selected for our curated collections.
We also welcome photographers and designers to collaborate with us on unique wallpaper collections.
/ Widgets & Shortcuts
Make beautiful wallpapers part of your everyday life.
Discover new wallpapers through Home Screen widgets, or use Apple Shortcuts to create wallpaper automations that fit your routine.
/ Your Favorites, Always With You
We value our longtime users. Years of wallpapers and collections, along with your favorites, submissions, and membership benefits, remain part of the new Clarity Wallpaper.
We hope every time you open Clarity, you'll discover something new while still enjoying everything you've always loved.
Featured & Recommended
App Store: "Create the Perfect Wallpaper from Your Photos"
SSPAI: "When Your Wallpaper Steals the Spotlight, This App Offers a Better Way"
ifanr: "3 Ways to Turn Your Photos into Perfect Wallpapers"
About Subscriptions
Subscribe to Clarity Wallpaper to unlock exclusive collections and personalization features. Subscriptions are billed annually and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your device settings.
Terms of Use: https://claritywallpaper.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://claritywallpaper.com/privacypolicy
Questions & Feedback: hi@yuanjoy.com
We put care into every detail of Clarity Wallpaper, so every time your screen lights up, there's something to look forward to.

bluejetty:00029568:ios.name: Domino Duel - Online Dominoes
bluejetty:00029568:ios.summary: Let’s play Domino Duel! Domino Duel is an engaging multiplayer experience where you clash against players from different countries and your winnings will be visible in global leaderboards. You can play solo or as a part of a team. You can p
bluejetty:00029568:ios.description:
Let’s play Domino Duel! Domino Duel is an engaging multiplayer experience where you clash against players from different countries and your winnings will be visible in global leaderboards. You can play solo or as a part of a team. You can play one game, or best of 3!
Rules & Modes
1. Draw
Players start with 5 tiles in partner games, and 7 in solo games. If players are blocked, they can draw from the boneyard. The game ends when one player finishes their tiles, or all players are blocked.
2. Block
All players start with 7 tiles and there is no boneyard. If players are blocked, they have to pass. The player who finishes their tiles first wins, or the game ends when all players are blocked.
3. All Five
This one is a bit more complicated, but once you get the hang of it, you’ll play like a pro. Players start with 5 tiles in partner games, and 7 in solo games. If players are blocked, they can draw from the boneyard. If the sum of the pips of the end times equals a number dividable by 5, then that number is added to the player’s points.
Attention, highly competitive players!
Domino Duel has a global leaderboard ranking that tracks the top players from around the world. You can see how you stack up against other players at any time, and strive to climb the ranks.
The rankings are based on skill level, the number of matches you've won, and the number of points you've scored. You can track your progress, compare yourself with your biggest rivals, and work to improve your game.
Bonuses
Do you like receiving coins for free? Every day, each player gets a daily bonus upon logging in. If you log in every day of the week, you'll earn an even bigger bonus. In addition to daily bonuses, Domino Duel also offers a range of missions and daily challenges to help you earn rewards and progress through the game. And of course, winning multiplayer matches would reward you with that satisfying jingle of the coins.
Online Tournaments
Compete against the most skilled dominoe players from across the globe. Win matches against the toughest opponents and at the end of the Tournament, your face could be among the biggest winners in the Tournament leaderboard! Experience the thrill of making strategic moves, outwitting your opponents, and dominating the rankings.
Become a VIP
VIP membership lasts for 30 days and offers several perks, including:
• the removal of in-game ads;
• access to exclusive galleries;
• distinctive profile frame;
• private chats with other players;
Enjoy an exclusive bonus with Purchase stamps, where you will receive additional chips after 5 in-app purchases at any price (one stamp is a present from us). Also, additional bonuses with manual level up.
Duel
With the Duel feature, players can take control and challenge opponents of their choice rather than relying on the algorithm's selection. A simple press of the DUEL button initiates a one-on-one showdown.
Rematch
Have a Rematch! If the game did not go the way you wanted, you could always demand a Rematch with your last opponent.
Training mode
With the training mode, players can compete against a capable AI. Every new player can hone their domino skill before going against read people in the multiplayer mode.
Chat & Social
A player may like, befriend, and block other players, as well as open direct messages and manage their chat. Deleting messages and entire conversations is also an option.
Piggy bank
Coins will accumulate into a Piggy bank the player can purchase from the menu. The Piggy bank will transition into a cooldown state after purchase or reset. Then a new Piggy bank will become available 24 hours later, starting a new coin accumulating process.
IMPORTANT:
This product is intended for those 18 or older and is for amusement purposes only. This game includes in-app purchases. Practice or success at social casino gaming does not imply future success at real money gambling and gaming.

EXPERIENCE TRUE
bluejetty:00022665:ios.description:
Ever wanted to own the biggest business on the planet? Well, it doesn’t get any bigger than this. Become the CEO of Earth inc. and turn it into the biggest company in the universe. No matter the cost.

EXPERIENCE TRUE CAPITALISM

• Idle and get rich even while sleeping, and become the billionaire tycoon you were always meant to be.
• Hire millions of workers and build your business tower to the sky.
• Make money across all continents. The world is your playground.
• Environmental damage! Don’t mix ecologics with your economics, and keep stacking up that cash no matter the cost.

EXPAND TO OUTER SPACE

• Gain galactic knowledge to multiply your profits, and become the richest trillionaire tycoon in the whole universe.
• Take control of the whole cosmos in this incremental clicker simulation game. Are you ready for an adventure, capitalist?
Earth Inc. is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. You can disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings.

Our 20k
bluejetty:00091437:ios.description:
Forfeit is an app that adds accountability to your habits. We're based on the scientifically backed concept of Habit Contracts - popularised by Atomic Habits - that adding accountability to completing habits is massively effective.
Our 20k+ users have achieved a 94% success rate on over 75k forfeits.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Set your forfeit
Set the task/habit that you want to complete, when you want to complete it by, and how you'll be held accountable if you don't complete it. This can be sending an accountability buddy a text or email!
2. Submit your evidence
Verify that you completed your habit using any of the methods defined below. This can be in the form of a photo, timelapse, self-verify, friend verify, GPS check-in, a web tracking limit, an Apple Health activity, a Strava run, a Whoop activity, a MyFitnessPal meal or anything else.
3. Or you fail
If you don't send evidence in time, your accountability method is triggered. This rarely happens - only 6% of forfeits fail. If you do fail, you can appeal the failed forfeit - we only want you to fail if it's a willpower issue, not if life gets in the way!
VERIFICATION METHODS
• Photo
Take a photo of the task that you completed, and an AI will verify if your photo matches your description.
Examples: At the gym, inbox zero, Duolingo completed, homework submitted, taking medication.
• Timelapse
Record a timelapse of you completing the tasks that you completed, and a human will verify if your timelapse matches your description.
Examples: Meditating, nighttime routine, stretching, working for 1hr.
• Self-Verify
Simply verify if you completed this task. No need for evidence!
Examples: No smoking, no drinking, no vaping, absolutely anything!
• Friend-Verify
Have an accountability buddy testify to whether you did or didn't complete a task.
Examples: No drinking, no phone in the house, no eating junk food.
• Apple Health
Set a threshold that you must cross in Apple Health (eg, 10,000 steps). Thousands of apps sync to this.
Examples: 10,000 steps, 20 mins meditation, 30 min bike ride, less than 2000 calories consumed.
• GPS Check-in
Set a GPS location that you must be within 100m of by the deadline.
Examples: Check into the gym, work on time, home by a certain time.
• Location Reminders
Get a reminder when you arrive at or leave a place you've saved, even when Forfeit is closed. Background location is optional.
Examples: "You're home - time to walk the dog", "At the gym - log your workout".
• GPS Avoid
Set a location that you won't be within a certain radius of at the deadline.
Examples: Not being at a bar on the weekends, leaving the house at a certain time.
• RescueTime integration
We sync with RescueTime, a web time-tracking app. You can use this to set thresholds on websites/desktop apps.
Examples: Max 30 mins on reddit.com, minimum 2hrs on VSCode, max 30 mins on gmail.com
• Pomodoro timer
This is a timer that if you click off, you fail.
Examples: Working for 30 mins, meditating for 20 mins, studying for 45 mins.
OTHER FEATURES
• X days/week: Set forfeits to be due a certain number of times per week (eg, work out 3x/week)
• Certain days/week: Set forfeits only to be due on certain days (eg, weekdays, or Mo/We/Fr)
• Appeal anything: If you have to skip a submission, simply send in an appeal, and it'll be reviewed in a few hours by a human.
• Varying leniency modes: Depending on your leniency mode (lenient, normal, hard), you may or may not be required to justify your appeal with evidence. Hard mode doesn't allow appeals.
• Screen Time integration: If you go over your limit, you're held accountable.
Terms & Conditions: https://www.forfeit.app/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.forfeit.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00137724:ios.description:
Your one stop for full coverage of the 2026 PGA Championship (Aronimink Golf Club in Newtown Square, Pennsylvania, May 11-17), 2026 KPMG Women’s PGA Championship (Hazeltine National Golf Club in Chaska, Minnesota, June 25-28), and 2026 Senior PGA Championship (The Concession Golf Club in Bradenton, Florida, April 16-19)! With the official PGA Championships app, attending fans can:
-Access and manage tickets

-Receive alerts featuring exclusive spectator updates

-Live real-time scoring and starting times, with video highlights right within player scorecards

-NEW FOR 2026: A continuously updated highlight experience on the home screen, catching up the viewer on the action right after it happens

-Select favorite players to receive key alerts about their play and video alerts with their top shots and post-round recaps
-Live odds available within player scorecards during the PGA Championship
-Live streaming of SiriusXM’s coverage of the PGA Championship at Aronimink, no sign in or subscription required!
-NEW FOR 2026: In-depth history experience for each championship, featuring full leaderboards, video and imagery
-Enhanced virtual assistant ready to answer questions about the PGA Championship and KPMG Women's PGA Championship, with talk-to-text functionality
-Live streaming of Featured Groups during the KPMG Women's PGA Championship
-In-depth player and course statistics
-Live streaming of press conferences 
-Course tours of all three championship venues
-PGA Championship Fantasy: Make your picks and enter to win prizes!

Transform your photos into a unique T-shirt. The t shirt design app front and back helps to present your T-shirt designs super effectively. And there is no limit to how you create the most unique clothes!

Choose from tons of mug mockup styles featuring diverse models and backgrounds. Visualize your design, in a photorealistic way, with our variety of mug mockup items and templates.

•Powerful searching feature
Use our searching feature to quickly find the mockup you need. And more and more mockup templates will soon be on the list based on your searching requests.

Photo Translator: AI Translate is yo
bluejetty:00081921:ios.description:
Tap a button and translate any language in seconds! Whether you're traveling, studying abroad, or navigating a foreign city, this all-in-one app makes understanding other languages simple and intuitive.
Photo Translator: AI Translate is your smart companion for real-time communication across more than 100 languages. From menus and signs to full documents and live conversations, the app is built to help you translate quickly, accurately, and effortlessly—wherever you are.
Powerful Features That Work For You:
• AI Translate – Delivers natural, fluent translations that fit your tone and context—whether you're going for professional or conversational. It’s intelligent, adaptable, and designed for real-world use.
• Camera Translation – Instantly translate text from images or printed materials. Just point your camera at a document, menu, or sign, and the app translates it on the spot—no typing needed.
• AR Translation – Augmented Reality brings translation to life by overlaying translated text onto real-world objects in real time. See foreign text transformed before your eyes through your camera lens.
• Voice Translation – Speak naturally, and the app does the rest. It listens, transcribes, and translates your speech—then either displays or reads the translation aloud.
• Text Translation – Type in any phrase and get an accurate translation in seconds. You can also hear the correct pronunciation, making it easy to learn and speak with confidence.
• Conversation Mode – Have real-time conversations with people who speak a different language. The app translates both sides of the dialogue so you can connect without missing a beat.
• Offline Mode – No internet? No problem. Download languages in advance and get reliable translations wherever you are—even in remote areas.
Photo Translator: AI Translate uses cutting-edge machine learning to scan, recognize, and translate text in various formats with precision. From travel signs to scanned documents, the app is optimized to deliver fast, high-quality results every time.
With advanced speech and image recognition technologies, it doesn't just translate—it understands. This app is your go-to tool for breaking down language barriers and making global communication easier than ever.
Download Photo Translator: AI Translate for iOS today and speak the world’s languages with ease.

bluejetty:00171332:ios.name: RFM 2024 Football Manager
bluejetty:00171332:ios.summary: Calling all Championship Manager fans – we are back! After the amazing success of our first retro classic football manager, style game, Retro Football Management, we just had to release a new version, and this time it’s even better. We have
bluejetty:00171332:ios.description:
Calling all Championship Manager fans – we are back! After the amazing success of our first retro classic football manager, style game, Retro Football Management, we just had to release a new version, and this time it’s even better. We have kept the quick gameplay that you loved so much and just added more content – much more! The game now includes over 120,000 of the greatest football players that have ever lived.
Like in RFM, you can take control of your favourite club sides from across football history and can complete a season in less time than it takes to finish your daily commute. You can take your club further and win more trophies, in a lot less time.
This version contains the top five leagues and gives users the choice of three decades of soccer management to choose from. But this time we have included multiple divisions in each country. This includes the current 2024 season! Can you beat Pep to the Premier League title this year or will City win another treble? Download now and find out!
We will be adding more seasons and countries from across the decades, so follow us on Twitter to be the first to hear about the new content we will add.
If managing teams in European competitions is your thing then prepare to be happy, we have added two more European trophies to the game. So now whichever time-period you choose you can compete to win all three major European trophies, Champions League / European Cup, EUROPA League / UEFA Cup or Conference League / Cup Winners Cup.
Pick the era when you fell in love with football and manage the legends of your youth. Turn an average Coventry team into European Cup winners using our added tactical choices and improved in-game control. Sell the players you never liked and buy the ones you did. Unlike other Soccer Manager games, your clubs past mediocrity will not stop you signing the world’s best players - assuming you have the money of course!
Like in RFM, you will earn points for winning football trophies, hitting objectives and completing challenges. This time the harder the football management job you take on, the more points you could win.
We have also added a Football Manager Profile feature. The more points you win, the further your reputation and abilities will reach. Can you progress from your sofa to become a legend of football management? The more points you win, the more old seasons you can unlock for free.
Sure, winning the league with Milan in 1990 is great, but can you also do it with Messina?
The club’s board will still set you season-long objectives, hit them and get rewarded with cash and stadium expansions, miss, and you will be fired – but in RFM 2024 you will not have to start again, this time you will get offered a new job and a path back to your favourite club.
We have kept the five free game slots from RFM, so you can still build world-class sides from three different decades, and play five games concurrently, why not bring Totti to Leeds in 2000, how about Maradona to Munich in 1990 or sign Messi from Miami and finally see him in Manchester. RFM 2024 Football Manager still gives you the chance to pack your squad with legends and dominate world football, no matter how humble your football club is.
Why wait? Download the game for free now and take a nostalgic trip through the history of gaming and football!

bluejetty:00039960:ios.description:
Turn spoken words into written text effortlessly with SoundType AI! Our advanced app for transcribing voice to text and transcribing audio transforms your voice or video files into accurately transcribed text. Its also equipped with innovative audio features and AI-powered summaries. With our standout feature of individual speaker identification, its an ideal choice for transcribing from meetings, interviews, podcasts, and more. Supporting over 90 languages, SoundType AI simplifies transcription of conversations from around the globe.
Features:
● AI-Powered Transcribe Voice to Text Accuracy
Our AI boasts an unrivaled precision for transcribing voice to text, trained on an impressive 680K hours of multilingual and multitask data. Experience flawless transcriptions each time you use SoundType AI.
● Individual Speaker Recognition for Transcribing
Ideal for group meetings and interviews, SoundType AI identifies and tags different speakers in your audio, providing well-structured, easy-to-follow transcriptions.
● Uncomplicated Long Audio Transcription
Have lengthy recordings to transcribe? No problem! SoundType AI handles long audio files with ease, ensuring all-inclusive and accurate transcriptions.
● Engaging Transcribe Audio to Text Experience
Engage with your transcriptions in unique ways. Ask questions about your audio or video, and our AI will generate responses from the content, enhancing your transcribe experience.
● Summarized Transcriptions
Receive the key points and highlights of your audio in a concise, understandable format with SoundType AIs summary feature.
● Comprehensive Voice/Video to Text Transcription
Whether its uploading an audio or video file, recording within the app, or importing from YouTube, SoundType AI transcribes it into text for straightforward analysis.
● Broad Language Support for Transcription
With our sophisticated AI technology, transcribe in over 90 languages and dialects effortlessly, perfect for international meetings, research work, and global podcasts.
Use SoundType AI for transcribing spoken content from:
○ Meeting Notes
○ Negotiations
○ Interviews
○ Language Studies
○ Podcasts
○ Lectures
And more, all converted into simple-to-read text!
Supported Formats:
Our app accepts a broad range of file formats, including MP3, WAV, WMA, M4A, and more. If you have queries about specific file types, our support team is ready to help.
Export Formats:
Easily export your transcriptions in various formats, such as TXT, SRT, PDF and Docx.

Internet connection

bluejetty:00029762:ios.description:
PokeTrade is the ultimate companion app to help you master the PTCGP and complete your collection. Sync your Pokémon cards, instantly match with friends and players worldwide to trade, and easily find the exact Pokémon & Trainer Cards you need. 
Start trading effortlessly! Connect with a global Pokémon TCGP community, track the current meta, and compete in tournaments to win prizes!
◼ Sync Your Collection Instantly 
Automatically scan your Pokémon TCG Pocket game to update your account in seconds! Our smart system instantly fills your Wishlist with missing cards and lists your duplicates for trade, saving you hours of manual work.
◼ List Your Available Pokémon & Trainer Cards
List your cards for trade not only by name but also by their properties! You can even list your Pokémon & Trainer cards by featuring their language.
◼ Create a Wishlist and Let Others Know What You Need
Create a wishlist for the Pokémon & Trainer cards you seek. This way, other players can search your wishlist and send precisely what you need.
◼ Find the Cards You Need with “Advanced Filtering”
Search other players’ listed cards and wishlists by Pokémon & Trainer Card name and language to quickly find the exact card you want.
◼ Save Time with "Best Match"
Match with other players based on your trade list and wishlist. Easily find the trade you are looking for without scrolling through random lists.
◼ Trade Instantly with “Quick Trade”
Instantly match with a player who wants your cards and has exactly what you need in return!
◼ Track Your Collection with Pack Tracker
Your collection updates in the Pack Tracker, and we will show your progress. This way, you can easily decide which booster pack you should open next.
◼ Track Missions & Reveal Secrets 
See exactly which cards you need to complete Themed and Deck missions for in-game rewards. Plus, get a sneak peek at Secret Missions hidden in Pokémon TCG Pocket!
◼ Always Up-to-Date Meta Decks
Don't fall behind the meta! Check out constantly updated featured decks and user-created community decks.
◼ Compete in Tournaments
Participate in a tournament, battle other players, and win in-app prizes.
◼ Earn Rewards with Simple Missions
Complete simple daily missions to earn in-app rewards.
◼ Win Big with “Lucky Draw” 
Join our Lucky Draws for a chance to win incredible in-app prizes just by participating!
◼ Built-in Direct Messaging
Easily get in touch through our built-in direct messaging to arrange a trade without any 3rd party messaging application. This makes communication easier and safer!
◼ Location Privacy
PokeTrade does not share your location with other users.
◼ DISCLAIMER
PokeTrade is a third-party application that helps players worldwide get in touch with each other. It is not affiliated with the Pokémon TCG Pocket, DENA CO., LTD, Creatures Inc., or The Pokémon Company.
◼ EULA
Please visit https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00119925:ios.description:
BehaviorSnap makes it simple to conduct systematic behavior observations and prepare easy to understand graphs to bring key insights to focus and inform decision making. This frees up time for you to enjoy the most rewarding and important parts of your job - building connections and making a difference.
WHAT ARE PEOPLE SAYING ABOUT BEHAVIORSNAP?
“Let me be the first to say that this is the tool I’ve been waiting for. As a school psychologist this app has already helped me collect valuable data on student behavior. The charts are perfect, the user interface is easy and intuitive, and the design is sleek and modern.” - Eric W., School Psychologist
“BehaviorSnap gives a great framework for what types of observations we should be doing. It’s more scientific and much easier than how we have been conducting observations. We are now spending more time doing our jobs than managing our materials.” - Matt G., School Psychologist
“Going from doing pencil and paper observations to using this tool is like the difference between a dinosaur and a space rocket! This app has really helped me! It makes taking behavior data so much easier-- it’s well worth the cost.” - Rose D., Special Education Teacher
If you are drowning in paperwork and responsibilities, BehaviorSnap will help you win back your time.
FOR SCHOOL PSYCHOLOGISTS, BY SCHOOL PSYCHOLOGISTS
We are school psychologists ourselves and deal with all the same challenges you do. Systematic behavior observations are crucial but compiling the data with spreadsheets, so we could share the data in a presentable manner, sapped our attention from what we really wanted to be doing. We were sure there was a better way.
We created templates and put them in a simple to use app. With the press of a button, you can start a behavior observation and just as quickly collect and present data.
FEATURES
- Four separate observation tools in one to allow you to do Interval, ABC, Duration, and Frequency recordings.
- Customizable to meet the needs of individual students.
- Your input is saved for each student to ensure efficient and consistent data tracking. 
- Data from each observation is compiled into meaningful and easy to read graphs.
- Reports can easily be emailed, printed, or attached to IEPs. 
In no time time you'll have beautifully presented data. You'll feel more in control, more productive, and more secure in your job. And, you will open up time to work directly with kids which will give you greater overall satisfaction. 
++
Download and gain access to an initial 12 observations and opportunity to tour the basic functionality of the top behavior observation tool on the market. If you love the app as much as we know you will, you will then have the option to choose a subscription that grants you unlimited use and access to exclusive features. Whether or not you choose to subscribe, you will always be able to view all of your observations and reports - the data you created will remain in your hands.
Don't waste another day frustrated by inferior methods of conducting observations. Retire your hand drawn templates and stopwatches. You owe it to yourself to try the method that will allow you to organize data at the tap of a screen. 
MORE INFO ONLINE
On the fence? Screencasts, tutorials and more are available at behaviorsnap.com
If you choose to purchase a subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Current price for one year is $29.99/yr USD, and may vary from country to country. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://www.behaviorsnap.com/privacy-policy/#privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.behaviorsnap.com/privacy-policy/#terms-of-service

Bundle and save

bluejetty:00022277:ios.description:
Journey through the Word of God with clear, faithful Bible teaching
This app is designed to help you grow in your understanding of Scripture through verse-by-verse teaching and a structured path through the Bible. Whether you are new to the Bible or seeking to go deeper, you’ll find practical guidance, guided study, and audio teaching that keeps your focus on God’s Word.
Follow a complete journey through Scripture with teaching rooted in the Bible and shaped for long-term spiritual growth.
Features
Verse-by-Verse Teaching
 Study the Bible in a clear and consistent way with verse-by-verse teaching that helps you understand the meaning and context of each passage.
Structured Study Path
 Move through the Bible with a guided approach designed to build understanding over time, ideal for daily study and steady progress.
Audio Teaching from Scripture
 Listen anytime with audio teaching drawn from the Bible, making it easy to stay engaged whether at home or on the go.
Offline Access
 Download teaching and study content for offline listening, so you can continue learning without interruption.
Read and Listen to Scripture
Follow along with Bible passages while listening to teaching for a deeper connection to God’s Word.
Progress Tracking
 Your study progress is saved automatically, allowing you to pick up where you left off across your devices with an account.
Simple and Focused Experience
 A clean, distraction-free design keeps your attention on Scripture and teaching, making the app easy to use for all ages.
Personalized Settings
 Adjust font size, playback speed, and light or dark mode to match your preferences for reading and listening.
Share Scripture and Teaching
 Easily share Bible passages and teaching with friends and family.
Free and Accessible
 All content is available without cost and without ads, making it easy to access and use anytime.
Grow in Your Understanding of the Bible
This app is built for those who want to go deeper into Scripture, to not just read it, but truly understand it. With consistent teaching, audio lessons, and a clear study path, you can develop a stronger foundation in God’s Word and continue learning over time.
Start Your Journey
Download today and begin exploring the Bible through verse-by-verse teaching, guided study, and audio lessons at your own pace and in your own rhythm.

 Your feedback helps us improve the app. Share your experience through the in-app feedback page.

bluejetty:00143447:ios.description:
Babysittor is word-of-mouth in app form: find babysitters recommended by your friends, family, and neighborhood. Because the best babysitter is the one who has already proven herself with those close to you.
*** PARENTS ***
+ Post an ad in just a few clicks and receive applications quickly.
+ Activate "Smart Alert" to automatically notify your favorite babysitters as soon as you post an ad.
+ Rate and leave a review after each babysitting job to help other community members.
+ You can pay your babysitter directly through the app, with just one click.
*** BABYSITTERS ***
+ Create a complete profile with your photos and a description that reflects who you are.
+ Apply to nearby ads with a single gesture.
+ Become the favorite babysitter of the families you work with.
+ Receive recommendations and reviews from parents!
+ Get your payments directly to your bank account via the app.
*** SECURITY & VERIFICATION ***
At Babysittor, the safety of your children comes first:
+ Verified ID document: each babysitter submits an ID document, automatically checked for authenticity upon registration.
+ Criminal background check (B3): we check the criminal background of babysitters.
+ Verified reviews: only parents who have booked through the app can leave a review.
*** A COMMUNITY, NOT A MARKETPLACE ***
Since 2013, Babysittor has grown through word-of-mouth:
+ Build your circle of trust by adding your friends, family, and babysitters.
+ Discover babysitters who are already taking care of your loved ones' children.
+ Meet babysitter profiles with whom you share common connections.
+ Found a gem? Recommend her to your circle; that's how the community grows.
*** THE STORY ***
Babysittor was born in 2013 when we noticed the difficulty of finding babysitters recommended by friends and family. Thanks to word-of-mouth, the community has continued to grow. Today, Babysittor is present in France and abroad, with strong values: verification, kindness, and transparency.
*** THEY SPEAK ABOUT US ***
FIGARO: "Just post your ad to find your babysitter within the hour."
ELLE: "The two-way rating system — babysitters and parents."
LCI: "The promise: to find babysitters very quickly."
To contact us → contact@babysittor.com

bluejetty:00065948:ios.name: Dog to try
bluejetty:00065948:ios.summary: Dog is a popular board game with cards. Your goal is to get all your and your partner's marbles into the target area before your opponents do. Our app is available for iPhone, Mac, iPad, and iPod touch. The full version of this app reached
bluejetty:00065948:ios.description:
Dog is a popular board game with cards. Your goal is to get all your and your partner's marbles into the target area before your opponents do. Our app is available for iPhone, Mac, iPad, and iPod touch. The full version of this app reached several times rank 3 of all games in the Swiss App Store, with thousands of ratings at an astonishing average of 4.7 stars and ranks regularly among the top ranks for card and board game apps in several countries. Try our app in this ad-supported version a no cost!
In each round you first receive a handful of cards. You must give one of your cards to your partner and receive one of his cards. Cards that you play advance your marble. A marble that lands exactly on another marble sends it home. Special cards speed up your moves, by exchanging marble positions, going backwards, or splitting advances over several marbles. When you are done with your own marbles, you must help your partner, as you can only win together.
Invite friends to a multiplayer game or find other players on the Internet! The players see your board and play their cards and marbles on their iPhone, Mac, iPad, or iPod touch. Your devices communicate easily over the Internet via Game Center, or locally (no registrations needed) via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi network. The app supplies bot players on empty game seats, so you can finally play with your friends even if you are missing a third or fourth player.
Blind and visually impaired players can select moves through VoiceOver. We encourage you to get acquainted with the standard VoiceOver features of iOS, and in particular with rotors.
Dog to try for iPad, iPhone, and iPod touch is intended for casual players who want to discover the game or join into their friends' favorite game. If you want to play with a variety of stronger bot players of different characters and strength, or on boards of variable size, or if you are concerned about advertisers' data collection, consider our full app named Dog Board Game.
The Dog to try app is financed through Google Ads. We do not track you and do not store any information from this app. However, we provide Google with the opportunity to collect such information to target its ads. You may choose to allow Google to track you through different apps to provide personalized ads. If you are concerned about advertisers' data collection or tracking, consider using our ad-free app Dog Board Game instead.
