bluejetty:00116078:ios.description:
RoostScan is the ultimate chicken identifier app that instantly detects any breed just by taking a photo. It’s the perfect tool for farmers, backyard keepers, and poultry enthusiasts to explore detailed breed profiles, track traits, and organize their flock.
Beyond instant identification, it lets you browse and search a growing library of over 500 verified chicken breeds, each packed with detailed information on appearance, behavior, traits, and origin. Save breeds to your personal collection and build a deeper understanding of your chickens.
Key Features:
-Instant Chicken Identifier: Snap a photo to instantly identify chicken breeds using smart AI-powered image recognition.
-Explore 500+ Chicken Breeds: Search and browse an extensive database of recognized breeds with photos, characteristics, and classifications.
-Read Chicken Articles & Guides: Learn about breed care, behavior, origins, genetics, and more with regularly updated articles.
-Build & Manage Your Collection: Add identified chickens to your personal collection. Perfect for tracking your flock or saving your favorite breeds.
-View Detailed Breed Information: Get in-depth profiles with traits, origin history, egg-laying details, climate suitability, and appearance.
-Smart Search & Filtering: Easily filter breeds by country, size, feather type, egg color, temperament, or productivity.
Why RoostScan?
1. A Powerful Chicken Identifier for Everyone: Whether you're a hobbyist or homesteader, this chicken identifier app simplifies breed recognition and learning.
2. Great for Education and Research: RoostScan is a fun, visual tool for students, teachers, and anyone interested in animal science or poultry farming.
3. Beginner-Friendly & Easy to Use: Designed for all ages, RoostScan's interface makes identifying chickens simple — no experience needed.
4. Offline Breed Access: Save breeds and articles to view offline anytime — ideal for use in remote areas or on the farm.
5. Always Expanding: Our chicken identifier database grows regularly with new breeds, facts, and community updates.
Whether you're tracking egg layers, researching breeds, or just curious about the chickens you see, RoostScan empowers you with accurate, AI-powered insights at your fingertips. From quick breed checks to deep dives into chicken genetics and behavior, it's the go-to app for poultry knowledge on the go.
What truly sets RoostScan apart is the depth of information. It’s more than a tool, it’s a living encyclopedia and a continuous learning platform. From instant breed recognition to historical context and practical care tips, RoostScan empowers you to connect more deeply with your feathered friends.
RoostScan is the smartest chicken identifier app to scan, save, and learn!
Privacy Policy: https://www.roostscan.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.roostscan.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00062231:ios.description:
Start your 2-week free trial of FluentU now! Cancel anytime.
Tired of boring language learning textbooks? FluentU brings languages to life with real-world interactive videos!
Learn to read and speak Spanish, French, English, Mandarin Chinese, German, Japanese, Russian, Korean and Italian with FluentU.
FluentU turns music videos, movie trailers, news and inspiring talks into an amazing language learning experience. Experience an immersive education that teaches you to speak and comprehend new languages in a natural way.
Now you can learn a new language while connecting with the culture. No matter what your skill level or interest, FluentU has you covered.
FLUENTU FEATURES:
LEARN A NEW LANGUAGE
- Immerse yourself in a foreign language to understand how it’s used 
- Connect with the language through real-world videos
- Quiz yourself on the vocabulary
- Learn to speak the language instead of scripted phrases
- Stay motivated to learn each day
WATCH, LISTEN & LEARN
- Put the textbooks away and learn from experience
- Watch videos with subtitles and translations to learn the language
- Tap on any word or phrase to learn its meaning
- Add words to your vocabulary list for review
- Listen to audio dialogues to gain an understanding of the language
BILINGUAL DICTIONARY
- Look up any word and see how it’s used in a sentence
- Search content by title or grammar and vocabulary points
AVAILABLE LANGUAGES:
- Chinese (Mandarin) 
- English
- French
- German
- Italian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Russian
- Spanish
WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING
"Great app. To my knowledge the best on the market. You created something unique and new!"
- Felix Wedel
"It is more helpful than any other tool I've used. I had been using podcasts before and trying to make flashcards, and that worked pretty well. But it ended up that I was spending more time making the flashcards than studying. FluentU really solves this."
- David Brown
"FluentU has quickly become one of my favorite language-learning tools. Great job on an aesthetically pleasing app and an incredibly functional one."
- Justin Price
"This concept in FluentU is amazing. It's such a great way to help you understand a spoken language and the way you break it down is amazing."
- Demi Pradolin
"This app is so fun and useful - the best Chinese language learning app I've ever used."
- Richard Jun
PLUS SUBSCRIPTION
FluentU is available as a monthly ($29.99 for Plus) or yearly subscription ($239.99 for Plus). If you enjoy FluentU, do nothing and your membership will automatically continue for as long as you choose to remain a member. You can easily cancel anytime, online. Just sign up to get started!
If you subscribe via iTunes: Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00081218:ios.summary:

How to play?
The game goal here is simple and easy to understand. You just
bluejetty:00081218:ios.description:
Screw Home is a casual and fun brain-challenging game. Unlock the screw puzzles and decorate the charming room. Start challenging your brain and show your strategy.
How to play?
The game goal here is simple and easy to understand. You just need to unscrew the screws and put them in the toolbox of the same color. Unscrew all the screws in the level to complete the challenge! After passing the level, you can decorate your room, choose furniture according to your preferences, and build your dream house!
Game features:
- Fun and interesting level design. The screws in the level are carefully designed. As the level increases, nuts of different styles will appear, making the level full of fun!
- Hundreds of level content. The levels in the game are constantly updated, so don't worry about not having new content to play.
- Freely designed decoration. You can decorate the room according to your favorite style. Bedrooms, swimming pools, living rooms, different rooms are all designed by you freely. Choose chairs, beds, table lamps, floors, and build your dream house.
- Powerful level props. What should I do if I encounter a difficult level? A variety of props to help you easily beat the level. Use props to smash obstacles, add holes, and add toolboxes. No need to worry about the most difficult levels.
- Rich activities and rewards. Various activities are launched from time to time to enrich the gameplay. Participate in activities to win rewards, and you will be the master of this game.
Screw Home is a game that perfectly combines puzzle solving and decoration. Here you can experience unforgettable and interesting levels, and you can also build your dream house as you like. Challenge the screw level puzzles, think carefully about each step, and you will dig out more happiness!

bluejetty:00014619:ios.description:
Create QR codes you can update any time — no reprint needed. MQRG is the smart QR toolkit for businesses, creators, and marketers.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Paste a URL, contact, or any content
2. Pick a template, customize colors, shapes, and icons
3. Export, share, or save — your QR code is live and editable
Pro tip: create a QR code from any website using the iOS Share Menu.
SMART QR CODES — EDIT ANY TIME
New WiFi password. Updated menu. New landing page. Changed phone number.
Change the destination whenever you need to — the printed code keeps working. No reprint, no panic.
KNOW WHAT HAPPENS AFTER THE SCAN
Track every scan: when, where, how many. Get a push notification the moment someone scans your code. Spot your best campaigns and adjust based on real data — not guesses.
YOUR DOMAIN, YOUR BRAND
Use your own URL for every QR code link. More trust, more professional — every scan reinforces your brand.
460+ TEMPLATES — MATCH YOUR BRAND IN SECONDS
Colors, shapes, icons, corners, embedded text. Start from a ready-made design or build your own. Every template is designed to scan reliably.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN ONE APP
URLs, vCards, vCard+, Multi-links, WiFi, Phone, SMS, Email, PDFs, Images, Google Places, and all major social platforms. Plus batch creation from .csv or .json — hundreds of QR codes in a single tap.
BUILT-IN SCANNER & QUALITY CHECK
Scan any QR code or barcode. Verify your own codes scan reliably in different lighting and on different surfaces — before you print.
REAL SUPPORT, REAL PEOPLE
Need help? We reply to every message, usually within a day.
Download MQRG and create your first smart QR code in seconds.

bluejetty:00022280:ios.name: GetPodcast - Podcast Player
bluejetty:00022280:ios.summary:
GetPodcast - The simple & intuitive podcast player. All your favorite podcasts in one app - Discover a variety of podcasts and episodes with the GetPodcast app. Completely free.
YOUR PODCAST FUNCTIONS AT A GLANCE
• Listen to your podcasts
bluejetty:00022280:ios.description:
GetPodcast - The simple & intuitive podcast player. All your favorite podcasts in one app - Discover a variety of podcasts and episodes with the GetPodcast app. Completely free.
YOUR PODCAST FUNCTIONS AT A GLANCE
• Listen to your podcasts online and offline
• Over 900,000 podcasts available to listen and subscribe to for free
• Supports Apple CarPlay, Airplay and DarkMode
• Clear search for categories, topics and content
• Easily manage your podcasts
• Discover exciting content through our editorial team
• The auto-delete option helps you save space
• Receive notifications of new episodes
• Decide for yourself whether new episodes can only be downloaded in the WLAN
THE PODCAST PLAYER
Our podcast player allows you to adjust the playback speed according to your individual listening pleasure. You can subscribe to each episode directly via the podcast player or download it for offline listening. Do you want to hear a passage from an episode again? Then you can use the 15 second rewind function and if you want to fall asleep with GetPodcast, just use the sleep timer. Our podcast player has everything your heart desires.
DISCOVER NEW PODCASTS
On the Discover page, you will always receive new podcast suggestions through curated lists and recommendations from our editorial team. With the GetPodcast app you can also browse clear categories such as music, news, comedy, business and science to discover new content.
APPLE CARPLAY
The GetPodcast app also accompanies you when you drive, so you can listen to your favorite podcasts anytime, anywhere. With the Apple CarPlay integration, you can operate the GetPodcast app safely and intuitively while driving.
CLEAR SEARCH
With the GetPodcast Search you will always find the right content, you can search for podcasts, episodes, content and topics. In addition, you can get inspiration for which podcasts are trending right now by displaying frequent searches.
WLAN DOWNLOAD & WLAN STREAMING
With the smart WiFi functions, you can save your smartphone's mobile data consumption. If you have activated the WiFi download & streaming function, podcasts are only streamed with a WiFi connection or new episodes are downloaded.
AUTO-DELETE & AUTO-PLAY
You can activate the automatic playback for uninterrupted listening pleasure, so the next episode of the current podcast is always started automatically. If you have activated the auto-delete function, episodes that have ended after 48 hours are automatically deleted.
SEAMLESS HEARING ENJOYMENT
With Apple's HandOff feature, you can seamlessly continue listening to your podcasts on your Apple devices.
SIRI SHORT COMMANDS
You can add your podcasts as a Siri shortcut so that you can easily play your favorite podcast by voice command.
VOICE OVER
GetPodcast supports the VoiceOver function and supports the gesture-based screen reading function from Apple.

bluejetty:00017836:ios.description:
Expense Keep is the simplest and quickest way to track your expenses. It will save you money and improve your financial health.
Expense Keep has been downloaded over 500,000 times and ranked top 5 Finance app in 33 countries.
"This is exactly what I was looking for. It has cut my spending tremendously. Couldn't be happier with this app."
"I have never rated an app before but I feel so strongly about this app that I knew I had to share with everyone how great it is!"
"All I wanted was a sole app to track multiple accounts. This does it. I love it and have deleted all of my other expense tracking apps."
"This app is the only budget app that I could find which works well with a zero-based budget."
"This is the best budget envelope app available. So beautifully designed and simple to use. Includes recurring transactions and transfers between envelopes."
"This app is awesome! Super easy to use without requiring so much personal info like other apps (Mint)."
"Finally an expenses tracking app that don't force you to connect every single bank account you have. This app is for those, like me, that like to keep their info as private as possible."
"This app is helping me feel in much more control of my finances."
"This app is fantastic. Don't know how i ever managed without it."
"Awesome app. Easy to use. Quick to set up and quick to input transactions."
"Have tried a number of apps to track expenses, and this one has everything I've been looking for."
Expense Keep is a personal finance app built to be fast and designed to be flexible yet simple to use. Organize your money into separate accounts and track your expenses and incomes. Accounts can be used to track your bank account balances or as "envelopes" for your different spending groups.
FEATURES:
Accounts
+ Add/Edit/Delete accounts.
+ Set starting balance.
+ Organize your money into separate accounts.
+ View current balance of each account.
Expenses and Incomes
+ Add/Edit/Delete entries for expenses and incomes.
+ Create custom expense categories.
+ Assign expenses/incomes to an account.
+ Set a date and note for each entry.
+ Select a category for expenses.
Transfers
+ Add/Edit/Delete transfers.
+ Transfer money from one account to another.
+ Helps you stay on budget when you overspend in one account.
Recurring Entries
+ Add/Edit/Delete recurring entries that get automatically entered.
+ Setup recurring expenses/incomes/transfers for each account.
+ Set repeat cycles of daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly and more.
+ Set a start date and end date for recurring expenses.
+ Or set recurring expenses to be ongoing with no end date.
Monthly History
+ View all entries for current month.
+ Go back and see previous months' entries.
+ Go to future months and add entries ahead of time.
Cash Flow
+ See how much you earned/spent for the month.
+ Cash flow bar chart helps you spend less than you earn.
Expense Chart
+ Pie chart shows your expenses broken down into categories.
+ See where all your money is going.
+ Filter pie chart to show only the accounts you select.
Report
+ CSV export
Security
+ Passcode lock feature
More features coming soon!
Have questions, requests, or feedback?
Send them to info@expensekeep.com
If you enjoy using Expense Keep or found the app useful, please consider leaving a review. It helps us a lot. Thank you!

bluejetty:00061910:ios.description:
Start learning or keep improving your Spanish, English, French or any other language with private tutoring, thanks to qualified native teachers.
With italki, enjoy an immersive learning experience with native teachers, and learn Spanish, French or any other language by sharing a real and human connection with your teacher.
Do you want to learn a new language? Would you like to study English with a native teacher? You speak a bit of French and you’re not sure how to keep on learning? Language academies don’t fit your schedule? Download italki, register for free and learn Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean and more languages.
Customize the way you learn languages; connect with native teachers according to your interests, work experience, etc. In italki you’ll find qualified language teachers to learn the language you like best (English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, Korean…).
Make the most of this opportunity to learn languages, practice your conversation skills, get to know new cultures and grow professionally. Aside from the italki’s community’s support, video call tutoring with native teachers is the best tool for you to learn a language.
italki, the app to learn languages with tutoring
More than 150 languages available with native teachers
- Spanish
- English
- French
- Japanese
- Korean
- German
… and much more!
◉ Language classes where and when you want
Do you want to make the most of your lunch break at work or your daily walk to learn Spanish? Choose the class duration (30, 45, 60 or 90 minutes) and adjust it to your schedule. Use italki Classroom, Skype, Zoom or another platform for your online language classes and start speaking the language you always wanted to learn, or practice the languages you want to get better at. 
◉ Master the language skills you need the most
italki's qualified teachers tailor their language classes to your current level (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2). They will build every lesson based on your personal needs and weaknesses, to ensure you progress fast.
Choose a course that fits your priorities: conversation, business, grammar, creative writing, exam preparation… You have lots of options available for each language! 
◉ Pay as you go
Forget about paying a lot without knowing if you’ll be able to attend all the classes. With italki, you pay per class. You can also buy credits to spend them little by little or buy a package and save on the final price.
Educators set their own prices, from less than $10 for qualified teachers to less than $5 for tutors. You also have three classes for less than $5 each to try, so you can make sure it’s right for you!
◉ An immersive learning experience
Learn and exchange with native teachers who will teach you everything you need to know about the language and its culture, and with whom you can create a real human connection, far beyond mechanical language learning. Whether you want to learn Spanish, English, Japanese or any other language, progress quickly with a total immersion.
◉ Connect with thousands of native teachers
Find Spanish, English, French, Japanese, German, Italian and Korean teachers, and teachers of many more languages. Choose your teacher according to their interests, specialization, or even their accent: British or American English, to learn English and any other language you need.
Some teachers use language-teaching materials in their tutoring classes, such as books, videos, cards, etc.
◉ Learning together with your friend
Invite your friends to join italki to study a language, and earn $10 every time one of them spends their first $20. They will also earn $5 for adding you as their referrer.
Study online, learn languages with native tutors in italki and expand your world.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00079883:ios.description:
Toy Conflict is a strategic battle simulation fighting game. The game encompasses two main modes: Campaign and Sandbox.
In campaign, you are given a limited amount of in-game resources to build an army to defeat an enemy force. In sandbox, you build both armies and the two opposing armies can be placed on either side of the map. bluejetty:00138298:ios.description:
Get the latest Arizona lottery numbers within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Powerball (including Double Play)
- Powerball Xs & Os
- Mega Millions
- The Pick
- Triple Twist
- Fantasy 5
- Pick 3 (Midday and Evening)
- Pick 4 (Midday and Evening)
Powerball, Powerball Xs & Os, Mega Millions, The Pick, Triple Twist, Fantasy 5, Pick 3 and Pick 4 also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level. 
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

bluejetty:00031594:ios.summary: In Roll, you have 2500 rolls to collect as many points as possible. Roll your dice to gain points, spend your points to upgrade your dice, and repeat. Borrowing gameplay elements from strategy, clicker, and roguelike deckbuilder genres, Rol
bluejetty:00031594:ios.description: In Roll, you have 2500 rolls to collect as many points as possible. Roll your dice to gain points, spend your points to upgrade your dice, and repeat. Borrowing gameplay elements from strategy, clicker, and roguelike deckbuilder genres, Roll creates a perfect balance of relaxation with critical thinking. While the "Clicker"/"Incremental" genre is not known for its variety or depth of game mechanics, Roll offers a unique dicebuilding system which allows you to explore different strategies and synergies between upgrades. Each run will present you with new and interesting decisions creating a huge depth of strategy and keeping the game feeling always fresh. Roll is designed to be a relaxing and meditative experience. Get lost in the satisfying sounds and effects as all your worries melt away. From the minimalistic UI to the slow peaceful music, everything was designed to create the perfect zen environment. If you enjoy building an engine and watching it grow, chasing down highscores, or just need to escape from your own thoughts, then I really hope you'll enjoy my game, Roll. :)

bluejetty:00160740:ios.description:
Want deep conversations with your partner?
Deeper Talks for couples is a guided conversation app with meaningful relationship questions and couple question games designed to improve intimacy, trust, and communication.
HOW IT WORKS
Deeper Talks is an app that is best used together.
1. Open app with your partner
2. Choose a topic or a couple question game
3. Read questions for couples
4. Take turns answering question cards
5. Let each answer build the conversation
The experience feels simple and natural, like playing a thoughtfully arranged set of conversation cards, guiding you from one question to the next.
A QUESTIONS FOR COUPLES APP
Deeper Talks includes hundreds of questions across many relationship topics. These conversations help you:
+ Connect with each other
+ Spend quality time together
+ Improve communication in a relationship
+ Deepen emotional and physical intimacy
+ Build trust through honest conversations
+ Resolve conflicts with care
+ Talk through serious life decisions
Many of the questions are inspired by conversations that couples explore in therapy, adapted into a private, self-guided experience.
DIFFERENT WAYS TO COMMUNICATE
Not every conversation needs the same amount of time or energy.
+ Daily questions: one question each day to share as a love message
+ Conversation packs: themed sets of question cards that rotate weekly
+ Guided paths: multi-week experiences to build trust and bond
+ Relationship check-ins: quizzes to reflect over time
STRUCTURE & PROGRESS
Deeper Talks offers light structure to keep communication going:
+ Weekly goals to encourage regular conversations
+ Achievements to celebrate progress
FREE vs PREMIUM

bluejetty:00089096:ios.description:
Describe what you want. Replit builds it — websites, web apps, slides, videos, data dashboards, and more.
No coding. No tools to learn. Just describe what you need in plain language, and Replit handles the building, testing, debugging, and hosting — all in one place. It's like having an entire team of engineers and designers on demand, available through a simple chat.
Trusted by 50 million creators and builders worldwide.
BUILD ANYTHING
One platform for everything you want to make:
- Web apps — live in minutes with a public URL
- Websites and prototypes
- Slide decks and presentations
- Videos and animations
- Data apps and dashboards
DESIGN FREELY
Design directly on a live canvas. No handoff. No gap between what you picture and what ships.
BUILD TOGETHER
Every request becomes a structured task your team can track. Add tasks anytime, see progress in real-time, and stay focused on what matters — while Replit handles the maintenance, updates, and complexity in the background.
MOVE FASTER
Multiple AI agents work across your project simultaneously — building infrastructure, integrating services, and refining features at once. What used to take cycles now happens in parallel.
EVERYTHING BUILT IN — ZERO SETUP
Authentication, database, hosting, and monitoring are all included from day one. No configuration, no infrastructure decisions. Build fully scalable web apps securely from the start.
100+ INTEGRATIONS, NO API KEYS NEEDED
Connect to Google Drive, Gmail, Google Workspace, enterprise data warehouses, and more. Turn your project into a fully connected system in minutes, not days.
SECURE BY DEFAULT
Pre-deployment security screening, secure built-in services, and enterprise-grade controls — including SSO/SAML and SOC2 — so what you build stays protected.
WHO USES REPLIT:
- Founders and entrepreneurs building their first product or MVP
- Designers who want to ship without depending on a developer
- Product managers building internal tools and prototypes
- Marketers who need campaign tools and dashboards
- Students creating real projects for their portfolio
- Anyone with an idea and no time to waste
Creativity runs on Replit.
Get started for free. Download and build something today.

Have you heard of the legendary Jewel Gold Empire? 
Play more than 3,000 puzzle stages 
Packed with special blocks and magic blocks with jewels. 
Conquer the Jewel Gold Empire by collecting treasures scattered all over the land.
Some of the earlier stages will instantly be cleared 
when you align three of the same blocks. 
Not having fun? The puzzles will get more and more difficult as you progress.
Enjoy the best puzzle game anywhere and at any time.

Match more than 3 of the same jewels horizontally or vertically.
Use items to break through difficulties.
[Game Features]
No hearts required, free game for life. 
Internet connection is not required to play.
Dynamic puzzle game with more than 3,000 stages.
[Note]
1. When changing to a new device, save the game progress by pressing Run Game - Setting - Save,
then open the game on a new device by loading the save game through Run Game - Setting - Load. 
2. It is a free game but includes paid items. (ad removal, coins, items)
3. The game includes banner, front, and reward advertisements.

ABOUT 5-MINUTE EMERGENCY MEDICINE CONSULT

bluejetty:00027207:ios.description:
ABOUT 5-MINUTE EMERGENCY MEDICINE CONSULT 
Rosen & Barkin’s 5-Minute Emergency Medicine Consult delivers practical, quick-read information on over 600 medical conditions seen in emergency medicine directly to your smartphone and tablet. Search and browse for answers in concise topics organized to help save valuable time. Written and edited by practicing clinicians, this mobile resource is ideal for confirming accurate diagnoses and beginning treatment in the fast-paced environment seen in urgent and emergent care. Perfect for all practitioners, nurses, and residents in an emergency department setting. 
FEATURES 
• Fully-updated details on 600+ topics found in emergency medicine
• New topics include vasopressor therapy, renal tubular acidosis, chemotherapy complications, renal failure, opioid use disorder, ECMO
• Basics, Diagnosis, Treatment, Follow-up
• Diagnoses spanning from pre-hospital to disposition stage 
• Highlight and make custom notes within entries 
• Features new information—based on the latest practice guidelines and theoretical developments—and new approaches to diagnosis and management.
• Helpful Pearls and Pitfalls to help avoid common errors
• Advanced Search help find terms across all topics
• “Favorites” for bookmarking important entries 
Editors: Jeffrey J. Schaider, MD; Roger M. Barkin, MD, MPH; Stephen R. Hayden, MD; Richard E. Wolfe, MD; Adam Z. Barkin, MD, MPH; Philip Shayne, MD, Amanda L. Doodlesack, Michael E. Nelson, and Erik K. Nordquist
Publisher: Wolters Kluwer
Powered by: Unbound Medicine

bluejetty:00061171:ios.name: BookBuddy Pro: Book Tracker
bluejetty:00061171:ios.summary: BookBuddy is a powerful book management app that gives you access to your entire book catalog, anywhere. Using BookBuddy is fun and easy, allowing you to quickly find any book in your library, share your favorite books, and keep track of bo
bluejetty:00061171:ios.description:
BookBuddy is a powerful book management app that gives you access to your entire book catalog, anywhere. Using BookBuddy is fun and easy, allowing you to quickly find any book in your library, share your favorite books, and keep track of borrowed and lent books.
KEY FEATURES
• Adding Your Books
Add your books using the following options:
- Scan barcode (via iPhone camera or Bluetooth handheld scanner)
- Enter ISBN
- Search online by keyword
- Add manually
- Import from CSV file
• Organizing Your Books
Place your books where they belong:
- My Books — books you own
- Wish List — books you wish to own
- Borrowed — books you borrowed from others
- Previously Owned — books you no longer own
• Syncing Your Library
Sync your library across multiple devices using iCloud or Dropbox sync.
• Sharing Your Library
Share your library online via the BookBuddy Companion website and invite anyone to view it (requires a monthly subscription).
• Unlocking Your Reading Insights
Deep dive into your reading habits by exploring the following statistics:
- Books Finished — Track the number of books you’ve completed
- Pages Read — See your page count over time
- Top Authors — Discover your most-read authors
- Favorite Genres — Identify your preferred genres
MORE TO LOVE
• Universal app — pay once and use BookBuddy on your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon Mac.
• Personalize — use categories and tags, mark favorites, add personal notes, and much more.
• Appearance — choose either list or grid view to best match your needs.
• Custom Filters — filter your library by multiple criteria.
• Advanced Sorting — apply multi-level data sorting.
• Loans — instantly track books that are currently loaned out.
• Multiple selection — apply batch operations using multiple selection.
• Reading Status — filter your books by their reading status.
• Quick find — instantly find books by entering search keywords or scanning their barcodes.
• Export — quickly export your library into CSV, PDF, or HTML formats.
• Print — easily print selected books to AirPrint-enabled printers.
• Backup — create backups to any cloud service.
• Activity History — view the full history of your reading and loaning activities.
• Duplicates — quickly detect duplicates and easily remove them.
• Markdown Formatting — style your notes with headings, lists, bold, italics, links, and more.
• Privacy — your library is saved locally and privately on your device.
• And so much more!
CLASSROOM LIBRARY MANAGER (for teachers)
• Manage — use BookBuddy to manage your classroom library and track student checkouts.
• Checkout History — easily track checkout history and view statistics.
• Contacts — save your student names in BookBuddy Contacts rather than in your personal Contacts app.
• Reading Level Fields — use various fields to track the reading level of your books.
• Online Sharing — allow students to self-checkout books via the BookBuddy Companion website (requires a monthly subscription).
FEEDBACK
We love staying in touch with our users and we look forward to hearing from you! If you have any feedback, questions, or concerns, please email us at:
support@kimicoapps.com 
or visit: http://www.kimicoapps.com/support.html
Follow us on Facebook:
http://www.facebook.com/KimicoLtd

* Terms and Conditions: https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/12652322

bluejetty:00119255:ios.description:
** NO SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED **
Invoice Maker Simple is the easiest way to make and send professional invoices and estimates to your customers.
Create invoices and estimates wherever you are - with a customer between jobs, or at home. Get paid faster.
It’s perfect for small business owners, contractors, cleaners, freelancers, trades people, construction workers.
Simple invoicing will save your precious time.
Create, send and track invoices and estimates on your iPhone and iPad and keep your finances and accounting organised.
You can simply add your customer’s info with purchased items.
You can make simple but professional PDF invoices, quotes, estimates, purchase orders, receipts, timesheets instantly. 
That’s it. All will be done in minutes rather than hours. It’s so simple.
It is also easy to track all invoices, estimates, quotes in one place.
Professional looking templates are available for you to suit your business needs.
Perfect for small business owners, contractors, cleaners, freelancers, trades people, construction workers.
[ Key features of this simple invoice maker app ]
• Manually edit titles, subtitles, and currency codes (e.g. Invoice -> Tax Invoice)
• Payment term set up based on each customer
• Turn quotes, estimates into invoices by a single tap
• Check paid, overdue, unpaid invoices
• Professionally designed beautiful templates (One simple template, 3 templates with header images)
• CSV spreadsheet export to be used in your accounting software
• Send PDFs via Email or SMS messenger
• Save all PDF files in Apple Files app
• Available on iPhone, iPad
• Attach photos into invoices, quotes, estimates • Use payment methods field to enter your payment details such as PayPal, credit card, bank transfer info
• Tax, GST, VAT set up (e.g. No tax, single tax, compound tax)
• Add discount (Actual $ or %)
• Add payment terms (Immediate, 7 days, 14 days, 21 days,...up to 180 days)
• Add signature and date on the spot
• Simple, crisp, high resolution templates in PDF
[ Invoicing and more ]
You can also keep track of your business expenses and bills. 
Both income and expenses are visible in dashboard views in Reports page so that you can keep track of your cash flow. 
Reporting will be visible monthly, quarterly, yearly. This will benefit you to prepare your Tax and Accounting documents.
You can even use this app as receipt tracker and bill tracking organiser because you can attach receipts.
Invoice Maker Pro is the ultimate invoice maker. Send simple invoices using professional templates, invoice generator, PDF invoices and estimates, fast payments, bill organiser, receipt and expense tracker, and business cash flow reporting - all in one app.
Please download our free invoice app today to see it yourself. You can start a free trial without singing in. 
All simple and easy.
[ Upgrade to subscription version ]
Subscription version offers cloud sync and back up feature so that you can save all the info in our highly secured cloud services and share the same data in multiple iOS devices such as iPhone and iPad.
Upgrading to subscription version requires auto-renewal subscription.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. 
The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase.
Links to Your Privacy Policy and Terms of Use: 
http://invoicemkr.com/privacy.html
http://invoicemkr.com/terms.html
Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions.
Try now! Simple invoicing will save your precious time.

bluejetty:00119492:ios.description:

Open the app, point your camera, and scan any QR code or barcode instantly. QR Code Reader supports all major formats, including QR CODE, EAN13, UPC, ITF14, CODE128, AZTEC, DATAMATRIX, and more. Results appear right away, so you can open links, access product details, or save your scans.

Scan barcodes to get nutritional info, product details, and pricing. Track items in your pantry or household with simple inventory tools.

bluejetty:00127749:ios.description:
Map My Ride – Your Complete GPS Bike Ride Tracker for Every Ride
Reach your cycling goals with Map My Ride, the ultimate Bike Tracker that helps you log every mile, track performance, and explore new bike trails. Whether you're a beginner on your first road ride or a seasoned cyclist prepping for a race, this powerful bike app gives you everything you need to stay on track.
With built-in GPS tracking, performance stats, and a cycling-focused community of over 40 million cyclists, Map My Ride makes it easy to stay motivated, measure progress, and discover new routes.
Now with Garmin integration, Apple Watch, and Apple Health support for tracking your full training picture.
TRACK EVERY RIDE WITH PRECISION
- Use GPS to log your ride route and view your performance on a detailed bikemap
- Real-time audio coaching with updates on pace, distance, duration, and elevation
- Track over 600+ activities beyond cycling—like running, walking, strength training, and more
- Use the Routes feature to find new bike trails, save favorites, or share rides with friends
- Perfect for road cyclists, commuters, or indoor training sessions
Whether you ride outdoors or train indoors, this Bike Tracker captures every detail of your ride.
ANALYZE YOUR BIKE RIDE PERFORMANCE ON EVERY MILE
- See detailed stats for each ride: distance, speed, elevation, calories burned, and more
- Set and adjust personal goals to match your fitness journey
- View your full history and track improvements over time
- Stay consistent with tools that keep you focused and motivated
From a casual spin to a challenging climb, this bike ride tracker gives you insights that help you get better.
CONNECT WITH APPS AND WEARABLES
- Sync with Garmin, Apple Watch, Suunto, Polar, and other top fitness wearables
- Seamless integration with Apple Health for accurate heart rate and activity ring updates
- Pair with MyFitnessPal to balance your nutrition/meal planning and calorie burn
- Connect your bike tracker app data with fitness platforms for full performance tracking
Whether you're tracking mileage or monitoring your biking distance tracker, Map My Ride fits into your routine.
TAKE YOUR BIKE RIDES FURTHER WITH MVP PREMIUM FEATURES
Take your training further with Premium tools built for serious cyclists:
- Personal training plans that adapt to your goals and fitness level
- In-depth analysis of heart rate zones to fine-tune your training
- Create custom splits to measure speed and effort across segments
- Limited Ads – focus on your ride and minimize distractions in the app.
This cycling tracker evolves with you as you get stronger and go farther.
JOIN THE CYCLING COMMUNITY
- Share your workouts with friends and connect with other cyclists
- Compete in community challenges and push your limits
- Discover motivation through fellow riders in the activity feed
- Be part of the global Map My Ride network and ride stronger together
Whether you use this app as a ride tracker, bicycle tracker, or all-around bike tracker, you’ll love the support and inspiration from the community.
READY TO RIDE SMARTER?
Download Map My Ride today — the trusted Bike Tracker for cyclists everywhere. Whether you're using it for a quick city commute, getting a short workout in, or discovering new bike trails, this all-in-one ride tracker and bicycle tracker helps you map routes, monitor performance, and ride with confidence. Log every mile, explore the ride with GPS tools, and enjoy every moment on the saddle with Map My Ride.

bluejetty:00036581:ios.description:
Chair Yoga is designed to make fitness accessible to everyone, regardless of space, equipment, or fitness level. Leveraging the simplicity and versatility of a chair, the app provides users with personalized workout plans that can be performed in any setting, be it at home, in the office, or while traveling. This app is perfect for those looking to incorporate more physical activity into their busy schedules without the need for a gym membership or expensive equipment.
Key Features:
- Personalized Workout Plans: Upon starting, users are prompted to input their fitness goals, current fitness level, and any specific preferences or limitations. The app then generates a customized workout plan that evolves as you progress, ensuring continuous improvement and engagement.
- Progress Tracking: The app includes a robust progress tracking feature that allows users to monitor their advancements in strength, endurance, and overall fitness. Users can set goals, track workouts, and visually see their progress over time, keeping motivation high.
- Expert Instruction: Each workout is demonstrated through high-quality video tutorials led by professional fitness instructors. These experts provide tips on proper form and modifications for different fitness levels, ensuring exercises are performed safely and effectively.
- Diverse Workout Library: Chair Yoga offers a wide array of routines targeting different muscle groups, from strength training and cardio to flexibility and balance exercises. New and innovative workouts are regularly added to keep the routine exciting and challenging.
- User-Friendly Design: With its intuitive design, the app is easy to navigate for all ages and tech skill levels. Features like voice commands, customizable interface (including text size and contrast adjustments), and easy-to-follow menus enhance the user experience, making fitness more accessible to everyone.
Chair Yoga is more than just an app; it's a lifestyle change that makes fitness achievable and enjoyable for people leading busy lives or those simply looking for a new and convenient way to stay active. Whether you're a fitness newbie or looking to shake up your routine, Chair Yoga is your go-to solution for a stronger, healthier you. Download now and start transforming your fitness journey, one chair workout at a time.

bluejetty:00024946:ios.description:
* Grammy Academy awarded: app to support percussive music preservation.
Write, share, and practice drum music like never before. 
Join over 200,000 drummers and percussionists in 180 countries who have already created 400,000+ scores with Drum Notes, a simple app to create and share drum beats, music scores, drum lessons, drum loops, drum tabs and rhythms. Ideal for beginners and pros alike.
Drum Notes features an intuitive score creator, perfect for drumset and percussive genres like Samba, Marching Bands, Drumlines, Cuban percussion, and Drum grooves. 
Think of it as a more accessible version of Musescore, Flat or Finale, tailored for drummers. Like a drum machine or drum sequencer with real drum scores. 
FOR DRUMMERS - ALL LEVELS
Intuitive Music Score Editor: Effortlessly create percussive sheet music with a user-friendly music writing editor, for drum set or any percussion instrument.
Explore Beats: Learn drums by discovering thousands of beats, loops, and percussion samples from our drumming community.
Practice Tools: Adjust your own pro metronome, customize grooves, and use the drum score editor as a rhythm trainer.
Organize Your Notes: Keep rhythms, arrangements, recordings, and exercises neatly organized.
FOR TEACHERS - ENHANCE YOUR INSTRUCTION
Drum Exercises: Create, share, and manage exercises with ease.
Student-Teacher Groups: Maintain shared spaces for class materials and track progress.
Public Library: Access and share a wealth of exercises and materials.
FOR BANDS - PERFECT FOR BATUCADAS
Arrange and Share: Organize complex patterns and rhythms, and export them in audio or image formats.
Private Groups: Create groups for sharing compositions and performance notes.
Explore Percussion Rhythms: Discover diverse samples and beats to inspire and enhance your band’s sound.
FOR CONTENT CREATORS - SHARE PROFESSIONAL CONTENT
Export Options: Share drum grooves as high-quality audio or images. Perfect for showcasing your work on social media.
Diverse Library: Use an extensive collection of beats and samples for creating stunning content.
FOR MUSICIANS - EXPAND YOUR PLAYBACK OPTIONS
Playback Tool: Use Drum Notes to playback loops and samples for various instruments.
Versatile Use: Ideal for enhancing rhythm and practice sessions with authentic beats.
ADDITIONAL FEATURES
Diverse percussion instruments:
Drum Set
Electronic Drum Kit
Cajon
Rumba Instruments: Congas, Clave, Cowbell, Shaker, etc.
Samba Instruments: Surdos, Repique, Caixa, Agogos, Rebolo, Pandeiro, etc.
Samba Reggae Instruments: Timbal, Bacurinha, etc.
Marching Band / Drumline Instruments: Quads, Snare Drums, Bass Drum, Cymbals. 
Capoeira Instruments: Berimbau Viola, Berimbau Berra Boi, Berimbau Medio, Agogo, Pandeiro, Atabaque
And many more…
Percussion Library: Rock, Jazz, Samba, Marching Band, Capoeira, and many more.
Customizable Settings: Adjust metronome BPM, sound accents, and more.
Global Community: Connect with percussionists and drummers worldwide.
PREMIUM FEATURES
Unlock unlimited compositions, percussive instruments per score, and private groups. Support our mission to improve musical knowledge.
JOIN THE DRUM NOTES COMMUNITY
Developed by a team dedicated to empowering drummers and percussionists.
Drum Coach App: Explore our app for developing practice habits with exercises, scores, and audio instructions.
We wish you great grooves!
#drum, #drums, #drumline, #samba, #percussion
* if you are looking for the app Drumap (drum app; drum map), this is it! Now we are called Drum Notes.

bluejetty:00118840:ios.description:
Stop asking the question that where my money went, and why there is no money left in my wallet. Budget Projects keeps your money well managed and spent. 
By Budget Projects, you can create income and expense budgets, which indicate how much money you plan to spend or get, then when you have transactions under that budget, add them into it. 
When there is less money to spend under a budget, you will automatically control spending. 
This app helps controlling yourself spending money randomly and keeping your money well organized. After using it for a while, you will be surprised how much money you will save. 
Key Features: 
⁃ Create unlimited budgets with recurring or not. 
⁃ Recurring budgets by single or multiple cycles of daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly. 
⁃ Progress bar to show used amount VS budget amount. 
⁃ Over roll amount to next cycles or not. 
⁃ Custom order of added budgets. 
⁃ Add recurring transactions. 
⁃ Editable default categories and you can add your own. 
⁃ Pie chart reports to show income, expense and savings. 
⁃ Cycle pie chart reports to show percentage and amount of each budget. 
⁃ Chart report to show cash flow tendency. 
⁃ Search transactions by their name, type amount or note. 
⁃ Hide Expired Budgets or not. 
⁃ Air print support. 
⁃ iCloud backup and restore. 
⁃ Dropbox backup and restore. 
⁃ Passcode protection. 
⁃ Supports Touch ID as passcode.
⁃ Custom week and month start day. 
⁃ Create unlimited reminders. 
⁃ Export data in form of CSV, HTML or PDF. 
⁃ Adds 3D Touch function.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch.
⁃ Supports universal version (available on both iPhone and iPad). 
If you have any question or suggestion, please email to linklinksapp@tom.com.

bluejetty:00166833:ios.summary: "Word Connect puzzle game is really a good choice if you love playing word puzzle games or want to learn more words. If you are tired after work or study, you can play this word connect puzzle game for several minutes to relax your body and
bluejetty:00166833:ios.description:
"Word Connect puzzle game is really a good choice if you love playing word puzzle games or want to learn more words. If you are tired after work or study, you can play this word connect puzzle game for several minutes to relax your body and mind. You can also play this word connect word game every day for several minutes to improve your vocabulary and train your brain. This word connect game will calm your mind not only with word puzzles but also by bringing you beautiful landscapes and soothing music. 
Word Connect has more than 10000+ word puzzles waiting for you. You will sleep well after you solve several word puzzles at night. Also, when you are trying to learn more words, this word connect game makes your study interesting. You can swipe the letters to connect them into the hidden words; you need to recognize or guess the hidden words from the jumbled letters! If you don't know any words, you can use the free word translation feature to get the meanings. If you find any additional words not in the hidden words, these words will be taken as bonus words. Accumulating the bonus words can get you a gift box.
Daily word puzzles make the word connect game more challenging. If you are, or are trying to be, a word game master, you will love the daily word challenges. There are three daily word puzzles to challenge you every day; you can choose the one you love the most or you can challenge all of them. Word Connect is similar to crossword puzzle game; both of them are going to connect the letters to a word, so Word Connect adds a cross word puzzle in daily challenge to make the gameplay richer.
Word Connect features 200+ beautiful backgrounds of landscapes, animals, castles, and more. The backgrounds are so beautiful that they make you feel good and like you are traveling around the world. You can unlock these backgrounds by opening the star chests. The star chests are opened by playing the word connect puzzle games, and they also provide you with more gifts.
Word Connect has many abandoned gardens and messy rooms. You can play word connect puzzle games to repair and design them. With your elaborate design, the gardens will come to life, and the rooms will acquire completely new looks.
Good features:
 Easy and fun
 10000+ word puzzles waiting for playing
 200+ beautiful backgrounds waiting for unlocking
 Tens of abandoned gardens & messy rooms waiting for repairing and designing
 Daily puzzles and challenges
 Star Chests
 Word hints, letter shuffle, rockets and planes to reveal letters
 Word translation
 Bonus words
Word Connect will become more and more interesting. More word puzzles, backgrounds, abandoned gardens, and messy rooms will be added. Let's play it!
[Subscription]
Subscriptions refer to auto-renewing subscriptions that can greatly enhance your gaming experience.
An annual subscription costs $23.99, a monthly subscription costs $5.99 and a weekly subscription costs $2.99, or a price tier equal to the dollar subscription price as determined by the Apple App Store Matrix.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscriptions will automatically renew for the same price and term, and auto-renewal can be turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current term.
Your account will be charged the subscription fee at the originally selected price within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions can be managed by you and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the user's iTunes account settings.
For more information, visit the link https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039.
Cancellation of the current subscription is not allowed during the active subscription period.
The unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited when the user decides to subscribe.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.wonderentertain.com/privacy.html"

bluejetty:00040127:ios.description:
You don't have to do faith alone. FaithCircle helps you make Christian friends near you, pray and study the Bible together, and meet up in real life.
Most social apps leave you more disconnected than ever. FaithCircle is built for friendship first, with verified profiles and Christians in 100+ countries.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
FC Connect: make Christian friends
Meet believers near you and around the world. Profiles show what people are open to, so friendship always comes first.
Groups: find people in your season
New city, uni, new parent, waiting on God. Join a group for your stage of life and keep each other going every day.
FC Live: pray and study the Bible, live
Host or join Bible studies, worship and prayer rooms in real time.
FC Events: from chat to real life
Turn group chats into dinners, games and worship nights near you, in person or online.
FC Fasting: fast with friends
Set your intention, read daily scripture and check in with friends who are fasting with you. Grace, not a streak.
Full Bible: read with a friend
The full Bible with reading plans you do together, one day at a time.
Foojie: your faith in short videos
Watch, share and encourage. Real stories from Christians like you.
SAFEGUARDING AND SECURITY
FaithCircle is built to be a safe place to belong.
- Verified profiles, so you know who you're talking to
- You choose who can see your location, discover you and message you
- Report or block anyone in one tap, from a profile, post or chat
- Every report is reviewed by our team, and accounts that break our community guidelines are removed
- Meeting someone from FaithCircle? Our safety tips help you meet in public and tell a friend where you're going
Kindness is the house rule.
FREE TO JOIN
FaithCircle is free to download and use. FC Gold is an optional subscription for those who want more:
- Message anyone directly, before a mutual follow
- Unlimited Say Hi waves, follow requests, profile views and swipes
- 1:1 audio and video calls in chats and groups
- Go live anytime, with filters and effects
- Advanced filters by denomination, location, profession, marital status and age
- See everyone who waved at or liked your profile
- Priority verification, a supporter badge, dark theme and extra privacy controls
FC Gold members help keep FaithCircle 100% ad-free for everyone.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm your purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.
Questions? team@thefaithcircle.com
Privacy: https://thefaithcircle.com/privacy
Terms: https://thefaithcircle.com/terms
Community guidelines: https://thefaithcircle.com/community-guidelines
Safeguarding: https://thefaithcircle.com/safeguarding
Find your people. Grow your faith. Do life together.

bluejetty:00100661:ios.description:
iForm brings business grade, offline data collection to iPhones, iPads and iPod Touches. Utilized by 3 of the top 10 hotel brands in the world, the largest hospital in the US, the US Government, top franchises, amusement parks, and hundreds of small/mid size businesses, iForm helps you increase productivity, reduce costs, and reduce paper use.
Conduct surveys, inspections, walk-throughs, work-orders, audits, tasks, research studies and clinical trials easily and cost effectively on your iPad, iPhone, or iPod Touch. 
Using the iFormBuilder web interface, users can create business grade forms that will work seamlessly across all supported devices. Data views give you the flexibility to see your data in a variety of outputs including Map View, HTML View, PDF View and Excel View. Data feeds (XML, JSON, XLS, RSS, ATOM) offer seamless integration with your back-end systems.
The iFormBuilder platform gives you the power to turn your mobile device into an enterprise grade data collection tool.
Key Benefits:
-Quick turn-around with over-the-air form distribution
-Real time data upload
-Offline data collection (out of service, no wifi)
-Ensures accurate data capture and eliminates redundancy
-Immediately communicate changes and updates to your mobile workforce with server assignment and client-to-client assignment
-Massively scalable
-Maximum security (being used by HIPAA and FISMA regulated projects)
**Please upload all records before upgrading**
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00079311:ios.name: Relive: Hike & Ride Memories
bluejetty:00079311:ios.summary:
If you like to go out for a run, ride, hike, or any adventure outside, you’ll love Relive. And it’s free!
Millions of runners, cyclists, hikers, skiers, snowboarders, and other adventurers are using Relive to share their activities with 3D
bluejetty:00079311:ios.description:
If you like to go out for a run, ride, hike, or any adventure outside, you’ll love Relive. And it’s free!
Millions of runners, cyclists, hikers, skiers, snowboarders, and other adventurers are using Relive to share their activities with 3D video stories.
Show what it was like out there, create amazing stories, and share your passion with friends!
Just go out, track your activity, take some photos, and enjoy the moment. Finished? Time to create your video! Your outdoor activities have never looked so cool.
Relive works with just your phone, as well as with many other tracking apps (like Apple Health, Suunto, etc.).
Create 3D Video Stories for Free
• Turn your activity into a video story
• See your route in a 3D landscape
• Include photos from you and your friends
• See your highlights (like maximum speed)
• Share your videos with your friends on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and more.
Track your activities with GPS
• Track your ride, run, walk, hike, or pretty much any activity
• See your key stats and location in real time
• Take photos during your activity
Connect other apps
• Turn new activities from other apps into Relive video stories
• Works with: Apple Health, Suunto, Garmin Connect, Polar, MapMyRide, MapMyRun, MapMyHike, and MapMyWalk
• More trackers will be added soon!
Relive Plus
• Music: choose from 100+ songs to add to your videos
• More media: add up to 100 photos or clips to your video
• Video quality: your videos in HD
• Edit your videos as many times as you want
• Control video speed and watch at your own pace.
• Longer activities: relive activities lasting over 12 hours
Enjoy Relive for free! Want to experience Relive to the fullest? Get Relive Plus. It’s available as an in-app purchase with a monthly or yearly subscription. You can subscribe and pay through your Apple ID. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal can be turned off after purchase by going to the “Manage Subscription” page in settings.
Terms of use: https://www.relive.com/terms

bluejetty:00027077:ios.description:
The QLD Fires application is designed to provide information on current fires within the state of Queensland Australia. The information is displayed in a list or map view to enable the user to understand how far the fire is from a user.

bluejetty:00029569:ios.name: BAM - Beat Maker & Music Maker
bluejetty:00029569:ios.summary:
BAM - Beat Maker & Music Maker is a professional groovebox-style music production app and AUv3 plugin host with everything you need to bring your musical ideas to life.
Ready, set, create! Experience music production with next-level produc
bluejetty:00029569:ios.description:
BAM - Beat Maker & Music Maker is a professional groovebox-style music production app and AUv3 plugin host with everything you need to bring your musical ideas to life.
Ready, set, create! Experience music production with next-level productivity, BAM’s versatile functionality and feature set is easy to pick up, and hard to put down. In addition to AUv3 plugin support, BAM - Beat Maker & Music Maker comes loaded with its own set of high-quality instruments and effects, for a groovebox with a well stocked toolbox.
Whatever you want to make, quickly turn inspiration into creation with BAM’s intuitive easy-to-use interface, supercharge your workflow and build beats, loops and scenes in minutes. Expand and grow your projects with BAM’s MIDI clip and scene launcher, perform live and arrange full tracks using extensive follow actions.
A step ahead of the competition, BAM’s step sequencer gives you up to 256 steps per clip. View and edit multiple track clips simultaneously, and visualise a scene’s clips together.
Summary of features:
- 16 rack-style tracks plus Master and 2 send channels
- AUv3 plugin support
- Full mixer with volume, pan, mute, solo, arm controls
- Built-in synthesis engines: Oscillator synth, Drum synth, sampler, classic acid bass synth
- Built in effects: Filter, EQ, parametric EQ, delay, chorus, compressor, reverb, saturator, bit reduction, 3D panner and stereo width
- MIDI clip piano roll editor
- Step sequencer with up to 256 steps per clip
- Clip based parameter modulation editor
- Track level trigger options plus LFO and EG modulators
- Matrix MIDI clip and scene launcher with extensive follow action options
- Real-time adjustment of audio clip playback speed to match the tempo of the song, without altering pitch
- Sample library including over 1000 drum and percussive samples, plus melodic timbres
“I’m marking ambient, field recordings and techno projects, the modular interface is perfect for this type of projects, and the interface is minimal with no weird distractions.”
“Great app! Intuitive, fast, logic…”
“Whatever I try, I always come back to BAM to start my tracks. Either to jam live and have fun or to build the basics then export in audio or MIDI and complete in another app.. BAM is versatile enough to allow any musical genre. The team is responsive and helpful in case of questions or issues. I like: intuitive & simple yet powerful UI, built in effects, work with audio loops, export capabilities.”
“How did I miss this one? Easy to learn and like nothing else for live jamming. Get two iPads and run this on one and DRAMBO on the other and go wild. Who needs hardware when you can have this much fun for the price of a couple of beers.”
“I’ve never clicked with what people call ‘groovebox’ apps but this just made sense to me and I had instant results. The more I use it the more I learn and I realize the possibilities it brings. I’m making some slow, dark, atmospheric stuff with it as well as making quick, rhythmic things. The developers are passionate about what they do and respond to questions quickly. I wrote this a few days after buying BAM and I can’t wait to learn it inside out to fully explore it. I think this app is an absolute bargain considering the amount of work that has gone into it and the features included.”
“This app is incredible. The demo tunes alone are well worth it!”
“Great app for building whole songs, courtesy of the built-in clip launcher. The developer is very active, and constantly fixing bugs and adding new features, so definitely recommended.”
“This app has me excited to make arrangements, jams and tracks on the ipad. Your YouTube tutorials were super helpful. The app is easy to use with powerful tools to have a lot of fun. Really appreciate the work you put into this and all of your apps. We are very fortunate. Thank you. Keep jammin!”
“This is literally the type of app I’m looking for, FAR easier to use than most music programs and so far their best work since DRC.”

bluejetty:00162873:ios.description:
Your energy, strength, appetite and mood shift through your cycle. 28 builds your day, your workouts and your meals around them.
28 combines cycle-based workouts, phase-based nutrition and calorie tracking, hormone health insights and Gaia, your AI wellness companion, on top of simple period and ovulation tracking.
Rated 4.6 stars from more than 5,600 ratings in the US App Store.
NEW: YOUR DAY, IN ORDER
- A new Today screen that walks you through your day in order: check in, learn, nourish and move
- It always shows your next step, from morning to night
- See your phase, energy and fertile window at a glance
NEW: TALK TO GAIA
- Check in and ask questions with your voice. Just tap and talk
- Prefer typing? Chat with Gaia anytime
WORKOUTS THAT MATCH YOUR PHASE
- Daily workouts designed for the menstrual, follicular, ovulatory and luteal phases
- Programs from trainers of iconic supermodels
- Push harder when your energy peaks, and scale back when your body asks for rest
NUTRITION & CALORIE TRACKING
- Track calories with targets that fit your goals and your phase
- Log meals by snapping a photo
- Phase-based food guidance for every part of your cycle
RECIPES FROM WHAT YOU HAVE
- Snap a photo of your fridge, pantry or ingredients
- Get recipes matched to your current phase
GROCERIES IN ONE CLICK
- Order phase-specific groceries in one click through Instacart or Uber Eats
MEET GAIA, YOUR AI WELLNESS COMPANION
- Ask Gaia about your cycle, energy, cravings, workouts and nutrition, anytime
- Get personalized guidance based on your phase and logs
- Gaia provides general wellness information, not medical advice
PARTNER SHARING
- Invite your partner to see where you are in your cycle
- They get tips on how to help in each phase, plus your fertile window
OURA RING & APPLE WATCH
- Connect Oura Ring or Apple Watch to refine your fertile window estimate with your overnight temperature
HORMONE HEALTH, EXPLAINED
- Daily insights on how estrogen and progesterone typically change across your cycle
- Understand shifts in mood, sleep, energy and appetite
PERIOD & OVULATION TRACKING
- Period calendar with cycle predictions
- Fertile window and ovulation estimates
- Log symptoms, PMS, mood and more
- Sign in with your email or phone number
WHY WOMEN CHOOSE 28
Most fitness and diet apps assume every day is the same. Your body doesn't work that way. 28 uses cycle-based wellness to help you train, eat and feel your best all month.
28 is for general wellness and fitness. It is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat or prevent any condition, or to be used as contraception. Fertile window estimates should not be used to prevent pregnancy. Talk to a healthcare professional about medical concerns.
SUBSCRIPTION
28 offers optional auto-renewing subscriptions to unlock full features. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

bluejetty:00042543:ios.name: Value Study: art reference
bluejetty:00042543:ios.summary: In art, value (or tone) refers to how light or dark a colour is. If you're learning to paint or draw, doing value studies is one of the best ways to improve. These small, loose sketches in greyscale help you understand where shadows fall an
bluejetty:00042543:ios.description:
In art, value (or tone) refers to how light or dark a colour is. If you're learning to paint or draw, doing value studies is one of the best ways to improve. These small, loose sketches in greyscale help you understand where shadows fall and highlights appear—essential for capturing depth and form.
Value Study is a simple, focused tool designed to help you see values more clearly in your reference images. Instead of just converting a photo to black and white, this app lets you break down tones step by step. Start with just black and white to map out the biggest shapes, then gradually add more values to refine your understanding.
You can also highlight all areas of an image that share the same value, making it easier to see subtle shifts in tone. This is especially useful in complex references, like portraits, where different parts of the image might have the same level of shadow but look completely different in colour.
Value Study isn’t here to replace traditional studies—it’s here to enhance them. Whether you're sketching, painting, or working digitally, this tool makes it easier to focus on the fundamentals of light, shadow, and form.
Try it for free with all features enabled on sample images from Unsplash before deciding to unlock the full app with a low-cost yearly or lifetime purchase. All Value Study Pro upgrades count as lifetime purchase. Either option will unlock Value Study across iPhone, iPad and Mac.
Annual: Auto-renews yearly.
Lifetime: One-time payment, no fees.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00072658:ios.summary: Let's dive into the world of Block Sudoku Puzzle Game and start playing now! Block Sudoku Puzzle is the perfect game for those seeking relaxation and brain training. With its combination of various levels of complexity and addictive gamepla
bluejetty:00072658:ios.description:
Let's dive into the world of Block Sudoku Puzzle Game and start playing now! Block Sudoku Puzzle is the perfect game for those seeking relaxation and brain training. With its combination of various levels of complexity and addictive gameplay, reminiscent of both block puzzles and sudoku, this game offers a refreshing way to unwind. Whether you're feeling tired or down, a few rounds of Block Sudoku will uplift your spirits and provide a soothing escape for your mind.
If you enjoy challenging yourself with block games, Block Sudoku is the ideal choice. Take a break from the daily grind and eliminate negative thoughts as you immerse yourself in this brain-teasing puzzle. Boredom is simply not an option when playing block puzzle games! Whether you want to relieve stress or exercise your brain, Block Sudoku offers a relaxing yet stimulating gaming experience that can be enjoyed anywhere, anytime.
With Block Sudoku, playing block puzzles becomes an incredibly enjoyable and immersive activity. If you're a fan of puzzle games, prepare to be enthralled by the excitement this game brings. It combines the best elements of free block games and cube block grid games, offering an epic journey that challenges and delights players.
How to play Block Sudoku:
Take your time, as there is no time limit in this block game. Think ahead and strategize your moves, especially when facing difficult situations. Every move counts!
Build blocks on the puzzle board to eliminate lines or 3x3 squares with each move, in order to prevent the board from filling up.
Find your zen by striking a balance between destroying block figures quickly and aiming for combos and streaks to achieve higher scores.
Features:
Easy to learn and highly addictive gameplay.
Hours of enjoyable gameplay await you.
Free to play, with no need for an internet connection.
Get ready to experience the thrill of Block Sudoku and embark on an incredible puzzle-solving journey that will keep you engaged for hours on end!"

bluejetty:00143552:ios.description:
Protect your iPhone from spam calls with Call Blocker. Enable automatic protection to identify and block calls from numbers on our spam protection list, which we update as new threats are detected.
Find out who called you, check suspicious numbers, and take control of unwanted calls.
AUTOMATIC SPAM CALL PROTECTION
Call Blocker helps protect your phone from unwanted telemarketing calls and potential phone scams. With protection enabled, your iPhone identifies and blocks calls from numbers included in the protection list.
Your protection list updates automatically to include newly detected spam numbers.
WHO CALLED ME?
Look up a phone number before calling back. Check available information from UnknownPhone.com to see whether a number has been associated with telemarketing, unwanted calls, or potential scams, and read other users' reports.
BLOCK UNWANTED CALLS
Alongside spam protection, add individual numbers to your personal block list. Choose which numbers to block and manage your list in the app.
REPORT SUSPICIOUS NUMBERS
Received a suspicious call? Report the number and share what happened. Your feedback helps us identify new suspicious numbers and improve our protection.
MORE PROTECTION WITH AN OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION
• Access to the full database of dangerous numbers available for your country.
• Automatic updates to your protection list.
• Automatic identification and blocking of numbers included in the protection list.
• Unlimited credits and unrestricted access to available lookup results.
• An ad-free experience.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

The CellGate Access Control and Monitoring s
bluejetty:00044445:ios.description:
Notice: You NEED an account with CellGate before you can use this application. This Application is designed and intended for the sole use by CellGate Access Control and Monitoring Subscribers. 
The CellGate Access Control and Monitoring system lets you control who enters your property and when—from any location, at any time. By simply logging in to your online CellGate account, you can create and customize an unlimited number of access codes and maintain a detailed historical record of all gate activity, including photos. 
Our solar- and AC-powered system packages contain everything you need for remotely controlling automatic and manual gates, and the system's camera options help ensure you receive photos of all gate activity directly to your mobile phone. Built specifically for use with cellular networks and the internet, the CellGate system allows you to monitor and control access to your property 24 hours a day, directly from your mobile phone or any internet connection.
No matter where in the world you happen to be, when a visitor arrives you will receive text, email or voice alerts to your cell phone. Then simply send an open command to any gate anywhere in the U.S.
Working with manual or automatic gates and powered by solar or AC, the CellGate system can operate in a variety of environments such as Farms and Ranches, Oil and Gas Sites, Residences, Deer Leases and Self-Storage Facilities.
Exotic/Wild Game Traps are also controlled and monitored by CellGate with the added option to disable motion triggered image messages after the trap has been closed.
